paper.title: Token-Budget Distillation: Transferring Full-Token Semantics to Compressed Video Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Adapting video vision-language models (VLMs) is computationally expensive because video inputs produce a large number of visual tokens, making both fine-tuning and inference costly. Although visual token compression can reduce this overhead, direct adaptation on compressed inputs often causes semantic drift and noticeable performance degradation. We present Token-Budget Distillation (TBD), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework for adapting video VLMs under a fixed token budget. TBD freezes

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 VLM 在固定视觉 token 预算下适配时的语义漂移和性能下降问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态模型压缩与参数高效适配。它不直接推进基座预训练，但对视频 token 压缩、教师-学生蒸馏和长视频推理成本控制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Token-Budget Distillation。框架冻结预训练视频 VLM 主干，只训练 LoRA adapter，并在视频路径中接入 FlashVID 风格的视觉 token 压缩。核心是双路径 teacher-student：full-token teacher 保留完整语义，compressed student 在任务损失之外接受 answer-region KL distillation、GT-anchored margin distillation 和 reliability-aware KD control。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明该方法在固定 token budget 下能让压缩 student 恢复 full-token teacher 的语义行为，并减少微调与推理成本；未提供模型规模、训练数据量、具体 benchmark 名称或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中山大学、不列颠哥伦比亚大学和 Vast Intelligence Lab。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles semantic drift and accuracy loss when adapting video VLMs under a fixed visual-token budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in efficient multimodal adaptation and compression. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to video-token compression, distillation targets, and inference-cost control for video-language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Token-Budget Distillation freezes the pretrained backbone, trains only LoRA adapters, and inserts FlashVID-style visual token compression into the video pathway. A dual-path teacher-student setup uses a full-token teacher to supervise a compressed student with task loss, answer-region KL distillation, GT-anchored margin distillation, and reliability-aware KD control.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved recovery of full-token semantics under compression and lower adaptation/inference cost, but does not provide model size, data scale, benchmark names, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Sun Yat-sen University, the University of British Columbia, and Vast Intelligence Lab.

recommendation.zh: 只看蒸馏 loss 设计即可；它更像视频 VLM 压缩 recipe，不会改变对预训练数据或架构的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the distillation-loss design only; this is a video-VLM compression recipe, not a result that changes pretraining priors.

paper.title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
paper.abstract: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows set

summary.core_problem: 双向注意力机制计算复杂度随序列长度呈平方级增长，现有的稀疏注意力方法要么依赖输入结构（如文本顺序、图像空间邻近性），要么使用缓慢的聚类过程，难以在推理阶段实现免训练且高效的加速。
summary.importance: 提出了一种免训练的块稀疏注意力加速方法 ClusterAttention，通过快速递归聚类和条带均值补偿机制，在保持高精度的同时，实现了与密集注意力相当的单次查询-键交互延迟，为长序列任务（如高分辨率图像、视频生成、基因组数据）提供了实用的加速方案。
summary.technical_approach: ClusterAttention 采用快速递归聚类方法，根据每个注意力头中键和查询的几何分布生成固定大小（2的幂次方）的簇。为了降低稀疏注意力带来的误差，作者推导了误差表达式，发现未选中簇的键值协方差和 Jensen 不等式效应是主要误差来源。为此，引入了“条带均值补偿”（SMC）机制，通过未选中簇的键和值质心与查询交互，有效补偿了丢失的注意力质量，从而在不显著增加计算量的情况下提升了近似精度。
summary.experiments: 在 DINOv2（视觉 Transformer）和 TabPFN-3（表格数据 Transformer）上的实验表明，ClusterAttention 结合 SMC 机制，在保持较高精度的同时，显著降低了计算延迟。与基于注意力的精确路由相比，随机聚类结合质心选择在某些情况下表现更好，验证了误差分析中关于协方差项的结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 2 节的误差分析（特别是公式 4 和 5），理解 SMC 机制的理论基础；第 3 节的快速递归聚类算法；以及第 4 节的实验结果，观察不同聚类方法和补偿机制对精度和延迟的影响。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The computational complexity of bidirectional attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on input structure (e.g., text order, image spatial proximity) or use slow clustering processes, making it difficult to achieve training-free and efficient speedup during inference.
summary_en.importance: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a training-free block-sparse attention speedup method. By employing fast recursive clustering and a striped mean-compensation mechanism, it achieves latency per query-key interaction comparable to dense attention while maintaining high accuracy, providing a practical acceleration solution for long-sequence tasks (e.g., high-resolution images, video generation, genomic data).
summary_en.technical_approach: ClusterAttention uses a fast recursive clustering method to generate fixed-size clusters (powers of two) based on the geometric distribution of keys and queries in each attention head. To mitigate the error introduced by sparse attention, the authors derive an error expression, identifying the key-value covariance of unselected clusters and the Jensen inequality effect as the main sources of error. To address this, they introduce a 'striped mean-compensation' (SMC) mechanism, which compensates for the lost attention mass by interacting the key and value centroids of unselected clusters with the query, thereby improving approximation accuracy without significantly increasing computation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on DINOv2 (Vision Transformer) and TabPFN-3 (Tabular Data Transformer) demonstrate that ClusterAttention combined with SMC significantly reduces computational latency while maintaining high accuracy. Compared to attention-based exact routing, random clustering combined with centroid selection performs better in some cases, validating the conclusions regarding the covariance term in the error analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the error analysis (especially Equations 4 and 5) to understand the theoretical basis of the SMC mechanism; Section 3 for the fast recursive clustering algorithm; and Section 4 for experimental results, observing the impact of different clustering methods and compensation mechanisms on accuracy and latency. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 提出一种无需训练的注意力加速方法，其对稀疏注意力误差的理论分析（紧密聚类可能导致更大误差）值得关注，可作为长上下文或高效推理的参考。
recommendation.en: Proposes a training-free attention speedup method. Its theoretical analysis of sparse attention error (tight clusters may lead to larger errors) is noteworthy and can serve as a reference for long-context or efficient inference.

paper.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling uses extra test-time compute to improve performance, such as letting language models reason longer when solving a problem. As models keep the entire reasoning trace in memory via full attention, hard tasks that need long thinking can be prohibitively expensive. However, we find most intermediate reasoning tokens lose importance as the model continues reasoning. This calls into question whether retaining them is worth the cost. Based on this insight, we propose Prefix Sliding, w

summary.core_problem: 长链推理的 test-time scaling 受 KV-cache 和全注意力成本限制；当推理轨迹变成数万到十万 token 时，保留所有中间 token 的收益和成本不再匹配。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练目标，而在 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口。长推理 RL、RLVR rollout、异步采样都需要处理超长生成轨迹。Prefix Sliding 给出一个无需重新训练的近似方案：保留指令前缀和最近窗口，丢弃旧的中间推理 token。它把生成时的注意力内存从随轨迹长度线性增长，改成由 prefix 长度和窗口大小决定的常数上界。这对 100k token 级别 rollout、减少 overlong truncation、降低长推理训练成本都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单：推理时固定保留 prefix，包括 system instruction、用户问题、工具说明以及类似 <think> 的模式标记；同时保留最近 W 个生成 token 的滑动窗口。窗口向前移动时，较早的中间推理 token 从 KV-cache 中删除。作者的动机来自注意力分析：早期 prefix token 往往承担 attention sink 和任务约束作用，最近 token 则承载当前推理状态；中间推理 token 的注意力权重会快速下降。对 RoPE 等位置编码，作者比较了 Reset PE 和 Continue PE。Continue PE 不重新计算位置编码，能复用已缓存表示，工程成本更低；附录结果显示两者性能差异不明显，因此采用 Continue PE。训练侧还讨论了两种反传方式：chunked backpropagation 在多个窗口块上累积梯度，近似完整反传；truncated backpropagation 只对最后一段窗口计算 loss，前面的 token 只作为上下文。后者更省显存，也更适合长 rollout 的 RL 训练。
summary.experiments: 给定内容中的关键结果是：Prefix Sliding 在无需训练的情况下可以接近 full attention 的性能，同时推理速度约提升 3 倍；在训练中可支持超过 100,000 token 的 RL rollout。一个具体配置是窗口大小 2048，模型生成 100,000 token 推理轨迹时，训练器只接收最后 8192 token；其中前 6144 token 作为上下文，最后 2048 token 计算 token-level RL loss。作者还提到滑动窗口多层堆叠的理论感受野约为 W×L，但实际由于信息瓶颈更接近 1.5×W，因此用 4×窗口作为反传上下文可获得较准确梯度。附录中比较了 Continue PE 与 Reset PE，以及 truncated backpropagation 与 full attention/full backpropagation；给定内容显示差异较小，但未提供完整表格数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，Introduction 中对长推理成本和中间 token 价值衰减的论证；第二，Prefix Sliding 方法图，尤其是 prefix、sliding window、RoPE 位置处理的设计；第三，训练部分关于 chunked backpropagation 和 truncated backpropagation 的说明。若关心长推理 RL 系统，建议进一步看 Appendix D 和 Appendix E，确认位置编码处理和截断反传是否会在目标模型上带来退化。

summary_en.core_problem: Long test-time reasoning is limited by full-attention KV-cache growth. Once reasoning traces reach tens of thousands of tokens, keeping every intermediate token becomes expensive, while many of those tokens no longer contribute much to the next step.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is the interface between pretraining, inference-time scaling, and RL post-training. Long RLVR rollouts and reasoning-oriented sampling often fail because overlong generations are truncated or discarded. Prefix Sliding offers a training-free approximation: keep the instruction prefix and a recent window, and evict stale intermediate reasoning tokens. This changes the memory bound from growing with the full trace length to depending only on the prefix size and window length, making 100k-token rollouts more practical.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prefix Sliding keeps two regions in attention memory: a fixed prefix and a sliding window of the most recent generated tokens. The prefix contains system instructions, task prompts, tool descriptions, and markers such as <think>; it also serves as an attention sink. The recent window carries the active reasoning state. Older intermediate reasoning tokens are removed from the KV-cache as generation proceeds. For positional embeddings such as RoPE, the paper discusses Reset PE and Continue PE. Continue PE reuses cached representations and avoids reapplying positional embeddings, and the reported appendix results suggest little performance difference, so it is the default. For RL training, the paper proposes chunked backpropagation and truncated backpropagation. Chunked backprop computes gradients over chunks and accumulates them. Truncated backprop only computes loss on the final chunk, using preceding tokens as context.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content reports that Prefix Sliding can match full-attention performance while running about 3× faster without additional training, and that it enables RL rollouts beyond 100,000 tokens. One concrete example uses a sliding window of 2048 for a 100,000-token reasoning trace. The sampler sends only the last 8192 tokens to the trainer; the first 6144 tokens are used as context, and token-level RL loss is applied only to the final 2048 tokens. The paper notes that the theoretical receptive field of a W-window, L-layer stack is W×L, but the effective receptive field is closer to 1.5×W in practice because of bottlenecks. Appendix results are said to show small differences between Continue PE and Reset PE, and comparable performance between truncated backpropagation and full-attention full backpropagation, although detailed tables are not included in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read of 20–30 minutes is enough. Focus on the motivation in the introduction, the method figures explaining the retained prefix and sliding window, and the training section covering chunked versus truncated backpropagation. For long-reasoning RL systems, the most useful parts are the appendices on positional encoding choices and gradient truncation, since these determine whether the method is safe to use with a specific base model.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Test-Time Scaling 的高效 KV-Cache 管理策略，验证了中间推理 token 的可丢弃性，对长上下文推理优化有直接启发，值得一看。
recommendation.en: An efficient KV-Cache management strategy for Test-Time Scaling, validating the discardability of intermediate reasoning tokens. Offers direct insights for long-context inference optimization. Worth a skim.

paper.title: VisCache: Visual KV Cache Pruning for Efficient Vision Large Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: While Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in multimodal reasoning, their long-context inference remains prohibitively expensive due to the massive computation and memory overhead of visual Key-Value (KV) caches. Existing KV compression methods often apply uniform pruning across visual tokens and layers, leading to substantial information loss and degraded performance.To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{VisCache}, a plug-and-play framework for coarse-to

summary.core_problem: 长视频/高分辨率场景下，VLLM 的视觉 token 让 KV cache 体积和注意力计算成本爆炸；现有方法常做“各层/各 token 一刀切”的压缩，忽略视觉冗余的结构性（时间冗余、层间重要性差异、K/V 角色不对称），导致在同等压缩率下掉点明显。论文要解决的是：在不训练、可插拔的前提下，如何更精细地裁剪视觉 KV cache，同时尽量保持视频理解与多模态推理质量。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献不大（主要是推理侧效率），但对“统一多模态 token 进入同一 Transformer 后，哪些 token/哪些层真正需要被保留”给了一个工程上可落地的答案。它把压缩从“数值压缩（量化/低秩）”转向“结构压缩（token/层/键值不对称）”，这类思路会反向影响预训练阶段的设计：例如更强的时间冗余建模、更显式的层级表征分工、以及训练时就对 KV 预算做约束/正则，从而让模型天然更可剪。
summary.technical_approach:
VisCache 是两段式 coarse-to-fine、训练免疫（training-free）的框架。
1）输入侧：用一个轻量 vision-language “scout”模型做 prompt-aware 的关键帧筛选，目标是先砍掉时间冗余，避免无关帧进入主 VLLM 产生大量视觉 token。筛选准则用 Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR)：在“与问题相关”与“帧间多样性”之间做折中，得到一个小而覆盖语义的 keyframe 子集。
2）模型侧：提出 PruneKV，对视觉 KV cache 做“按层分配预算 + K/V 非对称处理”的结构化压缩。
- 层级预算：不是每层同样比例裁剪，而是用抛物线式（parabolic）预算调度：浅层保留更多视觉 token（强调细粒度空间细节），深层逐步减少（更抽象语义，冗余更高），并对超过阈值的视觉 KV 直接逐出。
- K/V 非对称：把 key 视为“路由/检索”更关键，允许丢弃不重要的 key；但 value 承载上下文内容，若直接丢会损信息，因此将被丢弃 key 对应的 value 通过加权聚合（fuse）并入保留 token 的 value，以减少信息硬丢失。
整体上，第一阶段减少进入模型的视觉 token 数量，第二阶段减少生成过程中 KV cache 的增长与带宽压力，两者叠加获得更好的速度-精度折中。
summary.experiments:
论文宣称在多个长视频理解基准上，相比现有 KV 压缩/裁剪基线，在仅保留约 19–28% KV cache 的情况下，最高可达约 2.35× 推理加速，并且在激进压缩下保持更稳定的任务表现。消融结论指向两点：
- 仅做关键帧筛选或仅做 KV 裁剪都不如两段式组合稳定；
- 层级非均匀预算与 K/V 非对称融合是性能保持的关键，否则在同等压缩率下更容易出现推理质量塌陷。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、以及各项指标的逐表数字；精确复现需要对照论文实验表格与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看方法总览图（通常是 Figure 1）理解两段式如何叠加节省：输入 token 数 vs 生成期 KV 增长。
- 重点读 PruneKV 的两处设计：抛物线预算调度的动机与实现细节；K/V 非对称“丢 key、融 value”的具体权重来源与计算开销。
- 看主要实验表：在相同 KV 保留率下与哪些基线比、掉点曲线是否平滑；再看消融表确认每个组件的边际贡献。
- 如果关心对预训练的启发：留意作者对“浅层细节、深层语义”的层间分工假设是否被实验支撑（例如按层裁剪敏感性曲线）。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-video / high-resolution settings, visual tokens dominate sequence length, making VLLM inference bottlenecked by (1) huge visual KV caches (memory + bandwidth) and (2) quadratic attention cost. Prior KV compression often prunes uniformly across layers/tokens, ignoring structured redundancy (temporal relevance, layer-wise importance, and asymmetric roles of keys vs values), which causes avoidable accuracy drops at the same compression ratio. The paper targets a training-free, plug-and-play way to prune visual KV caches more surgically while preserving video reasoning quality.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining recipe contribution. Still, it is useful for foundation-model researchers because it operationalizes a structured view of multimodal redundancy: prompt-dependent temporal filtering, non-uniform layer budgets, and K/V asymmetry. These ideas can feed back into pretraining design (e.g., training-time KV budget regularization, architectures that separate low-level visual detail vs high-level semantics more cleanly, or tokenizers/encoders that reduce temporal redundancy before the LLM).
summary_en.technical_approach:
VisCache is a two-stage coarse-to-fine, training-free framework.
1) Input-stage temporal filtering: a lightweight vision-language “scout” model selects prompt-relevant keyframes before running the main VLLM. Selection uses Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to balance query relevance and diversity, aiming to keep semantic coverage with fewer frames.
2) In-model KV pruning (PruneKV): a layer-aware visual KV compression algorithm.
- Layer-wise budget allocation: instead of uniform pruning, it uses a parabolic schedule—retain more visual tokens in early layers (fine-grained spatial details) and progressively fewer in deeper layers (more abstract semantics), evicting KV entries beyond a truncation threshold.
- Asymmetric K/V handling: keys are treated as routing/indexing signals and can be dropped more aggressively; values carry content, so values corresponding to pruned keys are fused into retained values via weighted aggregation to reduce hard information loss.
The two stages are complementary: fewer visual tokens enter the model, and the remaining visual KV footprint grows more slowly during generation.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports up to ~2.35× inference speedup while keeping only ~19–28% of the KV cache, outperforming prior compression baselines on multiple long-video understanding benchmarks. Ablations indicate (i) combining keyframe filtering + KV pruning is more stable than either alone, and (ii) the parabolic layer budget and asymmetric “drop keys, fuse values” update are important to maintain accuracy under aggressive compression.
Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the exact benchmark list, model sizes, or per-task numeric tables; those details should be taken from the main results tables/appendix in the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the overview figure to understand where savings come from (input token reduction vs KV growth reduction).
- Focus on PruneKV: how the parabolic schedule is defined, and how the value-fusion weights are computed (and their runtime overhead).
- Check the main trade-off tables/curves: accuracy vs KV retention ratio, and comparisons under matched budgets.
- Read the ablation section to see which component contributes most and whether the layer-importance assumption is empirically supported (layer sensitivity curves are especially informative).

recommendation.zh: 针对 VLM 长上下文推理的 KV Cache 压缩方法，抛物线逐层预算分配的思路对优化多模态模型推理效率有一定启发。
recommendation.en: KV Cache compression method for VLM long-context inference; the parabolic layer-wise budget allocation offers insights for optimizing multimodal model inference efficiency.

paper.title: Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policies
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models process long multimodal token sequences, making inference expensive in both memory and computation. Existing efficiency methods mainly reduce visual tokens, but aggressive token pruning becomes fragile because removing a token discards its entire representation. Sub-token compression provides a complementary alternative by retaining more tokens while reducing their value width. However, directly applying sub-token compression to VLA policies is less effective

summary.core_problem: VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在推理时需要处理极长的多模态 token 序列，导致计算和显存开销巨大。现有的 token 剪枝方法过于粗暴，直接丢弃整个视觉 token 会丢失重要的空间和控制信息，导致闭环控制任务性能崩溃。
summary.importance: 提出了一种针对 VLA 模型的细粒度压缩策略，证明了在多模态控制任务中，token 数量和 token 内部的价值表示（value representation）需要解耦处理，为高效 VLA 部署提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing (RoleSub)。核心思想是不直接丢弃 token，而是压缩保留 token 的 value 向量。具体做法：1) 将 value 向量转换到正交空间并分组；2) 引入一个轻量级的 role estimator，根据 token 表示和语言上下文生成软隐式表示；3) 利用该隐式表示动态决定保留哪些 value 分组。这种路由结构与策略网络联合训练，允许模型自主发现对动作预测有用的特征维度。
summary.experiments: 在 OpenVLA-OFT-7B 模型和 LIBERO 评测基准上，RoleSub 在 36 种压缩配置中的 33 种优于同等预算的纯 token 剪枝基线。在极端压缩和长视野任务中优势最明显。结合视觉和语言路由，可将多模态前缀的 KV 缓存压缩至原大小的 9.2%–11.3%，同时保持强劲的控制性能。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中关于 token 剪枝在 VLA 中为何失效的分析，以及 RoleSub 的路由机制设计。实验部分关注不同压缩率下的性能对比，以及视觉和语言 token 在压缩敏感度上的不对称性。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models process extremely long multimodal token sequences during inference, leading to high computational and memory costs. Existing token pruning methods are too aggressive; discarding entire visual tokens loses crucial spatial and control information, causing catastrophic failure in closed-loop control tasks.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a fine-grained compression strategy tailored for VLA models, demonstrating that token quantity and internal value representation must be decoupled in multimodal control tasks. This offers a new perspective for efficient VLA deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing (RoleSub). Instead of dropping tokens entirely, it compresses the value vectors of retained tokens. Specifically: 1) Value vectors are transformed into an orthogonal space and partitioned into groups; 2) A lightweight role estimator generates a soft latent representation based on the token representation and language context; 3) This latent representation dynamically determines which value groups to retain. This routing structure is trained jointly with the policy network, allowing the model to discover feature dimensions useful for action prediction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on OpenVLA-OFT-7B and the LIBERO benchmark. RoleSub outperforms a matched-budget token-only pruning baseline in 33 out of 36 compression configurations, with the most significant gains observed under aggressive compression and in long-horizon tasks. Combining visual and language routing reduces the multimodal prefix KV cache to 9.2%–11.3% of its original size while maintaining strong control performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the analysis of why token pruning fails in VLAs, and the design of the RoleSub routing mechanism. In the experiments, pay attention to the performance comparison under different compression ratios and the asymmetry in compression sensitivity between visual and language tokens.

recommendation.zh: 将 KV-cache 压缩的粒度从 token 级别细化到了 sub-token (channel/group) 级别，并结合了 VLA 模型的模态特性进行动态路由，对多模态大模型的长上下文推理优化有启发。
recommendation.en: Refines the granularity of KV-cache compression from the token level to the sub-token (channel/group) level, and dynamically routes based on the modality characteristics of VLA models, offering insights for long-context inference optimization in multimodal LLMs.

paper.title: MoNe: Modular Neural Memory for Efficient Long Context Inference
paper.abstract: We present MoNe, a lightweight modular neural memory that attaches to any frozen pretrained Transformer to enable long-context inference without retraining. MoNe reads context in fixed-size segments via test-time learning of fast-weight neural memory networks with layer-localized gradient updates; at inference, the memory generates keys and values from the query tokens alone, with no context tokens re-read. This two-phase design decouples inference cost from context length, achieving $O(N)$ prep

summary.core_problem: MoNe 解决的是冻结 Transformer 在超长上下文推理中的成本和泛化问题：不重新训练基座模型，也不把完整上下文作为 prompt 重读，而是把长上下文压入一个可在线更新的神经记忆模块，让查询阶段的计算不随上下文长度增长。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在长上下文建模接口。它给出了一种“冻结基座 + 测试时学习记忆”的路径，试图绕开扩展 RoPE、继续长上下文预训练、训练新型 recurrent/SSM 架构这几类常见方案。对基座研究员有两点启发：第一，长上下文能力不一定只来自预训练时扩大 context window，也可以来自外接可学习状态；第二，记忆模块如何和每层 attention 对齐，是长上下文系统能否复用已有 Transformer 的关键。
summary.technical_approach: MoNe 在每个 Transformer decoder layer 外接一个 fast-weight neural memory，主干参数完全冻结。长上下文先被切成固定长度 segment，文中使用 T=512。读取上下文时，模型逐段处理 segment，并对每层的记忆网络做 layer-localized gradient updates，也就是只更新该层对应的快速权重，不改动 backbone。记忆模块采用按 head 组织的 SwiGLU MLP，而不是简单线性映射，用来提高同等参数量下的关联存储能力。查询阶段，模型不再读取原始上下文 token。query token 经冻结的 Wq 得到 query 表示，再用最终 fast-weight state 生成固定数量的 memory tokens。这些 memory tokens 经过 RMSNorm 和可学习 gate 后，用冻结 backbone 的 Wk/Wv 投到 key/value 空间，并与 query 自身产生的 KV 一起进入 self-attention。这样，预处理阶段是 O(N)，查询阶段对上下文长度近似 O(1)，KV cache 大小也不随 N 增长。相比 RAG，MoNe 不依赖检索出局部相关片段；相比 Mamba、TTT、Titans 这类需要重新训练架构的方案，MoNe 更像是一个可插拔的推理时记忆层。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 MoNe 只增加约 6.4% 参数量。在 128K token 场景下，相比直接 ICL，它将总计算和峰值 GPU 显存都降低约 80%。训练时只见到最长 4K token 的上下文，但在测试时外推到 128K，即 32 倍长度外推。评测覆盖 RULER 中的 S-NIAH、MK-NIAH 和 Frequent Word Extraction。结果显示，当 ICL 超出 backbone 原生上下文窗口后性能明显下降，MoNe 仍能保持较强表现。实验重点不是证明它在所有真实长文档任务上替代 ICL，而是验证固定容量神经记忆在 needle-style 检索和频率统计任务上的长度外推、显存优势和多查询复用能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 RAG、ICL、recurrent 架构的取舍定位，再看 Figure 1/2 理解两阶段流程和成本曲线。方法部分重点看 memory 如何接入每层 attention：segment 读取、fast-weight update、query 生成 memory tokens、再投影成 KV。实验部分建议重点检查三个问题：训练长度到 128K 的外推是否只覆盖合成任务；多查询复用的收益如何计算；6.4% 参数开销和每层记忆容量 T=512 对不同 backbone 是否敏感。若关心长上下文预训练，最值得深挖的是它把“上下文压缩”放在测试时梯度更新里，而不是放在预训练目标或检索器里。

summary_en.core_problem: MoNe addresses the cost and extrapolation problem of long-context inference for frozen Transformers. Instead of retraining the backbone or rereading the full context at query time, it writes the context into an online neural memory and lets the query attend to generated memory tokens.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is not a new pretraining recipe, but a different interface for long-context capability. It offers an alternative to three common routes: extending positional embeddings and continuing long-context pretraining, relying on retrieval, or training a new recurrent/SSM-style architecture. The useful idea for foundation-model research is that long-context behavior can be partly externalized into a layer-aligned test-time state, while keeping the pretrained Transformer unchanged.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoNe attaches a fast-weight neural memory to each decoder layer of a frozen Transformer. The context is split into fixed-size segments, with T=512 in the paper. During the context-reading phase, segments are processed sequentially and each layer updates its own memory through localized gradient updates; backbone weights are never modified. The memory module is a per-head SwiGLU MLP rather than a single linear map, giving it more capacity to store associative structure under a small parameter budget. During generation, the original context tokens are not reread. Query tokens are projected with the frozen Wq, used to read the final fast-weight state, and converted into memory tokens. After RMSNorm and learned head-wise gating, these tokens are projected through the frozen Wk and Wv and concatenated with the query’s normal attention entries. This gives O(N) preprocessing, approximately O(1) query cost with respect to context length, and a KV footprint that does not grow with N. Compared with RAG, it is less tied to locally retrievable chunks. Compared with architectures such as Mamba, TTT, or Titans, it is designed as a plug-in for existing pretrained Transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports about 6.4% parameter overhead. At 128K tokens, MoNe reduces both total compute and peak GPU memory by roughly 80% relative to full in-context learning. It is trained on contexts up to 4K tokens and evaluated up to 128K, a 32x length extrapolation. The main benchmarks are RULER-style tasks, including S-NIAH, MK-NIAH, and Frequent Word Extraction. The reported pattern is that ICL degrades once it goes beyond the model’s native context regime, while MoNe maintains strong accuracy on these synthetic long-context tests. The experiments mainly support the efficiency and extrapolation claims on controlled retrieval/counting tasks, rather than establishing replacement for full attention on broad long-document reasoning workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the introduction and Figures 1–2 to understand the two-phase design and the compute/memory comparison. Then read the method details around how memory is attached to each attention layer: segment reading, fast-weight updates, query-conditioned memory-token generation, and KV projection. In the experiments, check how the 128K extrapolation is measured, whether the tasks require real multi-hop document reasoning, how multi-query reuse is accounted for, and how sensitive the method is to the fixed memory size T=512. The most useful part for long-context pretraining research is the placement of compression in test-time learning rather than in the pretraining objective, tokenizer, or retriever.

recommendation.zh: 一种有趣的 test-time learning 记忆机制，将长上下文压缩为快速权重，O(1) 查询成本的设计对长文本 Serving 优化有启发，值得关注其具体实现和泛化能力。
recommendation.en: An interesting test-time learning memory mechanism that compresses long context into fast weights. The O(1) query cost design is inspiring for long-context serving optimization; worth checking the implementation and generalization.

paper.title: pico-type: A 1.5M-Parameter Byte-Level Multi-Head Content Classifier
paper.abstract: We introduce pico-type, a byte-level multi-head content classifier with approximately 1.5 million parameters that simultaneously predicts seven content properties from raw UTF-8 bytes in a single forward pass. Operating directly at the byte level -- no tokenizer, no subword vocabulary, no pretrained embeddings -- pico-type classifies coarse type (12 classes), modality (8), subtype (24), code language (62), text language (30), file MIME type (90), and risk flags (6-label multi-label: API keys, JW

summary.core_problem: 现有内容分类方案存在明显的能力-效率断层：基于正则的工具轻量但仅支持固定模式，无法泛化到新格式；大模型或ByT5这类字节级模型能力强但参数量过大，无法满足端侧实时（毫秒级）、无外部依赖的多维度内容分类需求，缺乏极小参数量、多头联合、直接处理原始字节的端侧分类器。
summary.importance: 字节级无分词建模的思路，可为预训练tokenizer设计、多语言/混合模态（代码+文本+二进制）语料的快速过滤提供参考。Matryoshka式分层头设计通过一次训练产出多个尺寸模型，可迁移到预训练多任务头、不同量级模型的联合训练场景。共享主干的多头联合分类结构，可用于优化预训练数据清洗流水线——当前这类流水线通常需要独立运行多个分类器分别完成语言检测、内容类型判断、风险过滤，单模型多头的设计能显著降低计算开销。
summary.technical_approach: pico-type直接输入原始UTF-8字节（0-255），无分词、无子词表、无预训练嵌入。架构分为五层：96维可学习字节嵌入，三个卷积核分别为3/5/7的Conv1D块（感受野逐步增大，通道数从96升至192），两层带RoPE（基频500000）的双向自注意力块（4头，头维48，采用标准Pre-norm Transformer结构，带4倍隐藏层MLP），统计池化层（拼接均值、最大值、标准差三种统计量得到576维池化向量），七个Matryoshka式分类头。七个头分别预测粗类型（12类）、模态（8类）、子类型（24类）、代码语言（62类）、文本语言（30类）、MIME类型（90类）、风险标签（6类多标签）。分类头采用门控设计，例如代码语言头仅在粗类型为代码时计算损失，避免无关样本干扰共享主干。Matryoshka分层设计支持四个模型尺寸（tiny:16d、small:64d、base:192d、pro:576d），参数量在1.43M-1.56M之间，所有变体通过一次训练得到，推理时仅加载对应层级的线性层即可。
summary.experiments: 模型参数量约1.5M，FP32精度的ONNX单文件约9MB，CPU上通过ONNX Runtime推理延迟约18ms，支持动态batch和序列长度。七个分类头在单次前向传播中同时输出，覆盖内容类型、语言、风险等多维度分类需求。项目提供CLI、MCP服务器、Rust二进制等多种部署形式，权重和代码以Apache 2.0协议开源。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Model Architecture章节的字节级无分词建模设计、Matryoshka分层头实现逻辑、门控损失机制；Figure 1的架构图和Table 1的分类头定义可快速浏览。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。从事预训练数据清洗工作的研究者，可重点关注共享主干多头分类的设计思路，用于优化数据处理流水线效率。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing content classification solutions have a clear capability-efficiency gap: regex-based tools are lightweight but limited to fixed patterns with no generalization to new formats, while large language models or byte-level models like ByT5 have strong capabilities but are orders of magnitude too large for real-time on-device deployment requiring millisecond latency and no external dependencies. There is a lack of a tiny, multi-head, byte-level classifier that runs entirely on-device and predicts multiple content properties in a single forward pass.
summary_en.importance: The tokenizer-free byte-level modeling design offers reference for pretraining tokenizer research and fast filtering of multilingual/mixed-modality (code, text, binary) corpora. The Matryoshka-style tiered head design, which produces multiple model sizes from a single training run, can be transferred to pretraining multi-task heads and joint training of models at different scales. The shared-trunk multi-head classification structure can optimize pretraining data cleaning pipelines, which typically run multiple separate classifiers for language detection, content type classification, and risk filtering — the single-model multi-head design significantly reduces computational overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: pico-type takes raw UTF-8 bytes (0–255) as input, with no tokenization, subword vocabulary, or pretrained embeddings. Its architecture has five stages: a 96-dimensional learnable byte embedding, three Conv1D blocks with kernel sizes 3, 5, and 7 (increasing receptive fields, channel dimension expanded from 96 to 192 after the first block), two bidirectional self-attention blocks with RoPE (base frequency 500,000, 4 heads of dimension 48, standard pre-norm Transformer structure with 4x hidden dimension MLP), a statistical pooling layer that concatenates mean, max, and standard deviation to produce a 576-dimensional pooled vector, and seven Matryoshka-style classification heads. The seven heads predict coarse type (12 classes), modality (8), subtype (24), code language (62), text language (30), MIME type (90), and risk flags (6-class multi-label). Heads are gated: for example, the code language head only contributes loss when the coarse type is code, preventing irrelevant samples from affecting the shared trunk. The Matryoshka tiering supports four model sizes (tiny: 16d, small: 64d, base: 192d, pro: 576d) with 1.43M–1.56M parameters, all produced from a single training run; only the corresponding tier's linear layers are loaded at inference.
summary_en.experiments: pico-type has ~1.5M parameters, with a 9 MB FP32 ONNX single-file export. It runs in ~18 ms on CPU via ONNX Runtime, supporting dynamic batch and sequence lengths. All seven classification heads run simultaneously in one forward pass, covering content type, language, and risk classification needs. The project releases multiple deployment artifacts including CLI, MCP server, and Rust binary, with weights and code open-sourced under Apache 2.0 license.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Model Architecture section, particularly the tokenizer-free byte-level modeling design, Matryoshka tiered head implementation, and gated loss mechanism. Skim Figure 1 (architecture diagram) and Table 1 (head definitions) for quick reference. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes. For researchers working on pretraining data cleaning, pay special attention to the shared-trunk multi-head classification design for pipeline efficiency optimization.

recommendation.zh: 字节级无tokenizer的轻量多任务分类器可直接嵌入预训练语料清洗pipeline，重点看风险标签召回率与推理速度指标
recommendation.en: The tokenizer-free byte-level lightweight multi-task classifier can be directly plugged into pretraining corpus cleaning pipelines; focus on risk tag recall and inference speed metrics.

paper.title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction
paper.abstract: Efficient LLM serving is often bottlenecked by the need to pad sequences to a fixed maximum length, and this wastes compute and degrades throughput. Predicting output lengths in advance makes it possible to adopt length-aware scheduling, and this reduces the overhead. This advantage is especially pronounced in long-context reasoning and reinforcement learning applications. Existing approaches, such as entropy-guided token pooling, use token-wise entropy as their primary signal, but they tend to

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM输出长度预测方法仅依赖token级熵，忽略语义差异导致重要token权重分配偏差、预测可靠性差，进而引发serving场景下序列padding算力浪费与吞吐量下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量的熵+语义联合token池化框架，复用prefill阶段已有计算结果，提升长度预测精度，优化长上下文推理、RL场景的调度效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ESTP（Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling）框架，直接复用LLM prefill阶段计算得到的自注意力权重生成语义重要性分数，与token熵信号结合完成池化，实现更可靠的输出长度预测。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要截断，未披露完整实验配置、基线模型与量化提升结果，仅提及方法适配长上下文推理、强化学习等对调度开销敏感的场景。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM output length prediction methods rely solely on token-level entropy, ignoring semantic differences which cause misweighting of important tokens and unreliable predictions, leading to padding compute waste and reduced serving throughput.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing a lightweight entropy-semantic joint token pooling framework that reuses existing prefill computation to improve prediction accuracy and reduce scheduling overhead in long-context and RL scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ESTP (Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling), which directly reuses self-attention weights computed during the LLM prefill phase to generate semantic importance scores, combined with entropy signals for more reliable token pooling and length prediction.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup, baseline models, and quantitative gains are not disclosed, with only mentions of applicability to long-context reasoning and RL scenarios sensitive to scheduling overhead.

recommendation.zh: 推理调度侧的小改进，复用prefill注意力权重的思路可参考，仅看方法部分即可，无预训练相关直接insight。
recommendation.en: Minor inference scheduling improvement; the idea of reusing prefill attention weights is worth a quick scan, no direct pretraining insights.

paper.title: Large Models for Small Devices: Recent Advances and Empirical Analysis of Edge AI Deployment
paper.abstract: Running large AI models on resource-constrained edge devices requires model compression to reduce model size and computation. What compresses well, however, need not deploy well. We survey dozens of recent works that report compression results on real hardware and extract practical deployment guidelines from them. Following these guidelines, we deploy compact language and image models on GPU, CPU, and Raspberry Pi platforms across question answering and image segmentation. No single technique wi

summary.core_problem: 大模型边缘部署中，压缩效果（参数/MACs减少）与实际部署性能（延迟、文件大小、精度）不一致，缺乏基于真实硬件的实用部署指南。
summary.importance: 实证分析结合工程洞察，整合数十篇真实硬件压缩工作的结论，通过跨平台实证给出任务特定的部署指南，揭示压缩与部署的不一致性。
summary.technical_approach: 系统梳理现有模型压缩（量化、剪枝等）工作的真实硬件部署结果，提炼实用指南后在QA和图像分割任务上跨GPU/CPU/树莓派验证，对比不同压缩技术的实际部署表现。
summary.experiments: QA任务上，Qwen3.5 0.8B经Q5_K_M GGUF量化达SQuAD 93.85 F1/92 EM，同精度1%比例结构化剪枝损失16 F1；分割任务上剪枝可缩模型近80%且mIoU近不变，量化无参数/MACs收益；剪枝可能破坏k-quant超块对齐导致部署文件增大21-49%。

summary_en.core_problem: Compression metrics (parameter/MAC reduction) for edge deployment of large models often mismatch real-world deployment performance (latency, artifact size, accuracy), and there is a lack of practical guidelines grounded in real hardware.
summary_en.importance: Empirical analysis with engineering insights; synthesizes findings from dozens of real-hardware compression works, validates task-specific deployment guidelines across GPU/CPU/Raspberry Pi, and reveals inconsistencies between compression and deployment outcomes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematically reviews real-hardware deployment results of existing compression techniques (quantization, pruning, etc.), extracts practical guidelines, and conducts cross-platform validation on question answering and image segmentation tasks to compare real deployment performance of different compression methods.
summary_en.experiments: For QA, Qwen3.5 0.8B with Q5_K_M GGUF quantization achieves 93.85 SQuAD F1 and 92 EM, while structured pruning at the same precision (1% ratio) incurs 16 F1 loss; for segmentation, pruning reduces model size by ~80% with near-constant mIoU while quantization yields no parameter/MAC gains; pruning can break k-quant super-block alignment and inflate deployed artifact size by 21-49%.

recommendation.zh: 压缩指标≠部署性能的实证结果可作为量化感知预训练的约束，重点看任务-压缩方法匹配的实验表格即可。
recommendation.en: The empirical finding that compression metrics ≠ deployment performance can serve as constraints for quantization-aware pretraining; focus on the task-compression method matching tables.

paper.title: APEX: Adaptive Expert Prefetching for Memory-Efficient Edge MoE Inference
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are attractive for edge deployment because they provide high model capacity while activating only a small subset of parameters per token, improving compute efficiency. However, MoE inference at the edge is fundamentally limited by memory. Expert parameters are large and often reside in off-chip memory due to capacity, cost, and power constraints, putting expert loading to the critical path. We present APEX: Adaptive Expert Prefetching, a predictive resource manage

summary.core_problem: 边缘部署 MoE 时，专家权重放在片外 LPDDR，逐 token 动态加载专家成为延迟与能耗瓶颈；固定 top-k 预取对路由不确定性缺乏自适应，少量漏取就会造成停顿。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，属于推理系统侧工作；但对 MoE 架构设计有间接价值：它量化了路由可预测性、专家加载延迟与 EDP 之间的关系，提示在边缘 MoE 模型设计时应把路由稳定性和专家局部性纳入考量。
summary.technical_approach: APEX 在 attention 块之前插入一个轻量 prefetch router，提前预测当前层候选专家；不固定预取 top-k，而是按 token 用学到的置信度模型动态决定额外预取 δ̂(x) 个专家，即预取 top-(k+δ̂(x))。提供两种模式：correctness-preserving 模式保证最终路由语义不变，漏取的专家仍会同步加载；stall-free 模式在可接受精度损失时直接用已到专家执行，消除残余停顿。
summary.experiments: 在 Granite-3.1-1B-A400M、Granite-3.1-3B-A800M、Phi-mini-MoE-7B-A2.4B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite-16B-A2.4B 上评估，模拟专家权重驻留 LPDDR5X、经 PCIe 6.0 x16 传输的边缘配置。单 token 生成中专家加载占 Granite-3.1-3B-A800M 延迟的 43%、能耗的 29%。APEX 实现 >99% 的专家加载重叠率，端到端 EDP 相比已有预取基线最高改善 41%；stall-free 变体再带来 2–14% EDP 改善，应用精度影响可忽略。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，约 15 分钟。重点看 Section III 的内存层次建模和 Section IV 的置信度驱动 δ̂(x) 设计；Figure 1 对理解专家加载为何落在关键路径上很有帮助。若不做边缘 MoE serving，可跳过具体时序/能耗参数表。

summary_en.core_problem: When MoE models are deployed at the edge, expert weights live in off-chip LPDDR and dynamic expert loading sits on the critical path; fixed top-k prefetching cannot adapt to routing uncertainty, so even a small miss rate causes stalls.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining contribution. Its indirect value for pretraining is that it quantifies how routing predictability and expert locality translate into edge latency and energy, suggesting that routing stability should be considered when designing MoE models for edge deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: APEX inserts a lightweight prefetch router before the attention block to predict candidate experts for the current layer. Instead of always prefetching top-k, it uses a learned per-token confidence model to decide an additional budget δ̂(x), prefetching top-(k+δ̂(x)). Two modes are provided: a correctness-preserving mode that still synchronously loads any missed expert to preserve exact routing semantics, and an optional stall-free mode that executes with available experts when a small accuracy trade-off is acceptable.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Granite-3.1-1B-A400M, Granite-3.1-3B-A800M, Phi-mini-MoE-7B-A2.4B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite-16B-A2.4B under an edge setup where experts reside in LPDDR5X and stream over PCIe 6.0 x16. For Granite-3.1-3B-A800M single-token generation, expert loading accounts for 43% of latency and 29% of energy. APEX achieves >99% expert-load overlap and up to 41% end-to-end EDP improvement over prior prefetching baselines; the stall-free variant adds another 2–14% EDP improvement with negligible accuracy impact.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15 minutes. Focus on Section III for the memory-hierarchy model and Section IV for the confidence-driven δ̂(x) design; Figure 1 clearly shows why expert loading ends up on the critical path. The detailed timing and energy tables can be skipped unless you work on edge MoE serving.

recommendation.zh: 重点看§3.2的预取路由器设计，MoE预训练时可约束路由的时间局部性，降低推理时的专家加载开销。
recommendation.en: Focus on §3.2 for prefetch router design; constrain routing temporal locality during MoE pretraining to reduce inference expert loading overhead.

paper.title: SpecRoll: Fast-Slow Verifier-Feedback Adaptation for Speculative Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but autoregressive rollout generation remains a major efficiency bottleneck. Speculative decoding can accelerate generation, yet applying it during RL is difficult because the target policy continually evolves: static proposers become stale, while frequent drafter updates add substantial overhead. We introduce SpecRoll, a speculative rollout engine that preserves the target model's sampling di

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RL post-training 里一个很具体但很关键的瓶颈：GRPO 这类 group-based RL 需要反复生成长 rollout，而 rollout 生成仍是逐 token 的主耗时。把 speculative decoding 直接搬到 RL 里并不顺，因为 target policy 在训练中持续漂移，静态 drafter 很快过时；如果像 FastGRPO 那样在线训练一个独立 drafter，又会引入额外反向传播、优化器状态、同步和 KV cache 成本。论文要解决的核心问题，是在不改变目标采样分布、不过多增加训练系统复杂度的前提下，让 speculative rollout 能适应 RL 中的非平稳策略，并在 wall-clock 上稳定提速。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain objective，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口很有参考价值，尤其是大模型后训练阶段的系统效率问题。它的重要性主要有三点。第一，它把“精确 speculative decoding”从静态推理场景推进到在线变化的 RL rollout 场景，说明 rollout engine 也可以作为训练算法的一部分被设计。第二，它提出了两时间尺度适应：局部、无梯度、轨迹内修正处理短期失配；慢速参数更新处理持续漂移。这种分层适应思路，对持续预训练、mid-training、online data selection 也有启发。第三，它避免了单独训练一个 autoregressive drafter，而是用 target hidden state 上的 lightweight future-token heads 做 proposal，这在工程上更轻，也更接近“在主模型内部长出辅助预测头”的路线。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个 exact speculative rollout engine，名字叫 SpecRoll。它由四个部件组成。

第一，proposal family 不是独立 drafter，而是挂在 target backbone hidden state 上的多 horizon future-token heads，形式上接近 MEDUSA。给定前缀 x_{<=t}，target 先精确采样一个 anchor token x_{t+1}，然后多个 head 并行预测后续若干位置的 token，复用 target 的词表投影矩阵 W。这些候选组成一个 prefix-closed sparse tree。这样做的好处是省掉第二个 AR backbone 和对应 KV cache，proposal 成本更低，也减少了 target/drafter 失配来源。

第二，verification 是 exact 的，而且是 concurrency-aware 的。RL rollout 里同时活跃的样本数会随着部分样本提前结束而下降，因此固定大小的 speculative tree 在高并发阶段可能浪费验证算力，在低并发阶段又吃不满硬件。SpecRoll 会根据当前 active concurrency 动态调整 sparse tree 的预算：并发高时保守，减少额外验证负担；并发下降后扩大 tree，换取更高 accepted progress。论文的出发点不是单纯提高单条序列 acceptance，而是优化整个 GRPO rollout 阶段的吞吐。

第三，快路径是 Reflex。它利用“延迟 verifier 反馈在同一轨迹邻近位置上仍有预测性”这一观察，对 proposal hidden state 做 bounded、trajectory-local、gradient-free correction。这里的关键不是学习一个新模型，而是把已经成熟的 verifier error 当作局部校正信号，在不反传的情况下修正后续 proposal。为了避免误修正，作者加了 conservative alignment gate：只有当过去误差对未来仍有可预测性时才启用；同时还有 candidate-boundary safeguard，防止在候选边界附近做有害干预。这个设计试图区分 transient local mismatch 和 persistent drift：前者不值得动参数，局部修一下就够；后者才交给慢路径。

第四，慢路径只在 sustained degradation 被检测到时，才更新 future-token heads 的参数。也就是说，SpecRoll 不把所有失配都转成在线学习问题，而是先用 Reflex 吃掉短期、局部、轨迹内的偏差，把真正跨轨迹持续存在的 proposal 退化留给参数更新。这一点和 FastGRPO 的持续在线训练独立 drafter 不同，后者把适应主要放在参数层，代价更高，也不区分误差类型。

从训练目标上，SpecRoll 始终保持 exact target verification 为最终裁决，因此 committed token 的分布不变，GRPO 的 reward、advantage 和优化目标都不被改写。它优化的是 rollout 生成过程，而不是 RL objective 本身。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个模型、参数规模从 1.5B 到 14B，3 个数学推理数据集，共 15 个 model-dataset 组合。主结果是：相对 vanilla GRPO，generation speedup 达到 1.26× 到 2.15×，end-to-end speedup 达到 1.21× 到 2.04×。和 FastGRPO 做 matched setting 对比时，SpecRoll 在全部 15 个组合上 generation 和 end-to-end 时间都更好，平均 pairwise end-to-end gain 为 1.18×。

这些数字说明两件事。第一，收益不只是 token generation microbenchmark 上的局部加速，而是能传导到完整 RL 训练回路。第二，轻量 proposal + 两时间尺度适应，至少在作者测试的规模和任务上，比“单独维护一个在线 drafter”更划算。

消融部分的关键信息是：快路径和慢路径都各自有贡献，组合时效果最好。也就是说，Reflex 并不是一个可有可无的小修补；它确实能吸收一部分短期失配。反过来，只有 Reflex 也不够，因为 policy drift 会跨轨迹累积，最终仍需要慢速参数更新。另一个值得注意的点是 concurrency-aware tree budget 的作用，它解释了为什么同样是 speculative decoding，在 RL rollout 里不能直接照搬固定树结构的推理配置。

从论文给出的结果看，作者更强调 wall-clock 和 end-to-end efficiency，而不是 reward 或 final accuracy 的显著变化。这是合理的，因为 exact verification 保证了采样分布不变，理论上训练信号应保持一致，主要差异体现在吞吐和系统开销上。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但如果你做 RL 系统或 post-training infra，方法部分值得认真看。

建议先看 Introduction，抓住它和 FastGRPO 的分歧：不是再训练一个更聪明的 drafter，而是把适应拆成局部无梯度修正和低频参数更新。然后重点看 Figure 2 和 Method 里 proposal engine 的定义，理解 future-token heads、anchor token、sparse tree、exact verification 之间的关系。

接着看 Reflex 相关章节，重点不是公式细节，而是三个判断：为什么 verifier 的延迟误差在邻近位置仍可用；alignment gate 如何决定何时修正；candidate-boundary safeguard 为什么必要。这里最值得深挖的是，它其实在利用 rollout 轨迹内部的短程误差相关性，这和很多训练系统只做全局平均统计不同。

实验部分优先看主表和 ablation。主表看三件事：对 vanilla GRPO 的 generation/end-to-end 提升、对 FastGRPO 的 pairwise 优势、不同模型规模下收益是否稳定。消融则看 fast path、slow path、concurrency-aware budget 分别拿掉后的退化幅度。

如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要贡献；如果要复现或迁移到自家 RL 系统，Reflex 触发条件、慢路径更新频率、tree budget 调度策略需要细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in RL post-training: GRPO-style training needs many long rollouts, and autoregressive generation dominates wall-clock time. Speculative decoding is a natural acceleration tool, but RL makes it harder because the target policy keeps changing. A static proposer quickly becomes stale, while continuously training a separate drafter adds backward passes, optimizer state, synchronization overhead, and extra KV-cache cost. The core problem is how to make speculative rollouts adapt to a non-stationary policy while preserving the exact target sampling distribution and keeping the system lightweight.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface and for large-scale training systems. Its contribution is important in three ways. First, it extends exact speculative decoding from static inference into online RL rollouts, treating the rollout engine itself as part of the training algorithm. Second, it introduces a two-timescale adaptation scheme: local, gradient-free, within-trajectory correction for transient mismatch, and slower parameter updates for persistent drift. That separation is relevant beyond RL, including continual pretraining and other non-stationary training loops. Third, it avoids a standalone autoregressive drafter and instead uses lightweight future-token heads on top of the target hidden states, which is a cleaner and cheaper design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SpecRoll is an exact speculative rollout engine built from four main pieces.

First, the proposer is not a separate drafter model. It uses MEDUSA-style future-token heads attached to the target backbone hidden state. Given a prefix, the target model samples an exact anchor token x_{t+1}, and multiple horizon heads predict later positions in parallel, reusing the target vocabulary projection. These candidates form a prefix-closed sparse tree. This removes the need for a second autoregressive backbone and its KV cache, reducing proposal cost and simplifying synchronization.

Second, verification remains exact and is made concurrency-aware. In GRPO, the number of active rollouts changes over time because some responses finish earlier than others. A fixed speculative tree is therefore inefficient: too expensive when concurrency is high, and too small to saturate hardware when concurrency drops. SpecRoll adjusts the sparse-tree budget based on active concurrency, using a smaller budget early and a larger one later. The objective is not just better acceptance on a single sequence, but better throughput for the whole rollout stage.

Third, the fast adaptation path is Reflex. The key observation is that delayed verifier errors can still be predictive for nearby future positions within the same trajectory. Reflex converts such mature verifier feedback into bounded, trajectory-local hidden-state corrections without backpropagation. It is guarded by a conservative alignment gate, which activates only when past errors are predictive of future mismatch, and by candidate-boundary safeguards that suppress harmful interventions near unstable boundaries. The design explicitly separates transient local mismatch from persistent drift.

Fourth, the slow path updates the future-token heads only when sustained degradation is detected. In other words, SpecRoll does not treat every mismatch as an online learning problem. It first uses Reflex to absorb short-lived, local errors, and only escalates recurring cross-trajectory mismatch into parameter updates. This differs from FastGRPO, where adaptation relies more heavily on continuously training a separate drafter.

Throughout the method, exact target verification is authoritative. The committed-token distribution is unchanged, so rewards, advantages, and the GRPO objective remain intact. The method changes rollout efficiency, not the RL objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers five models from 1.5B to 14B parameters and three math reasoning datasets, for 15 matched model-dataset settings. Against vanilla GRPO, SpecRoll reports 1.26x to 2.15x generation speedup and 1.21x to 2.04x end-to-end speedup. Against FastGRPO, it is better on both generation time and end-to-end time in all 15 matched settings, with an average pairwise end-to-end gain of 1.18x.

These results matter for two reasons. First, the gains are not limited to token-generation microbenchmarks; they carry through to the full RL training loop. Second, the combination of lightweight proposal heads and two-timescale adaptation appears more cost-effective than maintaining a separately trained online drafter, at least in the tested regime.

The ablations show that both the fast path and the slow path help individually, and the combination works best. That means Reflex is not a cosmetic add-on; it absorbs a meaningful portion of transient mismatch. At the same time, Reflex alone is insufficient because policy drift accumulates across trajectories, so slow parameter updates are still needed. Another useful finding is the role of the concurrency-aware tree budget, which explains why speculative decoding settings from ordinary inference do not transfer directly to RL rollouts.

The paper focuses on wall-clock and end-to-end efficiency rather than final reward improvements, which is consistent with the exact-verification design: the training signal should remain unchanged, while throughput improves.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper overall, but it is worth a closer read if you work on RL systems or post-training infrastructure.

Start with the introduction and isolate the main design choice relative to FastGRPO: instead of training a better standalone drafter, SpecRoll splits adaptation into local gradient-free correction and infrequent parameter updates. Then read Figure 2 and the method section around the proposal engine to understand the interaction among future-token heads, the anchor token, the sparse tree, and exact verification.

Next, focus on the Reflex section. The main questions are not the algebra but the mechanism: why delayed verifier errors remain useful locally, how the alignment gate decides when to intervene, and why candidate-boundary safeguards are necessary. The interesting systems idea is that the method exploits short-range error correlation inside a rollout trajectory.

In the experiments, prioritize the main timing table and the ablations. Check three things in the main results: gains over vanilla GRPO, pairwise wins over FastGRPO, and stability across model scales. In the ablations, look at what happens when the fast path, slow path, or concurrency-aware budget is removed.

If time is limited, 25 to 35 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. For implementation or reproduction, the most important details are the Reflex trigger conditions, the slow-path update schedule, and the tree-budget policy.

recommendation.zh: RL训练rollout加速的实用方案，重点看Reflex模块的无反向传播隐状态修正设计，可直接复现到内部RLHF pipeline
recommendation.en: Practical scheme for RL training rollout acceleration; focus on backprop-free hidden state correction in the Reflex module, directly reproducible for internal RLHF pipelines

paper.title: HiSC: Hierarchical Spatial Clustering Token Compression for Efficient 3D Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) enable spatial reasoning over multi-view scenes but suffer from substantial token redundancy due to duplicated observations and large uninformative regions, leading to high computational cost. Although visual token compression has shown promise in accelerating 2D VLMs, it fails to capture the structured nature of 3D scenes and leads to incomplete spatial coverage and loss of fine-grained details. In this paper, we propose \textbf{HiSC}, a training-free framewo

summary.core_problem: 3D VLM 在多视角场景理解中会产生大量重复或无信息视觉 token，导致推理计算开销高；直接套用 2D VLM 的 token compression 又容易破坏空间覆盖和细粒度细节。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的 3D VLM token 压缩方法。它不涉及 LLM 预训练，但对多模态长上下文推理、视觉 token 冗余处理和几何约束压缩有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: HiSC 将 token-level selection 提升为 cluster-level processing。方法用几何和语义线索把多视角 token 组织为空间聚类；其中 SGraM 将跨视角冗余建模为空间图连通性，并合并物理一致区域，以减少重复 token，同时保留场景覆盖。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 3D VLM、场景数据集、压缩率、速度提升或精度变化。应重点查看压缩比例与 3D 空间问答/理解性能之间的 trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: 3D VLMs incur heavy inference cost because multi-view scenes contain duplicated observations and large uninformative regions, while 2D token-compression methods can lose spatial coverage and fine details.
summary_en.importance: The work proposes a training-free token-compression framework for 3D VLMs. It is not a pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to efficient multimodal inference and to how visual token redundancy should be handled when geometry is available.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiSC moves from token-level selection to cluster-level processing. It groups tokens into spatially grounded clusters using geometric and semantic cues. Its SGraM strategy models cross-view redundancy as spatial graph connectivity and merges physically consistent regions to reduce duplicated tokens while preserving coverage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the 3D VLM backbones, datasets, compression ratios, latency gains, or accuracy deltas. The key evidence to inspect is the compression-performance trade-off on 3D scene understanding tasks.

recommendation.zh: 只看压缩率-精度曲线和消融；几何约束 token 合并有用，但 3D 场景结论别外推到通用 VLM。
recommendation.en: Read only the compression-accuracy curves and ablations; geometry-aware merging is useful, but do not overgeneralize 3D-scene results to general VLMs.

paper.title: SlimVLM: Sensitivity-aware Dynamic Structured Pruning with Adaptive Visual Token Selection for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in processing and understanding both text and images, their large parameter sizes lead to significant computational overhead, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices. While pruning has been effective for compressing Large Language Models (LLMs), directly applying it to VLMs leads to significant performance drops, largely due to redundant visual tokens interfering with importance estimation. To this end

summary.core_problem: 直接将 LLM 结构化剪枝方法应用于视觉语言模型（VLM）时，大量冗余视觉 token 会干扰模块重要性评估，导致剪枝决策次优、性能显著下降；现有 VLM 压缩工作主要聚焦视觉 token 剪枝，对语言模型参数本身的压缩缺乏适配多模态输入的有效方案。
summary.importance: 明确了 VLM 剪枝与纯文本 LLM 剪枝的核心差异来源——视觉 token 冗余对重要性估计的干扰，提出的视觉 token 选择策略可即插即用迁移到其他剪枝框架；对多模态基座的部署侧压缩、以及预训练后稀疏化都有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SlimVLM 结构化剪枝框架，包含两个核心设计：1) 自适应视觉 token 选择：在剪枝前，利用解码器每层中 text-to-visual 注意力的平均得分评估视觉 token 重要性，过滤低得分的冗余视觉 token；得到的 token 掩码仅用于模块重要性估计阶段，不影响最终推理。2) 敏感度感知的动态剪枝率调整：以剪枝前后模块输出的 Pearson 相关系数作为线性近似误差指标，根据每个模块的稀疏容忍度动态调整注意力头和 MLP 通道的剪枝率；注意力头选择保留与原输出 Pearson 相关度最高的组合，并适配 Multi-Head Attention 和 Grouped-Query Attention 两种结构；通道重要性在输出特征空间中定义，同时考虑权值的幅值和方向一致性。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaVA-1.5 等 VLM 上验证：相同剪枝率下性能优于现有结构化剪枝方法；20% 剪枝率下接近原始精度，在推理速度与精度的权衡曲线上表现出明显优势；视觉 token 选择模块可无缝集成到其他剪枝框架，显著提升其剪枝效率和性能保留。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中关于「视觉 token 冗余干扰重要性估计」的问题分析，以及方法部分的两个核心模块：text-to-visual 注意力驱动的 token 选择、基于 Pearson 相关的敏感度感知剪枝率调整。实验部分重点看 20% 剪枝率下的保留精度和与其他方法的对比曲线。泛读，预计 30-45 分钟，适合做 VLM 部署压缩的工程参考。

summary_en.core_problem: When LLM structured pruning methods are directly applied to Vision-Language Models (VLMs), a large number of redundant visual tokens interfere with module importance estimation, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions and significant performance degradation. Existing VLM compression work mainly focuses on visual-token pruning, and lacks effective solutions for compressing the language model parameters themselves while accounting for multimodal inputs.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies the core difference between VLM pruning and pure-text LLM pruning — the distortion of importance estimation caused by redundant visual tokens. The proposed visual-token selection strategy is pluggable into other pruning frameworks. It offers practical engineering reference for deployment-side compression and post-pretraining sparsification of multimodal foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SlimVLM is a structured pruning framework with two core designs: (1) Adaptive visual-token selection: before pruning, the average text-to-visual attention score in each decoder layer is used to rank visual token importance, and low-scoring redundant tokens are filtered. The resulting token mask is only used during module importance estimation, and does not affect final inference. (2) Sensitivity-aware dynamic pruning ratio adjustment: the Pearson correlation between module outputs before and after pruning is used as the linear approximation error metric. Pruning ratios for attention heads and MLP channels are dynamically adjusted per module according to its sparsity tolerance. Attention heads are selected to maximize Pearson correlation with the original output, and the strategy is adapted to both Multi-Head Attention and Grouped-Query Attention. Channel importance is defined in the output feature space, considering both weight magnitude and directional consistency.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on VLMs including LLaVA-1.5: SlimVLM outperforms existing structured pruning methods at the same pruning ratio. Under 20% pruning it retains near-original accuracy, and shows clear advantages on the inference-speed vs accuracy trade-off curve. The visual-token selection module can be seamlessly integrated into other pruning frameworks, substantially improving their pruning efficiency and performance retention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the introduction's problem analysis of how redundant visual tokens distort importance estimation, then the two core method modules: text-to-visual attention driven token selection, and sensitivity-aware pruning ratio adjustment based on Pearson correlation. In experiments, pay attention to accuracy retention at 20% pruning and the comparison curves against other methods. Skim-level reading, 30-45 minutes. Suitable as engineering reference for VLM deployment compression.

recommendation.zh: 针对VLM的剪枝工作，核心insight是利用cross-attention分数先剔除冗余视觉token再做剪枝，对做VLM压缩的工程师有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Pruning work for VLMs; the core insight is using cross-attention scores to prune redundant visual tokens before model pruning, valuable for engineers working on VLM compression.

paper.title: Adaptive Two-Stage Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Inference in Video-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models excel at image and video understanding but suffer from high inference latency due to the need to process thousands of tokens per image, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices and in real-time surveillance applications. This challenge is further amplified in video processing, where multiple frames must be analyzed simultaneously. Existing token reduction techniques are largely developed for single-image inputs and therefore fail to account for the te

summary.core_problem: 降低视频语言模型推理时大量视觉 token 带来的延迟和算力开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法，关注视频输入中的时间冗余和样本间冗余差异；对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对长视频 VLM serving 和 token budget 设计有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两阶段自适应视觉 token pruning。核心思想是先利用视频帧间冗余进行粗粒度裁剪，再按内容复杂度动态决定保留比例，避免单图方法常见的固定 pruning ratio。摘要未完整披露两阶段的具体打分函数和裁剪准则。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型参数量、视频数据集、baseline 名称或延迟/精度数值；仅说明目标是在视频语言模型推理中减少 token 数，同时保留关键信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets inference latency in video-language models caused by processing thousands of visual tokens per video.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It focuses on temporal redundancy and input-dependent redundancy in videos; it is not a direct pretraining result, but it is relevant for long-video VLM serving and token-budget design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a two-stage adaptive visual-token pruning strategy. The main idea is to exploit inter-frame redundancy and then choose content-dependent pruning levels instead of applying a fixed pruning ratio inherited from image-based methods. The supplied abstract does not expose the full scoring or pruning formulation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, datasets, baseline names, or latency/accuracy numbers; it frames the evaluation around reducing visual tokens while preserving video-language understanding performance.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融表即可；若没有按视频复杂度分桶的精度-延迟曲线，结论只能当 serving heuristic。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; without accuracy-latency curves bucketed by video complexity, treat it as a serving heuristic.

paper.title: Allocation Before Ranking: Decoupled Token Compression for OmniLLMs
paper.abstract: Token compression in OmniLLMs is typically posed as a single saliency-ranking problem: score each multimodal token, keep the top-K. We argue this abstraction is mis-specified. The same attention score simultaneously decides two things: how much retained capacity each modality receives, and which tokens within a modality are kept. A shared top-K rule therefore inherits this audio-favoring allocation prior, spending retained capacity on audio before video tokens have a chance to compete. We propos

summary.core_problem: 现有共享解码器OmniLLM的token压缩普遍采用全局top-K显著性排序，将跨模态容量分配、模态内token选择两个独立决策耦合在同一个注意力分数中。共享注意力本身存在稳定的音频偏好先验，会隐式挤占视频token的保留配额，导致压缩后的精度与效率平衡不佳。
summary.importance: 它揭示了共享解码器OmniLLM的注意力存在结构性跨模态分配偏差——这一偏差来自架构设计本身，而非训练数据或策略。对统一多模态预训练的架构设计、模态容量平衡机制，以及推理侧的token压缩优化都有参考价值。无需训练的特性也使其可直接用于现有OmniLLM的部署优化。
summary.technical_approach:
Macer是一种无需训练的推理侧token压缩方法，核心遵循「先分配，后排序」的原则：
1. 先显式为音频和视频分配各自的保留配额，不再由原始共享注意力的质量隐式决定容量分配；
2. 在每个模态内部，用模态归一化后的注意力分数排序选token，不做跨模态混排；
3. 由于音频显著性在解码器浅层更早稳定，视频显著性稍晚才稳定，因此在模态特定的浅层读取注意力分数，无需等到深层。
此外，在视频配额内加入了一个轻量的时间覆盖约束，避免保留的视频token在时间上过度集中。
整个方法不需要训练、不需要修改模型，也不需要额外前向传播。
summary.experiments: 在三个共享解码器OmniLLM骨干（Qwen2.5-Omni-7B、Qwen2.5-Omni-3B、OmniVinci-9B）上验证，覆盖音频grounding、音视频联合、视觉主导、视频中心四类任务。25% token保留率下，Qwen2.5-Omni-7B可保留全token性能的98.7%，对比基线OmniZip的91.6%；3B版本可保留97.3%，OmniZip为95.5%。在OmniVinci-9B上，相比共享top-K排序最高提升12.9个点。所有测试保留率下的综合性能，均优于对比的token剪枝基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分的三个核心观察，这是方法的核心动机，比方法本身更具启发性。然后看方法部分中注意力分解为跨模态分配项和模态内残差项的数学推导，理解全局top-K排序天然存在耦合问题的原因。实验部分只需看主结果表和跨模型迁移性结果即可。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing token compression methods for shared-decoder omnimodal LLMs (OmniLLMs) frame compression as a single global top-K saliency ranking problem, coupling two distinct decisions — cross-modal capacity allocation and within-modality token selection — into one attention score. Shared attention has a persistent audio-favoring prior that implicitly consumes most of the retention budget before video tokens can compete, leading to a poor accuracy-efficiency tradeoff under compression.
summary_en.importance: It identifies a structural cross-modal allocation bias in shared-decoder OmniLLM attention that arises from architecture design, not training data or strategies. This finding informs multimodal pretraining architecture design, cross-modal capacity balancing mechanisms, and inference-side token compression optimization. The training-free property makes it directly applicable to existing OmniLLM deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Macer is a training-free inference-time token compressor built on the allocation-before-selection principle:
1. It first explicitly assigns separate retention budgets for audio and video tokens, removing implicit budget allocation from raw shared attention mass.
2. It ranks tokens only within each modality using modality-normalized attention scores, instead of cross-modal mixed ranking.
3. It reads saliency scores at modality-specific shallow layers, since audio saliency stabilizes earlier than video saliency in the decoder.
A lightweight temporal coverage term is applied only within the video budget to avoid temporal over-concentration of retained video tokens.
The method requires no training, no model modification, and no extra forward pass.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three shared-decoder OmniLLM backbones (Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, Qwen2.5-Omni-3B, OmniVinci-9B) across four task categories: audio-grounded, audio-video joint, visual-dominant, and video-centric. At 25% token retention, Macer preserves 98.7% of full-token accuracy on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B (vs. 91.6% for OmniZip) and 97.3% on the 3B variant (vs. 95.5% for OmniZip). On OmniVinci-9B, it outperforms shared top-K ranking by up to 12.9 points. It achieves the best aggregate performance among compared token pruning baselines at every tested retention ratio.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the three motivating observations in the Introduction — they capture the core insight behind the method. Then review the mathematical decomposition of attention into cross-modal allocation and within-modality residual terms in the method section, which explains why global top-K ranking is fundamentally mis-specified for OmniLLMs. Skim the main result tables and cross-model transfer results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 token 压缩的一个干净 insight：统一 top-K 隐含模态间不公平分配。看 §3 方法和 Table 2 性能保留曲线即可。
recommendation.en: A clean insight on multimodal token compression: unified top-K implicitly biases cross-modality allocation. Read §3 method and Table 2 performance-retention curves.

paper.title: xPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its p

summary.core_problem: 块扩散草稿模型（如dFlash）可单次前向生成整块草稿token，但各位置从边缘分布独立采样，缺乏因果依赖，导致草稿局部token合理但联合概率低，会被左到右的目标模型提前拒绝，直接限制推测解码的接受长度与端到端吞吐。
summary.importance: 为扩散式推测解码的核心缺陷提供了低开销解决方案，在保留并行草稿生成优势的前提下稳定提升接受率，对大模型推理效率优化有直接工程参考价值，也为离散扩散模型的因果性注入提供了通用思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出xPress轻量因果修正框架，核心设计有两点：一是保留原扩散草稿模型的并行块生成能力，新增低秩因果修正头，将token嵌入和草稿隐藏状态投影到低秩空间，用严格下三角线性混合器聚合前驱位置信息，输出逐位置logit加性偏置完成修正；二是用Jacobi迭代并行求解修正过程的因果依赖，仅需远小于块长B的K次并行迭代即可逼近串行自回归修正的不动点，避免重新引入串行解码开销。
summary.experiments: 以Qwen3-8B为目标模型、dFlash为基础草稿模型，在7个数学、代码、对话基准上测试：贪心解码下接受长度提升18%-56%，T=1采样下提升19%-58%，端到端解码吞吐获得一致增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节的Jacobi并行修正推导逻辑、第4节的实验对比与消融（尤其是块长B和迭代次数K的权衡），预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Block diffusion drafters (e.g., dFlash) generate an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, but sample each position independently from marginal distributions without causal dependencies. This produces drafts with locally plausible tokens but low joint probability under the target model's left-to-right distribution, leading to early rejection, limited acceptance length, and suboptimal end-to-end throughput for speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: Provides a low-overhead fix for the core limitation of diffusion-based speculative decoding, preserving parallel drafting while improving acceptance rates. It offers direct engineering value for inference efficiency optimization, and a generalizable approach to injecting causality into discrete diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: xPress is a lightweight causal refinement framework with two key designs: 1) It keeps the original diffusion drafter's parallel block proposal intact, and adds a low-rank causal refinement head that projects token embeddings and drafter hidden states into a low-rank space, uses a strictly lower-triangular linear mixer to aggregate predecessor information, and outputs per-position additive biases for the drafter's logits. 2) It resolves the causal dependency in refinement via parallel Jacobi iterations: only K ≪ B (B is block size) parallel passes are needed to approximate the fixed point of sequential autoregressive refinement, avoiding reintroducing serial overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with Qwen3-8B as the target model and dFlash as the base drafter across 7 math, coding, and chat benchmarks. Acceptance length improves by 18–56% under greedy decoding and 19–58% under T=1 sampling, with consistent end-to-end throughput gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus on Section 3 (Jacobi parallel refinement derivation) and Section 4 (experimental results and ablation studies on block size B vs iteration count K). Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 准确指出 block-diffusion draft 的边际独立采样问题，因果 refiner 是直接补丁；做推测解码或 diffusion LM 应看方法节。
recommendation.en: Correctly identifies the marginal-independence flaw in block-diffusion drafts and offers a direct causal-refinement fix; read the method section if you work on speculative decoding or diffusion LMs.

paper.title: CodeShrink: Adaptive Visual Compression for Efficient Multimodal Code Understanding
paper.abstract: Rendering source code as images offers a promising way to reduce the input costs of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Adjusting image resolution can trade visual token cost against content fidelity. However, resolution scaling alone overlooks two sources of inefficiency: blank regions created by line breaks and indentation, and code regions irrelevant to the current instruction. Moreover, the best compression setting varies across inputs, tasks, and models, limiting fixed-ratio strategie

summary.core_problem: 解决把代码渲染成图像交给 MLLM 时视觉 token 成本过高、且固定压缩比例容易损伤可读性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏工程方法创新。它把代码理解中的视觉 token 压缩拆成空白布局、任务相关区域、输入自适应配置三个问题，对多模态代码模型的低成本推理有参考意义，但不直接推进基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CodeShrink：Blank-Free Rendering 用紧凑布局和显式结构标记替代依赖缩进与换行的空白区域；Adaptive Compression Configuration 用轻量 agent 通过强化学习为每个输入预测压缩配置；Dominant Token Selection 结合指令和代码图像裁剪任务无关视觉 token。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体 benchmark 和提升幅度。可确认的是实验目标围绕 MLLM 代码理解中的视觉 token 节省与可读性保持，并与固定分辨率或固定压缩策略比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high visual-token cost of rendering source code as images for MLLMs, where fixed compression ratios often lose readability.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an engineering method for efficient inference. It decomposes visual compression for code understanding into layout waste, task-irrelevant regions, and input-adaptive settings. It is useful for multimodal code systems, but not central to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CodeShrink combines three components: Blank-Free Rendering replaces whitespace-heavy code layouts with compact layouts and explicit structural markers; Adaptive Compression Configuration trains a lightweight RL agent to choose per-input compression settings; Dominant Token Selection uses both the instruction and code image to prune task-irrelevant visual tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, benchmarks, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to compare token efficiency and readability against fixed-resolution or fixed-ratio visual compression baselines for MLLM code understanding.

recommendation.zh: 作为视觉 token 压缩的工程备查即可；预训练研究员只需看空白布局和任务相关裁剪设计，不必细读实验。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an engineering reference for visual-token compression; pretraining researchers only need the layout-removal and task-aware pruning ideas.

paper.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric $V \to L \to A$ pathway, where visual observations are projected into the representation space of a large language model before being decoded into robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead at every policy invocation. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a new VLA paradigm that reformulates the conventional $V \to L \to A$ pathway as a direct $V + L \to A$ mapping. Instead of

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在每次机器人策略调用时依赖大语言模型中枢，导致算力、显存和延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLA 推理路径和轻量动作解码的系统设计，重点在实时部署效率；它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对 embodied 模型是否必须 LLM-centric 提供了一个反例。
summary.technical_approach: TurboVLA 将传统的 V→L→A 路径改为直接 V+L→A：视觉观测和语言指令分别编码，通过轻量双向视觉语言交互融合，再由紧凑 decoder 预测连续 action chunks，避免在高频控制环路中调用大 LLM 表征空间。
summary.experiments: 标题给出的核心结果是在 RTX 4090 上以 32 Hz 实时运行，显存占用低于 1 GB。摘要没有提供完整机器人任务、数据规模、baseline 名称或成功率提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high compute, memory, and latency cost of using an LLM-centric interface at every policy invocation in vision-language-action models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an efficient VLA inference and action-decoding design. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but it is a useful counterexample to the assumption that embodied policies must be LLM-centric.
summary_en.technical_approach: TurboVLA replaces the conventional V→L→A pathway with a direct V+L→A mapping: visual observations and language instructions are encoded independently, fused through lightweight bidirectional vision-language interaction, and decoded into continuous action chunks.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is real-time execution at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with less than 1 GB VRAM. The supplied abstract does not include full task suites, data scale, named baselines, or success-rate deltas.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构图和 latency/VRAM 表；它提醒 VLA 不一定要把 LLM 放在控制回路中心。
recommendation.en: Read only the architecture and latency/VRAM tables; it is a useful reminder that VLA control loops need not be LLM-centered.

paper.title: SepPrune:A Separator-based Pruning Framework for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3, generate large numbers of vision tokens for high-resolution inputs, leading to substantial computational cost. Existing vision token pruning methods either depend on cross-modal attention and cannot prune before the prefill stage, or rely on diversity estimation with high computational overhead. We observe that attention scores from both vision and text tokens peak at modality separator tokens, suggesting that the

summary.core_problem: 高分辨率输入下 MLLM 产生过多视觉 token，现有剪枝方法要么依赖跨模态注意力无法在 prefill 前剪、要么多样性估计开销大。
summary.importance: 工程型训练无关剪枝方法，利用模态分隔符 token 作为统一查询做视觉 token 筛选。
summary.technical_approach: 观察到视觉和文本注意力都在 separator token 处达到峰值，以此作为 query 复用 LLM 内置投影参数对视觉 token 排序，training-free、plug-and-play，无需架构改动。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上剪掉 80.2% 视觉 token，保留 96.3% 原始精度，达到 SOTA 剪枝效果。

summary_en.core_problem: High-resolution MLLMs produce excessive vision tokens; existing pruning methods either depend on cross-modal attention (cannot prune before prefill) or incur high diversity-estimation overhead.
summary_en.importance: Engineering-oriented, training-free pruning that exploits modality separator tokens as a unified query for vision token selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that attention scores from both vision and text tokens peak at modality separator tokens; reuses the LLM's built-in projection to rank vision tokens with the separator as query, requiring no training or architecture changes.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, removes 80.2% of vision tokens while retaining 96.3% of original accuracy, achieving SOTA among pruning methods.

recommendation.zh: 小而干净的 serving 侧 trick，separator 当 query 的观察可复用；不涉及预训练，看 abstract 即可。
recommendation.en: Clean serving-side trick; the separator-as-query observation is reusable, but it doesn't touch pretraining—abstract is enough.

paper.title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Token-level sparse attention, as implemented by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) in production systems, makes the downstream attention efficient but shifts the bottleneck to the indexer that feeds it.
