To select the top-k tokens for each query, the indexer must still score every preceding token, incurring a cost of O(L^2) per layer for a sequence of length L. We observe that this per-query scan is largely redundant: nearby queries select highly overlapping top-k tokens, and the indexer scores are

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 token-level sparse attention 在真实长上下文推理里的一个新瓶颈：主注意力已经从全量 attention 降到只看 top-k token，但用于选出这 top-k 的 indexer 仍然要对每个 query 扫完整个前缀，单层复杂度还是 O(L^2)。论文抓住的不是 token 轴、head 轴或 layer 轴，而是 query 轴上的冗余：相邻 query 往往会选到高度重合的 top-k token，因此没必要为每个 query 各做一次完整前缀扫描。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练方法本身，而在长上下文 serving 与稀疏注意力落地。很多稀疏 attention 方案论文里看起来便宜，真正上线时却被索引阶段拖住，这篇工作把瓶颈拆得很清楚，也给出一个不改模型、不重训、可直接替换的方案。它的价值主要有两点：第一，说明 sparse attention 的效率分析不能只看 downstream attention kernel，还要把 candidate selection 算进去；第二，提出 query-group 共享索引这一条独立于 token/head/layer 压缩的新轴，对后续训练期联合设计也有启发，比如是否可以在预训练中显式鼓励局部 query 的检索一致性，从而让这类近似更稳。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，也很工程化。PIVOT 的核心是把一组相邻 query 合成一个 proxy query，只做一次 full-prefix traversal，然后把这次扫描得到的高分 token 作为整组共享候选集。之后再分两种变体。PIVOT-Refine 会让组内每个 query 只在这个小候选集上重新打分，再取自己的 top-k；这样把原本每个 query 的 O(L) 扫描改成 O(c)，其中 k < c << L。PIVOT-Reuse 更激进，直接把 proxy query 的 top-k 复用给整组 query，连 per-query refine 都省掉。复杂度上，g 个 query 的索引成本从 O(gL) 变成 Refine 的 O(L + gc) 或 Reuse 的 O(L)。论文成立的经验基础有两个：一是相邻 query 的 top-k overlap 很高；二是 indexer score 沿 key 轴呈长尾分布，所以只要 c 比 k 稍大，通常就能覆盖组内大部分真正需要的 token。实现上它保持 DSA 接口不变，下游 Sparse MLA 完全不用改，因此是 drop-in replacement。prefill 阶段按固定组大小分组；decode 阶段则直接利用 multi-token prediction 同一步产生的 d+1 个 token 作为一组，因此能和 MTP 的加速叠加。方法的关键取舍也很清楚：Refine 更稳，Reuse 更便宜；组越大，摊薄越明显，但候选覆盖风险也会上升。
summary.experiments: 论文在 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5.1 上做了 LongBench 与 RULER 评测，结论是 Refine 基本能维持与原始 dense DSA indexer 相当的精度，同时显著降低索引开销。文中给出的代表性结果是：在长上下文场景下，indexer operator 最多可加速 4×，端到端延迟最多降低 1.6×。问题背景里的一个数字也很关键：在 200K context 时，原始 indexer 可占 prefill 延迟约 81%，decode 延迟约 41%，这解释了为什么只优化 attention kernel 不够。实验重点不是绝对任务分数提升，而是 accuracy-latency tradeoff：PIVOT-Refine 在较小候选预算下就能接近基线，说明 query-group 的 top-k union 远小于最坏情况 gk；PIVOT-Reuse 则进一步换取速度，但更依赖 query 相似性。消融的核心变量应包括 group size g、candidate size c、Refine vs Reuse、prefill 与 decode 两阶段差异，以及不同长上下文长度下的收益变化。全文给人的信息是：收益主要来自把重复 prefix scan 摊薄，而不是改写下游稀疏 attention 算子。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2。Figure 2 基本给出了整篇成立的证据：相邻 query 的 top-k overlap 高，而且组内 top-k 并集增长很慢。然后看方法部分里 proxy query 的构造方式、candidate set 的选取、Refine 与 Reuse 的复杂度对比。实验部分重点看三类结果：一是 indexer latency 与 end-to-end latency 的拆分；二是不同 g、c 下的精度保持情况；三是 prefill 和 decode 是否都稳定受益。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得跟进，实现接口兼容性和 MTP 结合方式最值得看，因为这决定了它是不是一个真实可部署的方案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in token-level sparse attention. Even if the downstream attention only attends to top-k tokens, the indexer still scores every prefix token for every query, so indexing remains O(L^2) per layer. The key observation is that this work does not reduce cost along the token, head, or layer axis; it attacks redundancy along the query axis. Nearby queries often retrieve highly overlapping top-k tokens, so running a full prefix scan for each query is wasteful.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly on long-context inference and sparse-attention deployment rather than pretraining itself. Many sparse-attention designs look efficient on paper but hide a dense retrieval stage that dominates latency in production. This paper is useful because it makes that hidden cost explicit and proposes a training-free replacement. Two takeaways matter. First, sparse-attention efficiency should be evaluated end-to-end, including candidate selection. Second, query-group shared indexing is an orthogonal optimization axis, which may later inform training-time co-design, for example by encouraging local retrieval consistency so that such approximations become more reliable.
summary_en.technical_approach: PIVOT groups nearby queries and replaces multiple full-prefix scans with one shared scan. A group is aggregated into a single proxy query, which traverses the prefix once and selects a shared candidate set of size c. Then there are two variants. PIVOT-Refine rescoring: each query re-scores only the shared candidate set and picks its own top-k. This changes per-query work from O(L) to O(c), where k < c << L. PIVOT-Reuse is cheaper: it directly reuses the proxy top-k for all queries in the group, skipping per-query refinement. For a group of size g, indexing cost drops from O(gL) to O(L + gc) for Refine or O(L) for Reuse. The method relies on two empirical properties shown in the paper: high top-k overlap among nearby queries, and long-tailed indexer scores along the key axis, so a candidate budget only slightly above k is often enough. Importantly, PIVOT preserves the DSA interface and leaves the downstream Sparse MLA operator unchanged, making it a drop-in replacement. In prefill, groups are formed by contiguous query positions; in decode, the d+1 tokens from one multi-token prediction step form a natural group, so PIVOT composes with MTP speedups.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 with LongBench and RULER. The main result is not better task quality but a better accuracy-latency tradeoff. PIVOT-Refine largely matches the dense DSA indexer in accuracy while reducing indexing cost substantially. The headline numbers are up to 4x speedup for the indexer operator and up to 1.6x end-to-end latency reduction at long context. A key motivating number from the paper is that at 200K context, the original indexer can account for about 81% of prefill latency and 41% of decode latency. The important ablations are group size g, candidate size c, Refine versus Reuse, and behavior in prefill versus decode. The evidence suggests that the gain comes from amortizing repeated prefix scans, not from changing the sparse attention kernel itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 2. Those plots carry the central empirical claim: neighboring queries have high top-k overlap, and the union of their top-k sets grows much more slowly than the worst-case gk. Then read the method section for proxy-query construction, candidate selection, and the complexity difference between Refine and Reuse. In experiments, focus on latency breakdowns, quality retention under different g and c, and whether gains hold in both prefill and decode. Around 20 to 30 minutes is enough for a solid skim. If deciding whether it is deployable, pay most attention to interface compatibility and how it leverages MTP during decode.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek生产级稀疏注意力的索引优化，思路巧妙且训练无关，做长上下文/高效注意力的研究员应重点看其分组共享扫描的设计。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek's production-grade sparse attention index optimization, clever and training-free; researchers on long-context/efficient attention should study its group-shared scan design.

paper.title: PRESTO: Prefix-Aligned Tree Drafting for Diffusion Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, generating tokens in parallel. This makes them effective draft models for speculative decoding (SD), producing an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass. Yet existing diffusion-based drafting methods rely on linear drafting, even though dLLMs emit multiple candidate tokens across positions, inducing a large combinatorial space of decoding paths. Consequently, they limit acc

summary.core_problem: PRESTO 解决 diffusion LLM 作为 speculative decoding drafter 时的候选路径利用不足问题。现有 diffusion drafting 多采用单路径线性草稿，但 diffusion 模型一次 forward 会在多个位置给出多个候选 token，天然形成组合空间。只取一条 top-1 轨迹会浪费候选。直接套用 AR tree drafting 也不合适，因为 diffusion 输出的是位置级 marginal probability，而 AR verifier 接受 token 时依赖前缀条件概率，两者的打分语义不一致。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把 diffusion LM 的非自回归分布形态和 AR speculative decoding 的验证机制接起来。它指出 diffusion drafter 的 marginal token 概率可以是有用信号，但不能直接当作前缀路径分数。这个观察对新型语言建模范式的 serving 很重要：dLLM 的并行生成优势不只取决于训练目标，也取决于解码时如何把并行候选转成可被 AR 或自验证器高效接受的路径。
summary.technical_approach: PRESTO 的核心是 prefix-aligned tree drafting。方法先对 diffusion marginal score 做一个最小的 prefix-dependent correction，让候选路径排序更贴近 AR verifier 的顺序接受过程。然后用 priority-based tree search 扩展候选，而不是按单一路径生成草稿。优先队列把计算预算分配给更可能获得长接受长度的路径。和 AR tree drafting 相比，PRESTO 不能直接依赖自然的前缀条件分布，因为 diffusion drafter 并不按左到右方式建模；和线性 diffusion drafting 相比，它利用了同一轮 diffusion 输出中的多候选结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类场景：一类是面向 AR LLM 的专用 diffusion drafter，例如 dFlash 路线；另一类是 diffusion LLM 的 self-speculative decoding，例如 TiDAR、I-DLM 或 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion 一类设置。论文报告 PRESTO 能提高 accepted length，并带来端到端 throughput 提升。关键消融应包括线性 drafting、朴素 tree drafting、只用 diffusion marginal 排序、加入 prefix-aligned scoring 后的 tree search。给出的材料没有包含完整实验表，因此无法确认具体加速比例、接受长度提升和不同 batch size 下的收益边界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看问题分析部分：为什么 diffusion marginal probability 和 AR prefix verification 不对齐。然后看 prefix-aligned scoring 的定义，判断 correction 使用了哪些前缀信号，以及是否引入额外 verifier 调用或显著 drafting 开销。实验部分重点看 accepted length 与 throughput 的关系，不要只看单步草稿质量；还要看 tree size、batch size、target model 利用率的消融，因为这些因素决定方法是否能转化为真实 serving 收益。

summary_en.core_problem: PRESTO studies diffusion LMs used as draft models for speculative decoding. Existing diffusion-based drafting often follows a single linear path, even though a diffusion model produces token distributions for many positions in parallel. This leaves much of the candidate space unused. A naive tree extension is also imperfect: diffusion scores are position-wise marginal probabilities, while AR verification accepts tokens under prefix-conditioned probabilities. The ranking signal and the verifier’s decision rule are therefore misaligned.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to both diffusion language modeling and inference efficiency. It shows that the serving advantage of diffusion LMs is not only about parallel token prediction; it also depends on how candidate distributions are converted into paths that an AR-style verifier can accept. The key lesson is that well-calibrated marginals are not enough when the acceptance process is sequential and prefix-dependent.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRESTO introduces prefix-aligned tree drafting. It modifies diffusion marginal scores with a prefix-dependent correction, aiming to preserve the useful signal from the diffusion drafter while making path ranking closer to the AR verifier’s acceptance behavior. A priority-based tree search then expands high-potential candidate paths under a fixed drafting budget. Compared with AR tree drafting, the method has to compensate for the absence of native left-to-right conditional probabilities. Compared with linear diffusion drafting, it uses the multi-candidate structure that diffusion generation already exposes.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates PRESTO in two settings: dedicated diffusion drafters for AR LLM speculative decoding, such as the dFlash line of work, and self-speculative decoding for diffusion LMs. The reported outcomes are higher accepted length and better end-to-end throughput. The important comparisons are linear drafting, naive tree drafting, marginal-only tree ranking, and the full prefix-aligned priority search. The supplied content does not include exact throughput gains, accepted-length numbers, or detailed batch-size sensitivity, so those should be verified in the experiment tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 20–30 minutes. Start with the section that explains the mismatch between diffusion marginal scoring and prefix-based AR verification. Then read the scoring rule and the priority tree construction algorithm. In the results, focus on accepted length versus wall-clock throughput, not just draft quality. The most useful ablations are tree size, scoring variant, batch size, and target-model utilization, because they determine whether the method gives practical serving gains.

recommendation.zh: 扩散 LM 推测解码的扎实改进，前缀对齐与树状草稿的组合解决了一个真实的结构性 mismatch，做 dLLM 推理的人应读 §3 和实验部分。
recommendation.en: A solid improvement in diffusion LM speculative decoding; the prefix-aligned tree drafting addresses a real structural mismatch. Researchers working on dLLM inference should read §3 and the experiments.

paper.title: CausalGate: Causal Importance Distillation for Transformer Module Pruning
paper.abstract: Existing adaptive inference methods for Large Language Models rely on observational heuristics, such as hidden-state similarity or activation magnitudes, to drop redundant modules. However, these correlation-based metrics often fail to capture subtle, non-linear structural computations vital for semantic accuracy. We introduce CausalGate, an intervention-guided framework for compute-efficient transformer inference. During a calibration phase, CausalGate isolates individual Attention and MLP sub-

summary.core_problem: 现有 Transformer 自适应推理方法依赖隐藏状态相似度、激活幅值等观察式启发式指标剪枝模块，无法捕捉对语义精度关键的非线性结构计算。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将因果干预引入模块重要性评估，提出了基于真实语义损伤的静态剪枝方案，避免运行时路由开销。
summary.technical_approach: CausalGate 在校准阶段逐个干预 Attention/MLP 子层输出置零，用最终 logit 分布的 KL 散度度量精确语义损伤；再通过 EMA 平滑与可微成对排序损失，把结构重要性层级蒸馏为一组全局静态轻量标量门控，消除运行时路由开销。
summary.experiments: 在 TinyLlama-1.1B、Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.1-8B 上评估语言建模与常识推理任务；摘要截断，未披露完整 FLOPs 缩减比例与精度保留率。
summary.authors_note: 南达科他大学 USD AI 研究实验室，无知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing adaptive inference methods for Transformers prune modules using observational heuristics (hidden-state similarity, activation magnitude) that fail to capture non-linear structural computations critical for semantic accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: introduces causal intervention into module importance estimation, yielding a static pruning scheme based on true semantic damage with no runtime routing overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: CausalGate performs a calibration phase where each Attention/MLP sub-layer output is individually zeroed out, and exact semantic damage is measured via KL divergence on the final logit distribution. This structural importance hierarchy is then distilled into a global set of static lightweight scalar gates via EMA smoothing and a differentiable pairwise ranking loss, eliminating runtime routing overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on TinyLlama-1.1B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Llama-3.1-8B across language modeling and commonsense reasoning tasks; abstract is truncated, full FLOPs reduction and accuracy retention figures not disclosed.
summary_en.authors_note: USD Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, University of South Dakota; no notable authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 用因果干预替代相关性启发式做模块剪枝的思路干净，可作为内部剪枝 ablation 的弱 baseline 参考，无需精读。
recommendation.en: The causal-intervention instead of correlation-heuristic approach to module pruning is clean; useful as a weak baseline for internal pruning ablations, no deep read needed.

institutions: University of South Dakota, Vermillion, SD

paper.title: Omni-Prune: Query-Aware Unified Token Pruning for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) are rapidly extending multimodal reasoning to cover synchronized audio and video. However, the resulting audio-video token sequences are long, leading to high prefill latency and GPU memory usage at inference time. Existing token pruning methods, designed mainly for vision-only inputs, miss both the cross-modal links between audio and video and the user query that decides which content matters. To bridge this gap, we present Omni-Prune, a training-free,

summary.core_problem: 支持音视频同步输入的全模态LLM存在音视频token序列过长的问题，导致推理预填充延迟高、显存占用大，现有视觉单模态剪枝方法忽略音视频跨模态关联与用户查询引导。
summary.importance: 提出首个针对音视频同步OmniLLM的免训练query感知token剪枝框架，在保留跨模态任务证据的前提下降低推理开销。
summary.technical_approach: 训练-free流程：按音频显著性峰值划分自适应时间窗口，结合编码器注意力与文本查询相关性对音视频token统一打分，配对关联的音视频token保证共同保留，窗口内用K-medoids选择代表性token完成剪枝。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、测试基准与量化效果，仅说明方法可联合去除跨模态冗余、保留任务相关证据。

summary_en.core_problem: Omnimodal LLMs with synchronized audio-video inputs face long audio-video token sequences causing high prefill latency and memory usage; existing vision-only pruning methods ignore cross-modal links and user query guidance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first training-free, query-aware token pruning framework for synchronized audio-video OmniLLMs, reducing inference overhead while preserving task-relevant cross-modal evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The training-free pipeline splits sequences into adaptive time windows aligned with audio saliency peaks, scores audio/video tokens on a unified scale combining encoder attention and query relevance, pairs correlated audio-video tokens for joint retention, and uses K-medoids per window to select representative tokens.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model sizes, benchmarks, or quantitative results are disclosed in the abstract; the method is stated to jointly remove cross-modal redundancy while preserving task-relevant evidence.

recommendation.zh: 音视频多模态LLM的训练-free剪枝增量工作，无范式创新，作为多模态推理效率文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental training-free pruning work for audio-video multimodal LLMs with no paradigm innovation; keep as reference for multimodal inference efficiency, no deep read needed.

paper.title: RIS-Kernel: A Model-Agnostic Architecture for Long-Context LLM Inference via Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Full self-attention in large language models scales as O(N^2), which limits long-context document analysis to 65,536 tokens and requires costly GPU clusters. The Reduced Interaction Sampling (RIS) inference engine addresses this constraint as a model-agnostic architecture. Without modifying weights, RIS reduces self-attention complexity to O(N log N) using sparse stochastic geometry that fits within commodity memory limits. We validate RIS on Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct across two regimes. In controlled

summary.core_problem: LLM全注意力O(N²)复杂度限制长上下文推理，需在不改权重前提下实现模型无关的稀疏注意力推理。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出模型无关的稀疏注意力推理架构RIS-Kernel，将自注意力复杂度降至O(N log N)。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Reduced Interaction Sampling(RIS)推理引擎，基于稀疏随机几何实现O(N log N)复杂度，无需修改模型权重；支持随机稀疏模式与多种子集成。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct上验证，32768 token场景下，1%密度+70个集成种子的RIS-Stochastic准确率75.00%，超过稠密基线71.88%；5%密度+10种子与稠密基线持平。

summary_en.core_problem: Full self-attention's O(N²) complexity limits long-context LLM inference; a weight-agnostic sparse attention architecture is needed.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a model-agnostic sparse attention inference architecture that reduces self-attention complexity to O(N log N).
summary_en.technical_approach: The Reduced Interaction Sampling (RIS) inference engine uses sparse stochastic geometry to achieve O(N log N) complexity without modifying model weights, supporting stochastic sparsity patterns and multi-seed ensembling.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct at 32,768 tokens: RIS-Stochastic with 1% density and 70 ensemble seeds reaches 75.00% accuracy, outperforming the dense baseline of 71.88%; 5% density with 10 seeds matches the dense baseline.

recommendation.zh: 稀疏注意力推理的增量工作，低密集成反而超过稠密基线的现象值得留意，但实验规模小，作为弱信号参考。
recommendation.en: Incremental sparse attention inference work; the counterintuitive low-density ensemble outperforming dense attention is notable but small-scale, treat as weak signal.

paper.title: Profiling Lightweight Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Lightweight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed locally on personal computers and are expected to play a growing role in resource-constrained edge and mobile environments. In such settings, energy consumption, execution time, and memory usage directly affect practical usability, yet existing evaluations of LLM efficiency largely rely on proxy descriptors such as parameter count or FLOPs, often decoupled from task precision. This paper introduces a PTME-based experimental

summary.core_problem: 现有轻量 LLM 效率评估依赖参数量/FLOPs 等静态代理指标，与实际精度-时间-内存-能耗 trade-off 脱节。
summary.importance: 提出精度-硬件联合 profiling 框架 PTME，对 edge 端小模型的真实部署成本做直接测量。
summary.technical_approach: 在受控桌面平台上，对一批代表性轻量 LLM 做硬件级直接测量，同时记录 Precision、Time、Memory、Energy 四个维度，覆盖代码、数学、多任务理解 benchmark；以静态代理指标 vs 实际测量做对比分析。
summary.experiments: 多个轻量 LLM 在本地 edge 资源包络下运行；发现静态代理（参数量/FLOPs）与真实 PTME 指标存在明显偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing lightweight LLM efficiency evaluations rely on static proxies (parameter count, FLOPs) that poorly predict the actual precision-time-memory-energy trade-off on edge hardware.
summary_en.importance: Proposes PTME, a precision-aware hardware-level profiling framework that directly measures Precision, Time, Memory, and Energy for lightweight LLM inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Runs a representative set of lightweight LLMs on a controlled desktop/edge-class platform, directly measuring four dimensions at the hardware level across code, math, and multi-task benchmarks, and contrasts these with static proxy descriptors.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple lightweight LLMs under edge resource envelopes, finds that static proxies deviate substantially from measured PTME values.

recommendation.zh: 实用但增量：证实参数量/FLOPs 不等于真实 edge 成本，做端侧选型可备查，方法上无新东西。
recommendation.en: Useful but incremental: confirms params/FLOPs are poor proxies for real edge cost; worth bookmarking for on-device model selection, no new methodological insight.

paper.title: Look Less, Think Faster: Joint Token-Compute Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance across vision-language tasks. However, their high inference cost, arising from both the large number of input visual tokens and the heavy computation of the large language model (LLM), remains a key barrier to practical deployment. Recent work attempts to reduce the cost by adaptively optimizing individual dimensions, e.g., pruning redundant visual tokens or skipping LLM layers and heads. Nonetheless, prior ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 MLLM 推理成本的联合自适应分配问题：视觉 token 数量、LLM 层深度、注意力头和 FFN 宽度都会影响 prefill 成本，但已有方法通常只单独做 token pruning 或 layer/head skipping，无法根据输入内容和实时算力预算做全局取舍。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，更偏高效推理。但它对 MLLM 架构设计有启发：视觉信息密度和语言模型推理深度不是独立变量。简单样本可以少看图、少走层；复杂样本可能需要保留更多视觉上下文，同时减少部分模型宽度或深度。这个思路也提示多模态基座模型在训练阶段可以考虑引入预算条件化能力，而不是只在推理时做后处理剪枝。
summary.technical_approach: SmartVL 把三类计算开关放到一个框架里联合控制：第一是视觉侧 token controller，决定保留多少视觉 token；第二是 LLM 侧 compute controller，决定层、头和宽度等计算路径；第三是预算条件化机制，把输入中间特征和目标 FLOPs budget 融合后作为控制器决策依据。核心区别在于，它不把视觉剪枝和语言模型跳层当成两个串联启发式模块，而是用可微资源估计器直接约束 FLOPs 偏差，并在推理时用 bounding mechanism 严格压住预算。这样做的目标是避免两个常见问题：视觉 token 被局部冗余指标误删后造成语义信息损失；模型跳层模块在默认全量视觉 token 的假设下工作，无法适配前面已经被压缩过的输入。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 VQAv2、GQA、TextVQA、ScienceQA、POPE、MMBench、VizWiz 等常见 MLLM 评测。对比对象包括单维 token pruning 方法 LLaVA-PruMerge+、FastV，计算自适应方法 AdaLLaVA，以及把 AdaLLaVA 和 PruMerge 组合起来的朴素两阶段方案。主要结果是 SmartVL 在不同 FLOPs budget 下给出更好的准确率-计算量曲线。论文明确给出的数字是：在 50% compute 下，SmartVL 相比 AdaLLaVA 有 6.6% accuracy gain，并且在更高算力区间仍保持优势。实验重点不只是绝对分数，而是说明联合调度优于单独剪 token、单独跳层，或把两个模块简单拼接。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中关于三类计算轴的分解，以及为什么 token redundancy 和 LLM reasoning complexity 存在耦合；再看方法部分的两个 controller、budget-conditioned feature fusion、differentiable resource estimator 和 bounding mechanism。实验部分优先看 FLOPs-accuracy Pareto 曲线和 AdaLLaVA-PruMerge 这类组合 baseline，因为它能判断联合训练是否真的优于工程拼接。若只关心预训练，可快速看结论，把它作为动态计算分配和预算条件化建模的参考。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses joint adaptive inference for multimodal LLMs. Visual token count, LLM depth, and model width all contribute to prefill cost, but prior methods usually optimize only one axis, such as token pruning or layer/head skipping. This misses the fact that visual information density and downstream reasoning compute should be allocated together under a runtime FLOPs budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in efficient MLLM inference rather than pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the coupling between visual token selection and language-model compute. The result suggests that multimodal models may benefit from being trained with budget-conditioned computation, instead of relying only on post-hoc pruning or skipping rules at deployment time.
summary_en.technical_approach: SmartVL jointly controls sequence length, model depth, and model width. It uses a vision-side token controller to select visual tokens and an LLM-side compute controller to allocate computation inside the language model. Both controllers are conditioned on fused intermediate representations that encode input content and the target compute budget. A differentiable resource estimator penalizes deviations from the desired FLOPs, and an inference-time bounding mechanism enforces the budget. The main distinction from earlier work is that token pruning and compute skipping are not treated as independent heuristics. The framework lets the model trade off retaining more visual context against activating more reasoning capacity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers VQAv2, GQA, TextVQA, ScienceQA, POPE, MMBench, and VizWiz. Baselines include LLaVA-PruMerge+, FastV, AdaLLaVA, and a composed AdaLLaVA-PruMerge pipeline. The reported result is that SmartVL gives a better accuracy-compute Pareto frontier than single-axis adaptation and naive composition. One concrete number in the manuscript is a 6.6% accuracy gain over AdaLLaVA at 50% compute, with the advantage maintained across higher FLOPs levels.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the introduction for the cost decomposition into sequence length, depth, and width, and for the argument that visual redundancy and LLM reasoning complexity are coupled. Then inspect the method details for the two controllers, budget-conditioned feature fusion, differentiable resource estimator, and bounding rule. In the experiments, focus on the FLOPs-accuracy curves and the comparison against AdaLLaVA-PruMerge, since that baseline tests whether joint scheduling is better than simply composing two separate efficiency modules.

recommendation.zh: MLLM部署侧的联合剪枝思路，与预训练无直接关系；只看§3框架图和主表即可。
recommendation.en: Joint token-compute pruning for MLLM serving, tangential to pretraining; just skim §3 framework figure and main results table.

paper.title: Importance-Aware OBS Pruning for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We propose importance-aware pruning for diffusion models, a training-free framework that prioritizes preserving parameters critical to semantically salient image regions. To do so, we incorporate spatial importance maps -- derived from conditioning signals or model attention -- into the pruning objective. This produces parameter rankings aligned with perceptual relevance rather than uniform reconstruction error. On MS-COCO dataset, our proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and

summary.core_problem: 传统扩散模型剪枝方法基于均匀重建误差或权重大小排序参数，未考虑语义区域重要性，高压缩比下会过度剪枝语义重要区域参数，导致感知质量下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出training-free的重要性感知剪枝框架，将空间重要性图融入剪枝目标，提升高压缩比下的生成感知质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Importance-Aware OBS Pruning；从条件信号或模型注意力提取空间重要性图，将其融入OBS剪枝目标函数，得到感知对齐的参数排序，优先保留语义重要区域参数，无需额外训练。
summary.experiments: 实验在MS-COCO数据集上开展；基线为基于权重大小、均匀重建误差的传统剪枝方法；高压缩比下传统方法出现可见生成退化时，所提方法仍能一致保留主体保真度与结构正确性。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional diffusion model pruning methods rank parameters based on uniform reconstruction error or weight magnitude, ignoring semantic region importance, leading to over-pruning of parameters in semantically salient regions and degraded perceptual quality at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a training-free importance-aware pruning framework that incorporates spatial importance maps into the pruning objective, improving perceptual quality at high compression ratios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Importance-Aware OBS Pruning; extracts spatial importance maps from conditioning signals or model attention; integrates them into the OBS pruning objective to obtain perception-aligned parameter rankings, prioritizing parameters in semantically salient regions without additional training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset; baselines include conventional pruning methods based on weight magnitude and uniform reconstruction error; the proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and structural correctness at high compression ratios where conventional pruning causes visible degradation.

recommendation.zh: 图像扩散的重要性感知剪枝思路可借鉴到LLM参数重要性排序，仅看§3重要性图构建与§4压缩比-质量曲线即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: The importance-aware parameter ranking idea for diffusion pruning can be borrowed for LLM parameter importance estimation; only read §3 for importance map construction and §4 for compression-quality curves, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: Kernelized Linear Attention: Breaking the Capacity Wall with Symmetric Cones
paper.abstract: Linear attention promises constant-time recurrent inference but degrades sharply on associative recall. We formulate attention recall as a spherical-packing problem and introduce Kernelized Linear Attention Activations (KATA), a framework whose feature maps are derived from first principles by certifying nonnegative attention weights through a self-dual homogeneous cone. Building on this observation, we show that rank-one positive semi-definite (PSD) features offer a favorable capacity--interfer

summary.core_problem: 线性注意力虽能实现常数时间循环推理，但在联想召回任务上性能急剧下降，存在明确的容量瓶颈，现有设计多为启发式，缺乏理论支撑。
summary.importance: 架构创新+理论突破，首次从球填充问题和对称锥的第一性原理出发设计线性注意力特征，同时给出容量的严格理论刻画和高效工程实现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 KATA 框架，将注意力召回建模为球填充问题，通过自对偶齐次锥保证注意力权重非负，推导秩一 PSD 特征实现容量-干扰权衡，得到参数无关的凸输出门，用 Welch 干扰下界刻画联想容量；实现两种融合 Triton 核：FlashAttention 风格前向和 O(T) 分块状态精确形式。
summary.experiments: 实现的 FlashAttention 风格前向核吞吐达 FlashAttention-2 的 ~1.6 倍，同时支持精确 O(T) 复杂度的分块状态推理；合成实验验证了有限尺寸下的行为与理论预测一致。

summary_en.core_problem: Linear attention enables constant-time recurrent inference but suffers severe performance degradation on associative recall due to a capacity bottleneck, with existing designs mostly heuristic and lacking theoretical grounding.
summary_en.importance: Combined architectural and theoretical breakthrough: first first-principles linear attention feature design from spherical packing and symmetric cones, with rigorous capacity characterization and efficient engineering implementation.
summary_en.technical_approach: KATA frames attention recall as a spherical packing problem, certifies non-negative attention weights via self-dual homogeneous cones, derives rank-1 PSD features for favorable capacity-interference tradeoff, obtains a parameter-free convex output gate, and characterizes associative capacity via the Welch interference floor; two fused Triton kernels are implemented.
summary_en.experiments: The flash-attention-style forward kernel achieves ~1.6× throughput of FlashAttention-2, and the framework supports exact O(T) chunked-state inference; synthetic experiments validate finite-size behavior matches theoretical predictions.

recommendation.zh: 线性注意力容量瓶颈的第一性原理解法，理论刻画干净，Triton核实现可直接用于架构消融，重点看§3的锥推导和§5的核实现。
recommendation.en: First-principles solution to linear attention's capacity bottleneck with clean theory; Triton kernel implementation is directly usable for architecture ablations, focus on §3 and §5.

paper.title: SALT: Salience-Aware Lexical Trie for Long-Context Compression
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly longer prompts, computation and KV-cache memory costs have emerged as major bottlenecks in inference systems. Existing input-level prompt compression methods address this, but rank each sentence by a scalar relevance score, treating the document as an unstructured pool of words and sentences. Under tight budgets, this causes theme collapse, where the dominant theme(s) of a document consumes the budget, discarding less-frequent yet task-relevan

summary.core_problem: 现有输入级 prompt 压缩方法按句子孤立打分分配预算，紧预算下会出现主题坍缩，主导主题占满预算而丢弃低频但任务相关的主题，无法保证主题覆盖度。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出模型无关的抽取式 prompt 压缩框架，解决了长上下文压缩中的主题覆盖缺陷，工程实现轻量可复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SALT 框架，将每个句子的关键词组织为按句子频率（SF）排序的字典树，用 SF 作为文档主题结构的轻量代理，通过 trie 结构平滑内存分配，避免主导主题垄断预算，结合多锚点检索提升任务相关性。
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要中实验部分被截断，未披露具体测试模型、数据集及量化提升结果，仅说明框架为模型无关，可复用句子频率作为主题结构代理。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing input-level prompt compression methods allocate budget via per-sentence isolated scoring, leading to theme collapse under tight budgets where dominant themes consume all budget and discard less frequent but task-relevant themes.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a model-agnostic extractive prompt compression framework that fixes theme coverage flaws in long-context compression, with lightweight and reusable engineering implementation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SALT organizes per-sentence keywords into a trie sorted by sentence frequency (SF), a lightweight reusable proxy for document thematic structure; the trie smooths memory allocation to prevent dominant theme monopoly, combined with multi-anchor retrieval to improve relevance.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section is truncated in the provided abstract; no specific test models, datasets, or quantitative improvements are disclosed, only that the framework is model-agnostic and uses sentence frequency as a thematic proxy.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文prompt压缩的实用改进，解决了现有方法的主题坍缩问题，trie结构设计可参考，重点看§3的SF-trie构造。
recommendation.en: Practical long-context prompt compression improvement fixing theme collapse; refer to §3 for SF-trie construction design.

paper.title: LookME: Lookup-Based Multimodal Embeddings for Layer Injection in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in multimodal understanding. However, scaling dense or sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models to improve performance limits deployment in resource-constrained environments due to the trade-off between high memory usage from full loading and increased latency from on-demand loading. Recently, the Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) architecture addresses this by scaling models with large external embedding tables stored in ROM and performing light

summary.core_problem: 把 Per-Layer Embedding（PLE）的查表式参数扩展从纯文本推广到多模态 VLM，缓解 MoE 扩容带来的显存/延迟矛盾。
summary.importance: 工程型架构扩展：用 ROM 存储大 embedding 表 + 按需查表替代全量加载 MoE，思路对边缘部署有参考。
summary.technical_approach: LookME：为 VLM 设计多模态 lookup-based embedding，支持分区存储和按需加载，在层注入时用查表增强 token 表示，适配视觉 token 而非仅文本 ID。
summary.experiments: 在 VLM 上对比 dense/sparse MoE 与 PLE 基线，报告显存、延迟与视觉任务精度权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Extend Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) lookup-based parameter scaling from text-only to multimodal VLMs, mitigating the memory/latency trade-off of MoE scaling.
summary_en.importance: Engineering-oriented architecture extension: large ROM-resident embedding tables with on-demand lookup replace full MoE loading, relevant to edge deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: LookME: multimodal lookup-based embeddings for VLMs with partitioned storage and on-demand loading, injecting retrieved embeddings per layer to enhance token representations beyond text IDs.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against dense/sparse MoE and PLE baselines on VLMs, reporting memory, latency, and vision-task accuracy trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 把 PLE 查表扩容搬到多模态，属部署侧工程增量；作为 ROM-based 参数化思路备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Extends PLE lookup-scaling to multimodal; an engineering-side deployment variant—file it as literature, skip the body.

paper.title: Precomputing the Future-Offset Average in TriAttention
paper.abstract: TriAttention is a recent method for shrinking the KV cache of long-reasoning LLMs: it scores each cached key by how much attention it is likely to receive and evicts the lowest-scoring ones. Because a key does not know how far away its future queries will sit, the score is averaged over a ladder of 17 possible future distances. We point out that this average is free: the future distance enters the score only through the position-dependent rotation, so the whole 17-fold average collapses--exactly

summary.core_problem: TriAttention长上下文KV缓存剪枝方法在计算键保留分数时，需要对17种可能的未来查询距离做平均，存在无意义的计算冗余
summary.importance: 给出了无精度损失的代数简化方案，属于对现有KV剪枝方法的工程补全，可小幅降低剪枝环节的计算开销
summary.technical_approach: 通过代数推导证明，未来距离仅通过位置依赖的RoPE旋转项进入评分公式，17个偏移量的平均可精确折叠为一次离线预计算的每频带权重，在线评分仅需单次计算，完全不改变剪枝决策逻辑和注意力核实现
summary.experiments: 通过数值验证确认代数恒等式成立，剪枝结果与原TriAttention完全一致，仅评分环节计算量降为原有的1/17，无任何精度损失

summary_en.core_problem: The TriAttention KV cache pruning method for long-context LLMs requires averaging scores across 17 possible future query distances when computing key retention scores, introducing redundant computation
summary_en.importance: Provides an exact, accuracy-loss-free algebraic simplification as an engineering complement to existing KV pruning methods, reducing overhead in the pruning step
summary_en.technical_approach: Derives that future distance only enters the scoring formula via position-dependent RoPE rotation terms, so the 17-fold average collapses exactly to a single per-band weight precomputed offline; online scoring requires only one evaluation, with no changes to pruning logic or attention kernels
summary_en.experiments: Numerically verifies the identity holds; pruning decisions are identical to the original TriAttention method, with scoring computation reduced by 17x and no accuracy loss

recommendation.zh: 这是TriAttention KV剪枝方法的极小精确补遗，无算法逻辑改动，仅需了解结论备查，无需通读正文
recommendation.en: This is a tiny exact optimization for TriAttention KV pruning with no algorithmic changes; just note the result for reference, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: Accelerating Masked Diffusion Large Language Models: A Survey of Efficient Inference Techniques
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a theoretical advantage in parallel generation over standard autoregressive models. However, parallel generation alone does not guarantee practical speedups. Realizing this efficiency requires specialized inference mechanisms, such as diffusion-aware caching and reuse. Consequently, as inference efficiency becomes a prerequisite for practical deployment, recent research has actively explored acceleration techniques across algorithms, architectures, a

summary.core_problem: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的并行生成理论优势难转化为实际推理加速，且算法、架构、系统层面的延迟影响因素混杂，现有评测难以严谨对比不同加速技术。
summary.importance: 提出首个dLLM推理延迟统一分解框架，系统梳理跨算法、架构、系统的加速技术，属于分析框架+综述贡献，为dLLM的效率优化与落地提供结构化参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建统一的延迟分解框架，将端到端推理延迟拆解为算法、架构、系统三个独立维度，沿该分类体系梳理现有dLLM加速技术（如扩散感知缓存、计算复用等），并分析各维度的权衡关系。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验，基于已有研究的延迟拆解与技术分类对比，量化了不同因素对实际部署速度的影响。
summary.authors_note: 延世大学Jaegul Choo团队，团队长期从事扩散模型、生成式AI相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The theoretical parallel generation advantage of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is hard to translate into practical inference speedup, with latency factors across algorithm, architecture, and system levels conflated, making rigorous comparison of acceleration techniques difficult.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first unified latency decomposition framework for dLLM inference and systematically categorizes acceleration techniques across algorithms, architectures, and systems. It is an analytical framework + survey contribution providing structured reference for dLLM efficiency optimization and deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a unified latency decomposition framework that breaks down end-to-end inference latency into three independent dimensions: algorithm, architecture, and system. Based on this framework, it surveys existing dLLM acceleration techniques (e.g., diffusion-aware caching, computation reuse) and analyzes cross-dimensional trade-offs.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; conducts latency decomposition and technical categorization based on existing studies, quantifying the impact of different factors on real-world deployment speed.
summary_en.authors_note: Jaegul Choo's group at Yonsei University, which has long worked on diffusion models and generative AI.

recommendation.zh: 做非AR语言建模范式的研究员可重点看其延迟分解框架，快速理清dLLM推理效率的核心瓶颈维度，无需逐篇追踪零散文献。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on non-autoregressive LLM paradigms can focus on its latency decomposition framework to quickly identify core dLLM inference bottlenecks without tracking scattered papers.

paper.title: Saturation Makes Quantization Error Additive: A Coverage Model with a Certificate
paper.abstract: Mixed-precision quantization must decide which parts of a model to keep at higher precision. A common premise, shared by sensitivity-based methods such as HAWQ and CoopQ, is that the loss from quantizing a set of layers can be reconstructed from per-layer or pairwise sensitivities measured in isolation. We test this premise at the 4-bit weight-and-activation precisions now being deployed, treating the change in loss $f(S)$ from quantizing a layer set $S$ as a set function on the Boolean cube and

summary.core_problem: 混合精度量化中逐层敏感度能否线性叠加来预测多层同时量化的损失变化，这一前提缺乏理论与实证验证。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，从集合函数视角刻画量化误差的组合规律，为逐层敏感度方法提供理论背书与修正模型。
summary.technical_approach: 将量化损失变化视为布尔立方体上的集合函数，通过傅里叶基与 Möbius 变换两种基变换分析方差构成，提出 coverage model f(S)=c(1-∏(1-a_i)) 拟合多层量化损失。
summary.experiments: 在 4-bit 权重量化与激活量化配置下测试，发现 85-93% 的损失方差可由单层效应解释；单调变换后的单层项之和对配置排序的错配对数不超过 2%。
summary.authors_note: Joshua Hill，机构信息未明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether per-layer quantization sensitivities can be linearly combined to predict the loss of quantizing multiple layers simultaneously remains unvalidated in mixed-precision quantization.
summary_en.importance: Analytical contribution that characterizes the combinatorial behavior of quantization error as a set function, providing theoretical grounding and a corrected model for layer-wise sensitivity methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats loss change under quantization as a set function on the Boolean cube, decomposes its variance via Fourier basis and Möbius transform, and proposes a coverage model f(S)=c(1-∏(1-a_i)) to capture multi-layer quantization loss.
summary_en.experiments: Under 4-bit weight-and-activation quantization, 85-93% of loss variance is explained by per-layer effects alone; a monotone transform of summed per-layer terms misorders at most 2% of configuration pairs.
summary_en.authors_note: Joshua Hill; institutional affiliation not specified.

recommendation.zh: 量化误差近似可加的结论对混合精度策略设计有参考，但实验规模偏小，作为方法背景备查即可。
recommendation.en: The near-additivity of quantization error informs mixed-precision policy design, but experiments are small-scaled; useful as background reference only.

paper.title: RDQ: Residual Distribution Quantization for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models degrades sharply below 4-bit precision. We identify the root cause as residual stream distributional drift: quantization noise injected at each transformer layer accumulates in the shared residual representation, causing KL divergence from the FP16 baseline to grow super-linearly with depth (Pearson r=0.999 with log-perplexity, p<0.001, confirmed across all tested methods and bit-widths). We discover that 84% of LLaMA-3-8B layers exhibit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很工程化的问题：为什么 LLM 的后训练量化一旦降到 3-bit，困惑度会突然恶化，而且现有 PTQ 方法即便逐层做得很精细，仍然救不回来。全文给出的答案不是“单层权重量化误差太大”这么简单，而是残差流分布漂移。Transformer 的 residual stream 是跨层共享的，前面层的量化误差会写进后面所有层的输入分布里。于是第 l 层在校准时看到的是干净 FP16 激活，但推理时接收到的却是已经被前面量化层污染过的 drifted activation，导致校准目标和真实部署分布错位。作者把这个错位量化为层间 KL divergence，并发现累计 drift 与 log-perplexity 几乎线性相关，Pearson r=0.999。这使问题从“某层量化得不够好”转成“跨层误差如何沿 residual stream 传播并放大”。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于提出了新的训练范式，而在于它把一个长期被经验化处理的量化失败模式，拆成了可测、可预测、可干预的分布动力学问题。第一，文章给出一个很强的经验结论：控制 residual distribution drift，基本就控制了低比特 PTQ 的质量。这对后续做量化感知训练、训练期鲁棒性设计、甚至预训练阶段的激活分布整形都有启发。第二，它指出很多 PTQ 分析默认激活近似高斯，但在 LLaMA-3-8B 上 84% 层不满足这个假设，且层间方差增长达到 6548 倍，说明深层 residual 的统计性质远比常见近似更尖锐、更异质。第三，方法本身没有改 kernel，没有引入运行时开销，输出仍是标准 group-128 非对称量化格式，这让它更像一个可落地的 calibration recipe，而不是只在论文里成立的技巧。对做大模型训练的人，这篇文章的价值在于提醒：很多部署侧问题，其根因其实是训练得到的表示分布在深层网络里高度脆弱。
summary.technical_approach: 方法主体叫 RDQ，但全文真正的核心机制是 CEC，Cascaded Error Compensation，也就是顺序式、drift-aware 的校准流程。它不是重新发明量化公式，而是改了“校准时看什么分布”。标准 AWQ/GPTQ/LeanQuant 一类方法，通常对每层独立校准，并默认该层输入来自 FP16 模型的干净激活。CEC 则按层顺序处理：先量化前面层，再把校准数据跑过当前已经部分量化的模型，捕获第 l 层真实会看到的 drifted inputs，然后再用这些输入去搜索当前层的 per-channel scale。作者在实现上沿用了 AWQ 风格的重要性度量和 20 点 α 网格搜索，目标是最小化真实输出重建误差，而不是只看权重误差。一个关键细节是安全回退：α=0 也就是 plain RTN 总会被纳入候选，如果任何缩放都不优于它，就保留 s=1，避免“错误校准比不校准更差”。另一个工程点是把缩放精确折叠进前一层 RMSNorm 权重，因此推理图不变，没有额外算子。论文还利用 LLaMA block 结构，把共享同一 RMSNorm 输入的投影分成 fold group，例如 q/k/v 一组，gate/up 一组，以保证缩放折叠是严格可实现的。方法的创新不在新的量化器，而在把层间误差传播显式纳入 calibration loop，这和传统逐层独立最优的思路不同。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Mistral-7B，设置主要是 W3A16 和 W4A16。最核心的结果是 LLaMA-3-8B 上，RTN-128 从 W4 的 5.83 PPL 降到 W3 时恶化到 14.09，而作者方法在 W3 做到 7.55，相对 RTN 降低 46.4%。文中声称在所有模型-比特组合上都优于已发表基线。比结果本身更值得看的是诊断实验：1）累计层间 KL drift 与 log(PPL) 的相关系数达到 0.999，且 p<0.001，几乎把“漂移解释性能”这件事钉死；2）LLaMA-3-8B 中 84% 层经 KS test 显示非高斯；3）per-layer residual variance 随深度增长 6548 倍，说明后层对误差更敏感；4）关键消融不是比较不同 scaling 公式，而是比较 drift-aware sequential calibration 与 AWQ 的 static calibration，证明收益主要来自校准分布匹配，而不是某个特定缩放启发式。文中还提到 BOS-filtered 校准，即每个序列跳过前 8 个 token，以减少序列起始位置对激活统计的污染，这也是一个实用细节。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但建议把问题诊断部分看仔细。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 5，抓住“累计 KL drift 几乎决定 log-PPL”这个主结论。然后看方法部分里 CEC 的顺序校准流程，重点不是公式推导，而是理解为什么必须让第 l 层在‘前面层已经量化后’的输入分布上重新拟合 scale。接着看 Figure 7 和方差随深度增长的统计，理解作者为什么强调非高斯和深层敏感性。实验部分优先看与 AWQ/static calibration 的对比和安全回退 ablation，这能帮助判断收益到底来自哪里。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要内容；如果你做量化或训练稳定性，可以再深挖 RMSNorm folding、grouping 设计，以及 drift 指标是否能迁移到 activation quantization 或 QAT 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific failure mode in low-bit post-training quantization for LLMs: why quality collapses sharply at 3 bits even when per-layer quantizers are carefully tuned. The full paper argues that the main issue is not merely large local weight error, but residual-stream distribution drift. In a Transformer, the residual stream is shared across layers, so quantization noise introduced by early layers persists and changes the input distribution seen by all later layers. Standard PTQ calibrates layer l on clean FP16 activations, but at inference that layer actually receives activations already perturbed by upstream quantization. This creates a calibration mismatch between the optimization target and the deployed distribution. The paper formalizes this mismatch with layerwise KL divergence and shows that accumulated drift is almost perfectly correlated with log-perplexity, with Pearson r = 0.999. That reframes the problem from isolated layer quality to cross-layer error propagation through the shared residual pathway.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is less about a new training paradigm and more about turning an empirical deployment pain point into a measurable distributional dynamics problem. First, the paper provides a strong empirical claim: if residual distribution drift is controlled, low-bit PTQ quality is largely controlled as well. That is useful beyond PTQ, because it suggests directions for quantization-aware training, activation-distribution shaping, and robustness-oriented pretraining. Second, it shows that common Gaussian assumptions are poor approximations in modern LLMs: 84% of LLaMA-3-8B layers fail a Gaussianity test, and residual variance grows by 6,548× across depth. This means deep-layer activations are statistically heterogeneous and increasingly fragile. Third, the method preserves standard group-128 asymmetric quantization and adds no runtime overhead, so the contribution is a practical calibration recipe rather than a benchmark-only trick. For people working on pretraining and model design, the broader lesson is that many deployment failures are rooted in how brittle learned internal distributions become in deep residual stacks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is presented as RDQ, but the real mechanism is CEC, Cascaded Error Compensation, a sequential drift-aware calibration procedure. It does not invent a new quantizer; it changes what distribution each layer is calibrated on. Standard methods such as AWQ, GPTQ, and LeanQuant calibrate each layer independently under the assumption that its inputs come from the clean FP16 model. CEC instead quantizes layers in order. After layers 0..l-1 are quantized, calibration data are run through this partially quantized model, and the actual drifted inputs to layer l are captured. Those inputs are then used to fit per-channel scales for the current layer. The implementation keeps AWQ-style channel-importance scoring and a 20-point grid search over alpha, optimizing actual output reconstruction error rather than only weight-space criteria. A useful safeguard is that alpha = 0, equivalent to plain RTN, is always included; if no scaling beats it, the method falls back to s = 1. This prevents harmful overfitting during calibration. Another important engineering detail is exact scale folding into the preceding RMSNorm weights, so the inference graph and kernels remain unchanged. The paper also groups projections that share the same normalized input, such as q/k/v and gate/up in LLaMA blocks, making the folding step structurally valid. The novelty is therefore not a new quantization formula, but explicitly incorporating cross-layer drift into the calibration loop.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover LLaMA-3-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B, mainly under W3A16 and W4A16 settings. The headline result is on LLaMA-3-8B: RTN-128 degrades from 5.83 PPL at W4 to 14.09 at W3, while the proposed method reaches 7.55 at W3, a 46.4% reduction relative to RTN. The paper reports wins over published baselines across all tested model-bit combinations. More informative than the leaderboard numbers are the diagnostics: (1) accumulated layerwise KL drift correlates with log-perplexity at r = 0.999 with p < 0.001; (2) 84% of LLaMA-3-8B layers are non-Gaussian under a KS test; (3) residual-stream variance increases by 6,548× across depth, indicating much higher sensitivity in later layers; and (4) the key ablation compares drift-aware sequential calibration against AWQ-style static calibration, showing that most of the gain comes from distribution matching rather than from a particular scaling heuristic. The paper also uses BOS-filtered calibration, skipping the first 8 tokens of each sequence, which is a practical detail for stabilizing activation statistics.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but the diagnosis section is worth reading carefully. Start with the introduction and Figure 5 to understand the central claim that cumulative KL drift almost determines log-perplexity. Then read the CEC procedure with one question in mind: why must layer l be calibrated on inputs produced after earlier layers have already been quantized? After that, check the non-Gaussianity and depth-wise variance statistics to see why the authors emphasize distribution mismatch and late-layer fragility. In the experiments, prioritize the comparison against AWQ/static calibration and the fallback ablation; those tell you where the gains actually come from. Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If you work on quantization or training stability, it is worth digging further into RMSNorm folding, projection grouping, and whether the drift metric could transfer to activation quantization or QAT.

recommendation.zh: 残差流漂移的根因分析对预训练架构设计有启发，只看§3的统计分析和Fig 2的方差增长曲线即可，量化方法本身按需参考。
recommendation.en: The root-cause analysis of residual drift offers insights for pretraining architecture design — only read §3 statistical analysis and Fig 2 variance growth curves, reference the quantization method as needed.

paper.title: KV-PRM: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via KV-Cache Transfer for Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have been proven to be highly effective in guiding test-time scaling (TTS) methods, which significantly boost the capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems. However, existing PRMs are text-based: they re-encode the entire trajectory text from scratch. In long multi-agent rollouts, the scoring cost, growing quadratically with respect to sequence length L, creates a severe computational bottleneck, severely limiting PRMs' application in long-context scenarios. To r

summary.core_problem: 多 agent 和 test-time search 中，PRM 需要频繁给长轨迹打分。传统 text-based PRM 每次都重新编码完整文本，长上下文下计算成本接近甚至超过生成本身，成为搜索扩展的瓶颈。KV-PRM 解决的是“如何在不牺牲过程奖励质量的前提下，复用生成阶段已经产生的表示”。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在推理期扩展和奖励建模接口。它指出生成模型的 KV cache 不只是 serving 加速结构，也可以作为 verifier/reward model 的连续输入表示。这个方向对长链推理、multi-agent search、PRM 训练和 latent-space test-time optimization 都有启发。需要注意的是，它依赖可访问生成模型内部 KV cache，更适合自有模型栈；对黑盒 API 或 verifier 与 generator 架构不一致的场景，落地约束会更强。
summary.technical_approach: KV-PRM 不再把轨迹文本送入独立 PRM 重新 forward，而是直接读取生成阶段自然产生的 KV cache。具体做法是在序列末尾追加一个 verify token，让轻量 LoRA adapter 在已有 KV cache 条件下处理这个 token 并输出过程奖励。这样每次 scoring 的复杂度从 text PRM 的 O(L^2) 降到 O(L)，因为不需要对长度为 L 的历史序列重新做完整自注意力。论文还给出理论论证：KV cache 相比离散文本 token 每个位置有 Ω(d/log|V|) 的信息容量优势；读出深度 k 增加时，近似误差指数下降，实践中 k=1 已能提取大部分有用奖励信息。额外探索的 KV Steering 利用奖励对连续 KV 表示可微这一点，尝试对 agent 间 latent message 做梯度优化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-0.6B、4B、8B 三个规模，并在 MATH、GSM8K、AIME 上评估。KV-PRM 在多种搜索设置中能够达到或超过 text-based PRM 的效果，同时显著降低开销。论文报告典型 multi-agent 轨迹下 scoring FLOPs 最高可降约 5000 倍，墙钟 scoring latency 加速 15 到 37 倍，单序列 memory footprint 降低 34.2 倍。这些数字说明 PRM 的主要成本确实来自重复文本重编码，而不是 reward head 本身。消融的关键点是 LoRA 读出、verify token 位置、读出深度和不同模型规模下的性能保持情况。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 到 45 分钟。建议重点看方法章节中 KV-cache transfer 的接口定义：KV 来自哪一层、verify token 如何读出、LoRA adapter 是否改动 generator。理论部分可重点看容量优势和 approximation gap 的假设条件，不必逐行推导。实验部分重点看与 text PRM 的准确率对比、latency/memory 表，以及 beam search、MCTS 或 multi-agent handoff 下调用次数如何放大收益。若做自有 serving 或推理搜索系统，KV cache 生命周期和跨模块传输开销值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost of process reward modeling in multi-agent test-time scaling. Text-based PRMs re-encode the full trajectory for every scoring call, which becomes expensive for long rollouts and repeated search. KV-PRM asks whether the verifier can reuse the KV cache already produced during generation instead of reconstructing the same context from text.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the interface between inference-time scaling and reward modeling. KV cache is treated not only as a serving optimization, but also as a continuous representation for verification. This is relevant for long-context reasoning, multi-agent search, PRM-guided decoding, and possible latent-space optimization. The practical constraint is clear: the method needs access to the generator’s internal KV cache, so it fits owned model stacks better than black-box API settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: KV-PRM scores a trajectory by transferring the generator’s existing KV cache to a lightweight verifier. Instead of running a full forward pass over the decoded text, it appends a single verify token and processes that token with a LoRA-style adapter conditioned on the cached keys and values. The scoring cost drops from O(L^2) for text re-encoding to O(L), since the historical sequence is not recomputed. The paper also gives a theoretical argument that KV cache has higher representational capacity than discrete text, with a per-position advantage of Ω(d/log|V|), and that the approximation gap decays exponentially with readout depth k. A proof-of-concept KV Steering experiment explores the differentiability of cache-based rewards for optimizing latent messages between agents.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen3-0.6B, 4B, and 8B on MATH, GSM8K, and AIME. KV-PRM matches or exceeds text-based PRMs across the reported settings while reducing scoring overhead. The paper reports up to about 5000x lower scoring FLOPs in typical multi-agent trajectories, 15–37x wall-clock scoring speedups, and a 34.2x reduction in per-sequence memory footprint. The main empirical message is that repeated text re-encoding is the dominant bottleneck, and cache-based readout can preserve reward quality while removing much of that cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Read the method section carefully enough to understand the KV-cache transfer interface, the verify-token readout, and whether the generator itself is modified. In the theory section, focus on the assumptions behind the capacity and approximation-gap claims rather than the full proof. In the experiments, prioritize the PRM accuracy comparison against text PRMs, the latency and memory tables, and the settings where beam search, MCTS, or multi-agent handoffs multiply the number of PRM calls.

recommendation.zh: 核心贡献是把PRM打分复杂度从O(L²)压到O(L)，其中KV缓存信息容量严格大于文本的结论值得预训练研究员注意，读§3理论证明即可。
recommendation.en: Core contribution reduces PRM scoring complexity from O(L²) to O(L) via KV-cache reuse; the theoretical claim that KV-cache holds strictly more information than text deserves pretrain researchers' attention, read §3 only.

paper.title: Signed Symmetric Quantization for Few-Bit Integers
paper.abstract: The signed integer alphabet contains one more negative representable value than positive. Yet, by convention, the standard symmetric integer quantizer fixes its scale to be strictly positive, which assigns this extra representable value to the negative tail and can force clipping of positive outliers. In this work, we show that, at few-bit precision, such clipping is a non-trivial source of quantization error. Asymmetric quantization addresses this problem with a zero point, shifting the grid to

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但被长期忽略的量化细节：标准 signed 对称量化使用的整数码本并不真正对称，负侧比正侧多一个可表示值；而业界习惯又把 scale 固定为正数，于是这个“多出来的格点”永远分配给负尾部，导致正向 outlier 更容易被裁剪。高 bit 下这件事常被噪声淹没，但在 2-bit、4-bit 这类 few-bit 场景里，正尾裁剪会成为显著误差来源。论文要解决的问题不是重新发明 asymmetric quantization，而是在不引入 zero-point 运行时开销的前提下，尽量拿回 asymmetric grid 的端点对齐收益。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在部署和低比特训练后压缩接口，而不是预训练算法本身。它的重要性来自两个层面。第一，这是一个很“工程真实”的观察：很多量化论文把 symmetric quantization 当成理所当然的 baseline，但这个 baseline 其实带着一个约定俗成的偏置。把这个偏置修正后，低比特性能能明显改善。第二，它给出了一种很便宜的改法：不改 kernel 路径，不加 zero-point metadata，只允许 scale 取负号。对于 llama.cpp、GGUF 这类强调推理吞吐和内存的系统，这种改法有现实价值。量级上，它不是范式变化，而是一个小改动换来低 bit 明显收益的工作，尤其适合 2-bit/4-bit 权重量化场景。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法叫 signed symmetric quantization。标准对称量化在 signed q-bit alphabet 上取 z=0，并用正的 absmax scale。作者指出，既然码本本身是 {-2^(q-1), ..., 2^(q-1)-1}，那就天然有一个额外的负值格点；如果允许 scale 带符号，那么翻转 scale 的符号，就等于把这个额外格点从“保护负尾”切换成“保护正尾”。这样做仍然保持 z=0，因此部署路径仍是对称量化，不需要像 asymmetric quantization 那样在 kernel 中处理 offset，也不需要额外存 zero-point。

关键创新不只是“让 scale 可为负”，而是给出一个闭式、data-free、metadata-free 的 sign selection rule。直觉上，规则是让额外的可表示端点去对齐数据中更占主导的 outlier 方向，从而减少最坏情况下的裁剪误差。论文进一步给出理论分析：证明 worst-case ℓ2 误差界，并说明所提 sign rule 在该误差界下具有条件最优性；还证明了“scale 符号翻转”在解析上等价于“同一 signed alphabet 上做一个单位 zero-point shift”。这个等价性很重要，因为它说明该方法拿到的是一种受限的 asymmetric alignment，但运行时仍保留 symmetric deployment profile。

从系统角度看，这个方法之所以成立，是因为很多实际格式本来就把 scale 存成 signed real value；在这种情况下，额外成本几乎为零。作者还在 llama.cpp / GGUF 风格格式上实现了对应的 2-bit、4-bit 方案，用来验证它确实不是纸面技巧。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 Llama3、Qwen3、Qwen3.5 等模型家族，重点看 few-bit 权重量化下的 perplexity、few-shot accuracy recovery，以及实际部署吞吐/内存。最醒目的数字来自 Llama3 8B 的 2-bit 结果：WikiText2 perplexity 从标准正 scale 对称量化的 103.1 降到 17.8，few-shot accuracy recovery 提升 7.9 个百分点。这说明在极低 bit 下，正负尾端点分配并不是边角问题，而会主导误差。

与 asymmetric quantization 的对比也很关键。作者在 AMD EPYC Turin CPU 上测得，4-bit 对称格式相较对应的 asymmetric 格式，内存可少 9%，prefill 吞吐可高到 2.21×，decode 吞吐约 2.03×；在摘要里还给出 2-bit/整体对比的一组数字：signed symmetric 相比 asymmetric 仍保留 1.24× prefill、1.08× decode 和 14% 内存优势。也就是说，这个方法的目标不是在精度上全面超过 asymmetric，而是在保留对称部署优势的同时，尽量逼近 asymmetric 的端点对齐收益。

如果看全文，建议特别关注不同 bit-width 下收益如何变化。论文的主结论很明确：bit 越低，这个修正越重要；bit 较高时，收益会缩小，因为量化误差不再主要由单侧裁剪主导。另一个值得注意的点是，作者不仅给了 perplexity，也给了 few-shot accuracy recovery，这让结果更接近真实 LLM 使用场景，而不只是语言建模指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合快速精读。先看 Introduction，作者把问题讲得很清楚：signed alphabet 的不对称性 + 正 scale 约定，如何在低 bit 下变成系统误差。然后直接看 Section 3 的方法定义，理解 signed symmetric quantization 到底改了什么、没改什么。接着看理论部分的两个结论：一个是 worst-case ℓ2 误差界与 sign rule 的关系，另一个是 scale sign flip 与 unit zero-point shift 的等价性。最后看 Table 1 和主结果表，分别对应部署代价与精度收益。

如果你更关心工程实现，优先看 llama.cpp / GGUF 相关格式说明和 Table 1；如果更关心方法是否站得住，优先看 Theorem 4.3、Corollary 4.4、Theorem 4.6。整篇不长，30 分钟左右可以读完主线。值得深挖的点是：这种“利用码本原生不对称性”的思路，是否还能推广到 activation quantization、group-wise mixed precision，或者训练时量化感知设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a small but consequential flaw in standard signed symmetric quantization. The signed q-bit integer alphabet is not actually symmetric: it contains one more negative representable value than positive. In practice, however, symmetric quantization conventionally forces the scale to be strictly positive, so the extra endpoint is always assigned to the negative tail. At high precision this is often negligible, but at 2-bit and 4-bit it can cause substantial clipping of positive outliers and become a dominant source of error. The paper asks whether one can recover some of the endpoint-alignment benefit of asymmetric quantization without paying the runtime and metadata cost of a zero point.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly on the deployment and compression side rather than pretraining itself, but it is a useful reminder that common quantization baselines can hide arbitrary conventions. Here, a seemingly innocuous sign convention materially hurts low-bit performance. The proposed fix is attractive because it is operationally cheap: no kernel-path change, no zero-point metadata, and no loss of the symmetric inference profile. For systems such as llama.cpp and GGUF-style formats, where memory and throughput matter as much as accuracy, this is a practical contribution. It is not a new quantization paradigm, but it is a high-leverage correction for very low-bit weight quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is called signed symmetric quantization. Standard symmetric quantization uses a signed alphabet with z = 0 and a positive absmax scale. The authors observe that because the alphabet is inherently skewed by one extra negative value, allowing the scale to take either sign effectively lets that extra endpoint protect either the negative tail or the positive tail. Flipping the sign of the scale does not introduce a zero point, so the deployed format remains symmetric and avoids the offset-handling overhead of asymmetric quantization.

The main contribution is not merely allowing negative scales, but providing a closed-form sign selection rule that is data-free in deployment and metadata-free when scales are already stored as signed real values. Intuitively, the rule aligns the extra representable endpoint with the dominant outlier direction, reducing clipping-driven error. The paper also provides theory: a worst-case l2 error bound, conditional bound-optimality of the proposed sign rule, and an analytical equivalence between a scale-sign flip and a unit zero-point shift on the same signed alphabet. That equivalence is important because it clarifies what the method gains: a restricted form of asymmetric alignment while preserving the symmetric deployment path.

From a systems perspective, the proposal is compelling because many real formats already store scales as signed floating-point values. In that setting, the change is nearly free. The authors also implement corresponding 2-bit and 4-bit formats in a llama.cpp/GGUF-style setup to show that the idea survives contact with real inference code.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers model families including Llama3, Qwen3, and Qwen3.5, with metrics spanning WikiText2 perplexity, few-shot accuracy recovery, and actual deployment throughput and memory. The most striking result is on Llama3 8B at 2 bits: WikiText2 perplexity drops from 103.1 under the conventional positive-scale symmetric quantizer to 17.8 with the proposed signed symmetric variant, and few-shot accuracy recovery improves by 7.9 percentage points. That is a large effect for such a small change, and it confirms that endpoint assignment can dominate error in the ultra-low-bit regime.

The comparison to asymmetric quantization is equally important. On an AMD EPYC Turin CPU, the paper reports that a 4-bit symmetric format can use about 9% less memory and achieve around 2.21x higher prefill and 2.03x higher decode throughput than its asymmetric counterpart. The abstract also reports that the proposed signed symmetric method retains a 1.24x prefill advantage, a 1.08x decode advantage, and 14% memory savings over asymmetric quantization while substantially improving over the conventional symmetric baseline. So the goal is not to beat asymmetric quantization on every accuracy metric, but to recover much of its alignment benefit without giving up the symmetric deployment profile.

A useful pattern in the full results is that gains are largest at the lowest bit widths. As precision increases, the benefit shrinks because one-sided clipping is no longer the dominant error source. The inclusion of few-shot accuracy recovery, not just perplexity, also makes the evaluation more relevant to real LLM usage.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good paper for a fast but careful read. Start with the introduction, which explains the issue clearly: an asymmetric signed alphabet combined with a positive-scale convention creates systematic clipping bias at low bit widths. Then read the method section to see exactly what changes and what stays the same in signed symmetric quantization. After that, inspect the theory: the worst-case l2 error bound, the conditional optimality result for the sign rule, and the theorem showing equivalence to a unit zero-point shift. Finally, look at Table 1 for deployment cost and the main accuracy tables for the practical payoff.

If your focus is systems, prioritize the llama.cpp/GGUF implementation details and the throughput-memory table. If your focus is method validity, prioritize Theorem 4.3, Corollary 4.4, and Theorem 4.6. The main thread can be read in about 30 minutes. A natural follow-up question is whether the same idea can be extended to activation quantization, group-wise mixed precision, or quantization-aware training.

recommendation.zh: few-bit量化的巧妙改进，利用有符号整数的额外bin减少裁剪，做训练后量化的可重点看网格设计部分
recommendation.en: Clever tweak to symmetric quantization leveraging the extra signed integer bin; check the grid design section if working on post-training quantization.

paper.title: MOSAIC: Adaptive Inter-layer Composition for Efficient Heterogeneous Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved success using homogeneous Transformers to process multimedia data. Recent studies show that heterogeneous structures interleaving efficient mechanisms, like linear attention, improve both performance and inference latency over homogeneous designs. However, these efforts rely on handcrafted static mixing patterns, which are sub-optimal and difficult to adapt to specific hardware. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-Objective Search for Adaptive Inter-l

summary.core_problem: 异构 VLM 结构常靠人工指定不同层使用何种高效算子，难以同时适配任务性能与具体硬件延迟约束。
summary.importance: 这是一个效率与架构搜索工作。对基座预训练研究员的价值有限，但如果你关心 heterogeneous attention、硬件感知模型设计或 serving 侧结构改写，它提供了一个自动化搜索思路。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MOSAIC，把 homogeneous VLM 自动转换为 heterogeneous 架构，在统一搜索空间中混合 linear attention、sparse operator、low-rank operator 等机制，并用多目标混合整数规划在性能和延迟约束下搜索最优层间组合。为降低搜索成本，还设计了相应的近似或代理评估流程。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调在严格硬件延迟约束下，相比手工设计的静态混合模式能取得更优的性能-延迟折中，但未给出具体模型规模、硬件平台和提升幅度。更像工程优化论文，而不是会改变预训练方法论的工作。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 LiAuto Inc。未见可确认的知名基座模型作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Heterogeneous VLM architectures often rely on manually chosen layer-wise mixes of efficient operators, which are hard to optimize jointly for task quality and hardware latency.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and architecture-search paper. Its relevance to base-model pretraining is limited, but it may be useful if you care about heterogeneous attention, hardware-aware model design, or serving-time architectural adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MOSAIC automatically transforms a homogeneous VLM into a heterogeneous one. It defines a unified search space over linear attention, sparse operators, low-rank operators, and related mechanisms, then solves a multi-objective mixed-integer program to maximize downstream performance under latency constraints. The method also includes cost-reduction machinery for search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims better performance-latency trade-offs than handcrafted static mixing patterns under strict hardware constraints, but does not provide model sizes, hardware details, or exact gains. This reads more like an engineering optimization paper than a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from LiAuto Inc. No clearly identifiable foundation-model researchers can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 heterogeneous attention 或部署侧结构改写，可只看搜索空间和 latency 约束建模；否则和基座预训练主线关系不大。
recommendation.en: Only read the search-space design and latency formulation if you work on heterogeneous attention or deployment-side architecture adaptation; otherwise it is peripheral to core pretraining.

paper.title: GeoTrace: Geometry-Aware Trajectory Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Although Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have shown strong performance in video understanding, their efficiency is still limited by the large number of visual tokens. Existing video token compression methods typically rely on frame-wise saliency or heuristic token merging, which can over-focus on locally salient regions and produce ambiguous fused features. To address these issues, we propose GeoTrace, a training-free spatiotemporal token compression framework that decomposes video evid

summary.core_problem: 降低 Video LLM 输入中的视觉 token 数量，同时减少现有帧级显著性选择和启发式 token merging 带来的证据丢失与融合歧义。
summary.importance: 贡献是训练无关的视频 token 压缩框架，属于多模态推理效率方向。它不直接改预训练目标，但对长视频 VLM 的 token 预算、证据可追踪性和部署成本有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GeoTrace，将视频证据拆成两类 token：保留关键结构的 skeleton tokens，以及压缩残差信息的 traceable residual event tokens。CFPA 用上下文最远点锚定选择显著、上下文一致且覆盖率高的骨架 token；TCRC 沿一对一时间轨迹压缩残余 token，并用近流形约束降低融合歧义。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 4 个 Video LLM 和 4 个视频理解 benchmark 上评估 GeoTrace，并与现有视频 token 压缩方法比较；具体压缩率、精度保持幅度和模型名称未在摘要中完整给出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsinghua University、Yangtze Delta Region Institute of Tsinghua University 和 Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the number of visual tokens fed into Video LLMs while avoiding evidence loss and ambiguous feature fusion caused by frame-wise saliency selection or heuristic token merging.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free video-token compression framework, mainly relevant to multimodal inference efficiency. It does not directly change pretraining objectives, but it is useful for thinking about token budgets, traceable evidence, and long-video deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: GeoTrace decomposes video evidence into skeleton tokens and traceable residual event tokens. Contextual Farthest-Point Anchoring preserves salient, context-consistent, high-coverage skeleton tokens, while Trajectory-Constrained Residual Condensation compresses residual tokens along one-to-one temporal trajectories with near-manifold constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that GeoTrace is evaluated on four Video LLMs across four video-understanding benchmarks and compared against existing video-token compression methods. Exact compression ratios, accuracy retention, and model names are not fully given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tsinghua University, Yangtze Delta Region Institute of Tsinghua University, and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications.

recommendation.zh: 只看 token 选择和轨迹约束部分；这是推理侧压缩，不应被误读成 video pretrain recipe。
recommendation.en: Read only the token-selection and trajectory-constraint parts; this is inference-side compression, not a video pretraining recipe.

institutions: Yangtze Delta Region Institute of Tsinghua University
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
Yangtze Delta Region Institute, Tsinghua University

paper.title: Director: Accelerating Distributed MoE Serving via Online Proactive Expert Placement
paper.abstract: Expert parallelism has become the prevailing paradigm to serve Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Its efficiency depends on the communication and computation latencies of the GPUs, which are linked to the placement of experts in the GPUs. Existing works for optimizing expert placement focus on leveraging past requests' expert activation patterns. However, they demonstrate deficiencies facing diverse and rapidly changing request patterns, calling for an online, proactive approach. Implementing such

summary.core_problem: 解决分布式MoE模型服务中现有专家放置方法依赖历史激活模式，在请求模式快速变化时效率低下的问题
summary.importance: 系统创新，提出预测驱动的在线主动专家放置框架，提升动态请求下的MoE服务效率
summary.technical_approach: 提出Director系统，通过轻量级级联预测器或低比特量化副本预测传入请求的专家激活模式，结合在线迁移策略优化专家放置，同时考虑激活不确定性、迁移成本和优化的NP难性，最小化端到端延迟
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，未披露具体模型规模、baseline和延迟提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses low efficiency of existing expert placement methods in distributed MoE serving under rapidly changing request patterns, which rely solely on historical activation patterns
summary_en.importance: System innovation proposing a prediction-driven online proactive expert placement framework to improve MoE serving efficiency under dynamic workloads
summary_en.technical_approach: Director uses either a lightweight cascaded predictor or low-bit quantized replica to predict expert activation patterns of incoming requests, combined with online migration to optimize placement while accounting for activation uncertainty, migration cost, and NP-hard optimization complexity
summary_en.experiments: Not available due to truncated abstract; no details on model scale, baselines, or latency improvements

recommendation.zh: MoE服务的工程优化，做MoE部署的可参考预测驱动放置的思路，预训练研究员仅需了解即可
recommendation.en: Engineering optimization for MoE serving via prediction-driven expert placement; only relevant for MoE deployment teams.

paper.title: Jet-Long: Efficient Long-Context Extension with Dynamic Bifocal RoPE
paper.abstract: Modern LLMs are increasingly deployed in long-context applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, repository-level coding, and agentic workflows whose accumulated reasoning and tool traces routinely push the input an order of magnitude past the pretraining window, making zero-shot context extension the dominant deployment path for open-weight checkpoints. Most existing zero-shot methods fix a single rescaling factor up front, so an aggressive factor sacrifices short-context fidelity whi

summary.core_problem: 现有零样本长上下文扩展方法需要预先固定一个缩放因子：激进因子会损害短上下文保真度，保守因子无法支撑超长上下文；近期的长度自适应变种又依赖逐模型拟合或距离相关调度，落地成本和推理开销较高。需要一种无需调参、同时兼顾短上下文保真和长上下文扩展能力、且推理开销低的零样本上下文扩展方案。
summary.importance: 1）提出分析式推导的动态双焦点RoPE方法，无需逐模型拟合超参数，降低了长上下文扩展的落地成本；2）双窗口设计在完全保留预训练短上下文行为的同时实现长上下文零样本扩展，为预训练模型的长上下文部署提供了更优的零样本选项；3）高效的内核设计将推理开销控制在极低水平，对长上下文模型的推理系统架构设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）动态双焦点RoPE设计：保留一个本地窗口使用原生RoPE，完全复现预训练模型的短上下文行为；远程窗口的分组大小根据当前序列长度L和预训练窗口w_pretrained分析式推导：G = max(1, ⌈L / w_pretrained⌉)，确保远程位置的旋转角始终处于预训练分布内，无需逐模型调参。2）容斥式注意力合并机制，通过三次FlashAttention调用融合本地与远程窗口的注意力结果，配合实时RoPE校正旋转，生成阶段无需修改KV缓存。3）融合为单个CuTe内核，Prefill性能接近FlashAttention4，生成阶段开销不超过4%。
summary.experiments: 1）在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B三个规模的模型上测试，上下文长度最高覆盖128K；2）在RULER基准上，相比最强零样本基线分别提升4.79/2.18/2.03个百分点；3）在HELMET-RAG和PG-19困惑度测试中达到最优或持平水平；4）唯一超参数本地窗口大小w0具有鲁棒性，方法可直接迁移到Jet-Nemotron混合架构上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：第1章引言（现有方法的缺陷总结，约10分钟）、第3章方法（动态因子推导与双窗口注意力合并设计，约20分钟）、第4章实验（核心性能结果与开销分析，约10分钟）；总阅读时间约40-45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing zero-shot long-context extension methods require a fixed rescaling factor chosen upfront: an aggressive factor sacrifices short-context fidelity, while a conservative one fails at very long contexts. Recent length-adaptive variants rely on per-model fitting or distance-dependent schedules, leading to higher deployment cost and inference overhead. A tuning-free zero-shot context extension method is needed that preserves short-context fidelity, enables long-context scaling, and maintains low inference overhead.
summary_en.importance: 1) Proposes an analytically derived dynamic bifocal RoPE method that requires no per-model hyperparameter fitting, reducing the deployment cost of long-context extension. 2) The dual-window design fully preserves pretrained short-context behavior while enabling zero-shot long-context extension, providing a stronger zero-shot option for deploying pretrained models at longer context lengths. 3) The efficient kernel design keeps inference overhead extremely low, offering reference for long-context inference system architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Dynamic bifocal RoPE design: a local window retains native RoPE to exactly reproduce the pretrained model's short-context behavior; the remote window uses a group size G analytically derived from the current sequence length L and pretrained window w_pretrained: G = max(1, ⌈L / w_pretrained⌉), ensuring remote rotation angles stay within the pretrained distribution without per-model tuning. 2) Inclusion-exclusion attention merge mechanism that combines local and remote window attention via three FlashAttention passes, paired with on-the-fly RoPE correction rotation that leaves the KV cache untouched during generation. 3) Fused into a single CuTe kernel, reaching near-FlashAttention4 prefill performance and ≤4% generation overhead.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B models up to 128K context length. 2) Outperforms the strongest zero-shot baseline on RULER by +4.79/+2.18/+2.03 percentage points for the three model sizes respectively. 3) Achieves best or tied performance on HELMET-RAG and PG-19 perplexity benchmarks. 4) The only hyperparameter w0 (local window size) is robust across settings, and the method transfers unchanged to the hybrid Jet-Nemotron architecture.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Chapter 1 (summary of limitations in existing methods, ~10 min), Chapter 3 (derivation of the dynamic factor and dual-window attention merge design, ~20 min), and Chapter 4 (core performance results and overhead analysis, ~10 min). Total estimated reading time: 40–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Song Han 团队的长上下文免微调外推工作，动态双焦点 RoPE 的思路很巧妙，值得关注其 CUDA 实现细节和实际加速比。
recommendation.en: A tuning-free long-context extrapolation work from Song Han's group. The dynamic bifocal RoPE idea is clever; worth checking the CUDA implementation details and actual speedup.

paper.title: BiSCo-LLM: Lookup-Free Binary Spherical Coding for Extreme Low-Bit Large Language Model Compression
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly constrained by memory capacity, weight bandwidth, and checkpoint storage during deployment. Existing low-bit compression methods mainly follow two directions. Scalar or group-wise quantization is simple and compatible with efficient low-precision kernels, but its representation capacity becomes limited when the target budget approaches 2 bits per weight. Vector-quantized weight compression provides a richer block-level representation, but usually int

summary.core_problem: LLM极低比特（≤2bit/权重）压缩存在本质权衡：标量/组量化在2bit及以下位宽下表征能力严重不足，而向量量化（VQ）类方法需引入显式码本、索引查找操作及额外存储开销。该问题在大参数MoE模型（数百B至1T参数）的部署场景中被进一步放大——小batch自回归解码时权重从高带宽内存的搬运过程主导延迟与吞吐量，TB级的模型 checkpoint 也给多租户、边缘、端侧部署带来沉重存储负担。
summary.importance: 提出无码本的结构化压缩范式，消除了向量量化方法的码本存储、索引查找等核心部署瓶颈，同时保留了块级离散表征的强表征能力，为2bit及以下极低比特后训练压缩提供了可行路径，降低了大参数（尤其是MoE架构）预训练模型的落地门槛。其「权重方向比幅值更关键」的球面表征设计思路，可反哺预训练阶段的权重正则化设计，引导预训练权重更适配结构化低比特编码；无码本块级离散表征的思路，也可迁移到预训练阶段的权重离散化、稀疏化架构探索中。
