summary.technical_approach: BiSCo-LLM是一套无需显式码本的后训练量化框架，核心基于二元球面编码设计，包含三个关键组件：1）局部权重分块：将权重划分为固定大小的局部块而非单个标量处理，平衡表征粒度与计算效率；2）球面映射：将每个权重块归一化到单位超球面，优先保留对LLM输出质量更关键的权重向量方向信息（而非幅值）；3）结构化二元球面编码：通过超球面的固定结构化划分规则，将每个归一化权重块编码为二元码，无需学习码本、最近邻索引查找及对应的存储开销。与现有方法相比，它避免了标量量化在≤2bit位宽下的表征天花板，也消除了AQLM、VPTQ等向量量化方法的额外系统开销。
summary.experiments: 提供的全文片段仅包含引言部分，未披露具体实验设置与结果。从研究定位推断，实验将围绕2bit及以下极低比特压缩场景展开，对比标量量化基线（GPTQ、AWQ、SpQR、SqueezeLLM等）与向量量化基线（AQLM、VPTQ等），覆盖稠密与MoE架构的主流LLM，评估指标包括权重重构误差、困惑度、下游任务精度、存储占用、内存带宽利用率、小batch解码延迟等。
summary.reading_guide: 优先泛读方法章节，明确三个核心组件的具体实现，尤其是球面映射的归一化策略、二元编码的结构化划分规则、无码本端到端编解码流程；再阅读实验章节的位宽消融实验、不同模型规模（7B、70B、MoE）的性能对比、系统级延迟/带宽测试结果；重点关注该方法与向量量化方法的开销差距、与标量量化方法在≤2bit位宽下的性能差距。预计阅读时间30-45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Extreme low-bit (≤2 bits per weight) LLM compression faces a fundamental tradeoff: scalar/group-wise quantization suffers from insufficient representational capacity near or below 2 bits, while vector quantization (VQ) based methods require explicit codebooks, index lookup operations, and extra storage overhead. This problem is amplified by deployment constraints of large-scale MoE LLMs (hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters), where weight movement from high-bandwidth memory dominates latency and throughput in small-batch autoregressive decoding, and terabyte-scale checkpoints create heavy storage burdens for multi-tenant, edge, and on-device scenarios.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a codebook-free structured compression paradigm that removes the key deployment bottleneck of VQ methods while retaining the strong representational capacity of block-level discrete representations. It provides a feasible post-training compression path for ≤2-bit regimes, reducing deployment costs of large pretrained models (especially MoE architectures). Its core insight of prioritizing weight direction over amplitude can inform pretraining regularization design to make weights more compatible with structured low-bit encoding, and the codebook-free block-level discrete representation idea can be extended to weight discretization and sparsification exploration during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: BiSCo-LLM is a post-training quantization framework built on codebook-free binary spherical coding, with three core components: 1) Local weight chunking: weights are split into fixed-size small blocks instead of being processed as individual scalars, to balance representational granularity and computational efficiency. 2) Spherical mapping: each weight chunk is normalized to the unit hypersphere to prioritize directional information of weight vectors, which is empirically more critical for preserving LLM output quality than amplitude. 3) Structured binary spherical coding: each normalized chunk is encoded into binary codes via fixed, structured partitioning of the hypersphere, eliminating the need for learned codebooks, nearest-neighbor index lookup, and associated storage overhead. Compared to existing methods, it avoids the representational ceiling of scalar quantization at ≤2 bits, and removes the extra system overhead of VQ-based methods like AQLM and VPTQ.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text fragment only includes the introduction section, with no specific experimental settings or results disclosed. Per the research scope, experiments are expected to cover ≤2-bit compression regimes (e.g., 2-bit, 1.5-bit, 1-bit), compare against scalar quantization baselines (GPTQ, AWQ, SpQR, SqueezeLLM) and VQ baselines (AQLM, VPTQ) on mainstream dense and MoE LLMs, and evaluate metrics including weight reconstruction error, perplexity, downstream task accuracy, storage footprint, memory bandwidth utilization, and small-batch decoding latency.
summary_en.reading_guide: First skim the method section to understand the concrete implementation of the three core components, especially the normalization strategy for spherical mapping, the structured partitioning rule for binary coding, and the end-to-end codebook-free encoding/decoding workflow. Then review the experiment section for bit-width ablation studies, performance comparisons across different model scales (7B, 70B, MoE), and system-level latency/bandwidth measurements. Focus on the overhead gap with VQ methods and the performance gap with scalar quantization at ≤2 bits. Estimated reading time: 30-45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看方法和存储 accounting 即可；若实测不含端到端 kernel 吞吐，2bit 结论只能算压缩率信号。
recommendation.en: Read the method and storage accounting; without end-to-end kernel throughput, the 2-bit result is mainly a compression signal, not a serving result.

paper.title: The Key to Going Linear: Analysis-Driven Transformer Linearization
paper.abstract: The quadratic cost of causal self-attention severely bottlenecks long-context transformer inference. While numerous post hoc linearization pipelines exist, it is difficult to identify which components preserve model quality. This work isolates the effect of state update design in a strict frozen-backbone regime. We show that softmax relies on key-dependent, rank-1 orthogonal projections, elucidating why delta-style networks outperform purely gated accumulation. We identify a potential source of

summary.core_problem: 现有对预训练Transformer做事后线性化的方法，通常同时叠加LoRA、滑动窗口、蒸馏等多种干预，无法剥离出真正决定注意力近似质量的核心设计；在严格冻结预训练主干的条件下，哪种线性状态更新能最好逼近softmax注意力，一直缺乏清晰、受控的结论。
summary.importance: 给出了一套不需要从头预训练即可将大模型转换为线性注意力的可复用设计准则，澄清了delta类更新优于纯门控累积的几何原因，结论在最高32B参数的LLaMA、Qwen模型上验证，对长上下文推理落地有实际参考；严格冻结主干的实验设置排除了混杂变量，比此前堆叠多种无消融干预的工作结论更干净、可复现性更强。
summary.technical_approach: 采用严格受控的实验范式：预训练主干权重完全冻结，仅训练注意力替换模块引入的少量新参数，排除其他调优手段的干扰。通过一阶近似推导证明：softmax注意力天然实现了依赖key的秩1正交投影，处理新query时会将状态中和历史key对齐的分量减掉，这一矫正步骤恰好是delta规则的核心机制；纯门控线性注意力（GLA）使用与key无关的固定衰变，缺失了这一几何矫正环节，因此近似误差更大。针对识别出的误差来源，补充三个结构性修正：1）独立的滑动窗口分支处理近场token；2）引入sink token承载注意力的全局常值分量；3）通过短卷积或小参数量LoRA对Q/K/V做极少量适配，弥补线性机制的表达缺口。
summary.experiments: 在7B到32B参数规模的LLaMA、Qwen模型上测试：严格冻结主干条件下，基于delta更新的Gated Delta Net近似效果显著优于核方法线性注意力、纯门控的GLA；叠加三个结构性修正后，MMLU等通用任务性能超过此前的事后线性化基线，长上下文检索性能与复杂的自适应token缓存方案相当；在混合注意力架构下性能保持稳定，32B规模未出现效果崩塌。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节的一阶近似分析（无需逐行推导数学，抓住delta更新与纯门控的核心几何差异：秩1投影矫正即可），以及第4节的消融实验（对应每个结构性修正解决的具体误差类型），跳过细碎的工程实现细节，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post hoc transformer linearization methods typically bundle LoRA, sliding-window attention, distillation, and other interventions together, making it impossible to isolate which design choices actually determine approximation quality. There is no clear, controlled evidence for which linear state update best approximates pretrained softmax attention when the backbone is kept strictly frozen.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a reproducible set of design rules for converting pretrained LLMs to linear-time attention without retraining from scratch, validated up to 32B parameters on LLaMA and Qwen backbones. The geometric explanation for why delta-style updates outperform pure gated accumulation resolves a long-standing design ambiguity in linear attention, with direct practical value for long-context inference deployment. The strict frozen-backbone evaluation eliminates confounding variables, producing cleaner, more reproducible conclusions than prior work that stacks multiple unablated interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a tightly controlled experimental setup: all pretrained backbone weights are frozen, and only the small set of new parameters introduced by the attention replacement module are trained, removing interference from other tuning methods. A first-order approximation analysis shows that softmax attention naturally implements key-dependent rank-1 orthogonal projections: when processing a new query, the mechanism subtracts state components aligned with historical keys, the exact correction step implemented by delta rules. Pure Gated Linear Attention (GLA) uses key-independent decay, missing this critical geometric correction and incurring larger approximation error. Guided by the identified error sources, three structural fixes are added: (1) a disjoint sliding-window path for local nearby tokens, (2) sink tokens to capture global constant components in attention, (3) minimal Q/K/V adaptation via short convolutions or small LoRA modules to close remaining expressiveness gaps.
summary_en.experiments: Across LLaMA and Qwen models from 7B to 32B parameters, delta-based Gated Delta Net delivers consistently stronger approximation than kernelized linear attention and pure gated GLA under the strict frozen-backbone setting. Adding the three structural fixes outperforms prior post hoc linearization baselines on MMLU and other general tasks, while matching the long-context retrieval performance of complex adaptive token caching frameworks. Performance remains stable in hybrid attention configurations, with no quality collapse at 32B scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the first-order approximation analysis in Section 3 (no need to work through all mathematical derivations; the core takeaway is the geometric difference between delta updates and pure gated accumulation around rank-1 projection correction), and the ablation study in Section 4 mapping each structural fix to a specific error source. Skip low-level implementation details. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 冻结骨干下的线性化误差分析很扎实，sink token与固定预算缓存路由可直接复现到预训练长上下文 ablation 中，重点看§3和§4.2
recommendation.en: The error analysis under frozen backbone is solid; sink token and fixed-budget cache routing can be directly replicated in long-context pretraining ablations; focus on §3 and §4.2

paper.title: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B: Compressing Hybrid MoE LLMs
paper.abstract: We present Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B, a compressed variant of Nemotron-3-Super optimized for interactive deployment. We designed the model to maximize server throughput under high user throughput constraints. In interactive serving workloads on a single 8xB200 node, Puzzle-75B-A9B achieves approximately 2x higher server throughput than Nemotron-3-Super at matched user throughput constraints. In ultra-long-context deployment on a single H100 GPU, the compressed model increases 1M-token concu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是混合 MoE 大模型在真实交互式服务中的压缩问题。难点不只是把总参数量变小，而是同时压低 active parameters、KV-cache、Mamba state、专家路由开销和解码阶段 IO 压力，并且要在不同负载形态下仍保留父模型的推理、代码、长上下文和 agentic 能力。论文把目标明确落到两个部署场景：单个 8×B200 节点上的交互式服务，以及单张 H100 上的百万 token 超长上下文并发。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏工程但对基座模型研究有直接参考价值的压缩报告。贡献不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于给出了一套面向混合 MoE 架构的部署约束驱动压缩流程。它把 Nemotron-3-Super 从 120.7B total / 12.8B active 压到 75.3B total / 9.3B active，同时在目标服务点获得约 2× server throughput，并把单 H100 上 1M-token 请求并发从 1 提到 8。对预训练研究的启发在于：模型架构的有效容量不能只用参数量衡量，长上下文服务时 KV-cache 和状态空间大小会直接改变可用架构；MoE 压缩也不能简单做均匀缩放，层间敏感性和专家使用模式需要进入压缩目标。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是两阶段流程：先做结构压缩，再做能力恢复。结构压缩使用 Iterative Puzzle。它不是一次性剪枝，而是在多个中间架构之间迭代推进：每轮先做硬件感知的结构压缩，再用短程知识蒸馏恢复表示。这样可以减少单步大幅压缩导致的表示漂移，也能让后续压缩根据已经改变的内部结构重新估计层重要性。压缩维度包括三类：一是对 MoE routed experts 做非均匀 channel pruning；二是非均匀减少 active experts；三是剪 Mamba 层的 SSM state size。这里的关键取舍是非均匀分配容量：敏感层保留更多宽度或状态，冗余层承担更多压缩，而不是按同一比例裁掉所有层。能力恢复阶段结合中长上下文知识蒸馏、面向软件工程和 agentic reasoning 的 RL post-training、FP8/NVFP4 混合精度量化，以及 Multi-Token Prediction head 用于推测解码。方法的特点是把压缩、蒸馏、RL、量化和解码头放在同一个部署目标下优化，而不是分别报告单点技巧。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了两个主要部署结果。第一，在单个 8×B200 节点的交互式服务中，Puzzle-75B-A9B 在匹配用户侧吞吐约束时，相比 Nemotron-3-Super 获得约 2× server throughput；目标 operating point 是每个用户至少 100 tokens/s。作者分别考虑了 50K/2K 的 prefill-heavy 场景，以及 8K/64K 的 decode-heavy 场景，用来覆盖长文档/RAG 和长输出推理两类负载。第二，在单张 H100 的超长上下文部署中，压缩后模型把 1M-token 请求并发从父模型的 1 个提升到 8 个，主要来自参数、KV-cache 和 Mamba state 占用下降。模型规模从 120.7B total / 12.8B active 降到 75.3B total / 9.3B active。论文还和 Nemotron-3-Nano 30B total / 3.5B active 做了服务效率比较：在考虑 Nano 输出更啰嗦的情况下，Puzzle-75B-A9B + MTP 在 100 TPS 用户吞吐下可完成接近 Nano without MTP 的请求数，同时保持接近 Super 的能力。能力评测覆盖 reasoning、coding、multilingual、long-context 和 agentic benchmarks，但给出的材料中没有逐项 benchmark 数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分的 Iterative Puzzle 流程、结构压缩目标和部署约束定义。重点看三处：第一，如何度量层重要性并决定非均匀专家/channel/state 压缩；第二，短程 KD 为什么插入到每轮压缩之间，而不是压完后一次性恢复；第三，吞吐曲线如何随 input/output ratio、MTP、量化和上下文长度变化。对做预训练或模型架构的人，最有价值的是它把“训练后的可压缩性”转化为架构设计信号：哪些层、专家和状态对能力敏感，哪些资源在长上下文服务中先成为瓶颈。对做 serving 的人，则应重点看 8×B200 交互吞吐和单 H100 1M-context 并发设置，因为这两组实验直接说明压缩目标为何不能只看 perplexity 或单一 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses deployment-oriented compression for hybrid MoE LLMs. The hard part is not merely reducing total parameter count. The compressed model must also reduce active parameters, KV-cache footprint, Mamba state memory, routing cost, and decode-time IO pressure while preserving reasoning, coding, long-context, multilingual, and agentic capabilities. The target settings are concrete: interactive serving on a single 8×B200 node and million-token long-context workloads on a single H100 GPU.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering-heavy but research-relevant compression study for frontier-scale base models. Its main contribution is a deployment-constrained compression recipe for hybrid MoE architectures, rather than a new language-modeling objective. Nemotron-3-Super is compressed from 120.7B total / 12.8B active parameters to 75.3B total / 9.3B active parameters. The reported gains are large at the system level: about 2× higher server throughput at the matched user-throughput operating point, and 1M-token concurrency on a single H100 increases from 1 request to 8 requests. For pretraining researchers, the important message is that usable model capacity is not well described by parameter count alone. KV-cache size, recurrent state size, and input/output length ratios can dominate the feasible architecture in production.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages: structural compression followed by capability recovery. The structural stage uses Iterative Puzzle, a sequential version of the Puzzle framework. Instead of compressing the model in one large step, it alternates hardware-aware structural compression with short knowledge-distillation recovery phases. This allows each compression step to account for representation drift and inter-layer dependencies introduced by earlier steps. The compressed dimensions include heterogeneous channel pruning of routed MoE experts, heterogeneous reduction of active experts, and pruning of the SSM state size in Mamba layers. The main design choice is non-uniform capacity allocation across depth: sensitive regions keep more capacity, while more redundant regions are compressed harder. The recovery stage combines medium- and long-context knowledge distillation, RL post-training for software-engineering and agentic reasoning tasks, mixed FP8/NVFP4 inference, and a Multi-Token Prediction head for speculative decoding. The novelty is in optimizing these components under explicit serving constraints rather than treating pruning, distillation, quantization, and decoding acceleration as independent tricks.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports two central deployment results. In interactive serving on a single 8×B200 node, Puzzle-75B-A9B reaches roughly 2× the server throughput of Nemotron-3-Super at matched user-throughput constraints, with the target operating point set at at least 100 tokens per second per user. The evaluation covers both a prefill-heavy 50K/2K input/output regime and a decode-heavy 8K/64K regime. In ultra-long-context deployment on a single H100 GPU, the compressed model raises 1M-token concurrency from 1 request to 8 requests by reducing parameter memory, KV-cache pressure, and Mamba-state footprint. The model size changes from 120.7B total / 12.8B active to 75.3B total / 9.3B active. The paper also compares against Nemotron-3-Nano with 30B total / 3.5B active parameters: after accounting for Nano’s higher generation verbosity, Puzzle-75B-A9B with MTP completes a similar number of requests per minute at 100 TPS user throughput while retaining near-Super quality. The provided material states broad preservation across reasoning, coding, multilingual, long-context, and agentic benchmarks, but does not include all per-benchmark numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the compression methodology and the deployment evaluation carefully. The key parts are the Iterative Puzzle loop, the layer- and expert-level importance signals used for heterogeneous pruning, and the throughput curves under different input/output regimes. The most useful question to track is why short KD phases are inserted between compression steps instead of recovering only after a single aggressive pruning pass. Also inspect how MTP, mixed-precision inference, and context length interact with server throughput. For base-model researchers, the paper is useful because it turns post-training compressibility into an architecture signal: it reveals which parts of a hybrid MoE model are capacity-critical and which parts mainly create serving cost.

recommendation.zh: Nvidia 关于混合 MoE 模型压缩的集大成之作，联合优化了 MoE 剪枝、Mamba 剪枝、蒸馏和 MTP，对后训练和高效推理架构设计有极高参考价值，必读其 pipeline 设计。
recommendation.en: Nvidia's comprehensive work on compressing hybrid MoE models, jointly optimizing MoE/Mamba pruning, distillation, and MTP. Highly valuable for post-training and efficient inference architecture design. Must read the pipeline design.

paper.title: Sangam: Efficiently Serving Diffusion LLMs with the AR Stack
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked response and can commit multiple output positions per model invocation. Their bidirectional attention prevents exact autoregressive-style KV caching, since committing one position shifts the KV activations of all others. Approximate caching techniques such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache refresh KV activations repeatedly and reuse them across intervening decodes, inducing a repeated prefill/decode structure. This makes

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 diffusion LLM 在并发服务中的系统问题。dLLM 通过反复去噪一个 mask response 区域生成文本，可以一次提交多个位置，但双向注意力使 AR 模型中精确 KV cache 的假设失效。已有近似 KV cache 方法会形成反复 prefill/decode 的执行模式，而现有 AR serving 栈不能直接套用。
summary.importance: 对预训练和新型语言建模研究的价值在于，它把 diffusion LM 的建模差异落到了服务约束上。dLLM 的训练目标和注意力模式不同，不只影响单请求生成速度，也改变 batching、KV cache、prefill/decode 切分和 GPU 调度。若 diffusion LM 要成为 AR LM 的实际替代方案，服务栈是否能支撑高并发和稳定延迟是关键约束。该工作有助于判断 diffusion LM 的系统可行性，而不是只看单样本解码步数。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先分析 cached dLLM 与 AR serving 的三个错配。第一，decode 粒度不同：AR decode 每次每请求贡献一个 query token，而 blockwise dLLM decode 会处理一个 response block，并且仍要 attend 到 prompt 和 response 上下文，因此 batch size 增大后 decode 代价增长更快。第二，prefill 不只发生在请求到达时；Fast-dLLM、dKV-Cache 等近似缓存方法会在 block boundary 或 cache refresh point 反复触发 prefill。第三，prefill/decode 的工作比例随请求状态、负载和采样策略变化，固定 GPU 分区容易产生空闲容量。Sangam 的方向是复用 AR serving 中的连续 batching、prefill/decode 管理和 KV 管理思想，但按 dLLM 的块级 decode、重复 prefill、双向注意力不可 chunked prefill 等特点重新组织调度。
summary.experiments: 从给出的正文可确认的实验信息主要是定性系统测量：论文指出 dLLM decode iteration time 随并发 decode 数增长更快，少量并发 decode 就可能使 GPU compute 和 memory bandwidth 接近饱和；继续扩大 decode batch 对吞吐的帮助有限。工作还以 Fast-dLLM 和 dKV-Cache 这类近似缓存执行模式为背景，分析 repeated prefill/decode 对调度的影响。具体吞吐、延迟、GPU 数量和相对提升幅度需要看实验章节的 trace-based serving 结果与 baseline 对比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 和系统动机部分，重点看 cached dLLM 为什么不同于 AR serving：decode 是 block-sized，prefill 会周期性回流，双向注意力阻止 chunked prefill。之后看 scheduler 设计、prefill/decode 资源分配策略和 KV 管理部分。实验部分优先看吞吐-延迟曲线、不同并发负载下的 GPU 利用率、与 vLLM/AR-style serving 改造 baseline 的对比，以及 Fast-dLLM、dKV-Cache 两种缓存策略下是否稳定。预计阅读 40–60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses efficient concurrent serving for diffusion language models. Masked diffusion LMs generate by repeatedly denoising a fixed response region and can commit multiple positions per model call. Because attention is bidirectional, exact AR-style KV caching is invalid: once a position is committed, the activations of other positions may change. Approximate caching methods create a repeated prefill/decode execution pattern, but the standard AR serving stack does not directly fit this pattern.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for pretraining and alternative language modeling research because it exposes the serving consequences of the diffusion LM objective and attention pattern. Diffusion LMs should not be evaluated only by single-request generation speed or number of denoising iterations. Their viability also depends on batching behavior, cache refresh cost, prefill/decode interference, and GPU placement under load. This is an important systems constraint for judging whether diffusion LMs can compete with AR models in practical deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper identifies three mismatches between cached dLLM execution and AR serving. First, decode cost has a different shape: an AR decode step adds one query token per request, while a blockwise dLLM decode processes a response block while attending over the prompt-response context. Decode time therefore grows much faster with batch size. Second, prefill is recurring and request-dependent. Methods such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache periodically refresh KV states at block boundaries or cache refresh points, so requests move back and forth between prefill and decode. Third, fixed prefill/decode disaggregation can strand capacity because the balance between phases changes with request progress, load, and sampling behavior. Sangam adapts AR serving ideas such as continuous batching, phase management, and KV-cache organization, but reorganizes them around block-sized dLLM decode, repeated refreshes, and the fact that bidirectional prefill cannot be chunked in the same way as causal AR prefill.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text gives the key qualitative measurement: dLLM decode iteration time rises quickly with the number of concurrent decodes, and only a small number of active decodes can saturate GPU compute and memory bandwidth. Larger decode batches therefore do not provide the same throughput benefit as in AR serving. The experimental setup is framed around cached dLLM methods such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache, where repeated prefill/decode phases dominate scheduling behavior. Exact throughput, latency, GPU-count, and relative-improvement numbers should be taken from the system evaluation section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and motivation first. The most important concepts are block-sized decode, recurring prefill, the impossibility of AR-style chunked prefill under bidirectional attention, and the instability of fixed prefill/decode partitioning. Then read the scheduler design, resource-allocation policy, and KV-management sections. In the evaluation, focus on throughput-latency curves, GPU utilization under different loads, comparisons against AR-style serving baselines, and whether the results hold for both Fast-dLLM-like and dKV-Cache-like execution. Expected reading time is 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM推理服务的首个系统化方案，调度设计有参考价值；做dLLM推理效率的研究者可重点看§3调度器设计。
recommendation.en: First systematic serving solution for diffusion LLMs; scheduler design is informative. Researchers working on dLLM inference efficiency should focus on §3 scheduler design.

paper.title: Variable Bit-width Quantization: Learning Per-Group Precision for "Bigger-but-Smaller" Language Models
paper.abstract: Low-bit quantization shrinks language models but treats precision as a single global hyper-parameter: every weight uses the same bit-width. We introduce Variable Bit-width Quantization (VBQ), a training-time method in which each contiguous group of 64 weights learns its own resolution from {1,2,4,8} bits via a Gumbel-Softmax relaxation, trained jointly by an alternating optimization that gives the precision logits a clean, task-aligned signal. VBQ discovers a consistent, strongly heterogeneous a

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是：低比特量化通常把整个模型或整层绑定到统一 bit-width，但真实模型里不同权重组对精度的敏感性差异很大，固定分配会浪费预算，也限制了“更大参数量但更小存储”的设计空间。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发不在于单个量化技巧，而在于它把 bit allocation 变成可学习对象，而不是部署阶段的手工格式选择。更重要的是，作者给出一个很强的经验结论：如果模型从训练开始就原生适应异构低比特表示，那么平均约 1.8 bit 的权重预算也能支撑比均匀 4-bit 更好的质量/容量折中。这对低成本预训练、量化感知训练、以及“参数量扩张换精度缩减”的 scaling 设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 VBQ。它把每 64 个连续权重作为一个 group，为每组学习一个离散 bit-width，候选集合是 {1,2,4,8}。bit 选择通过 Gumbel-Softmax 松弛成可微形式，与模型权重联合训练。难点在于，如果直接端到端优化，任务损失经量化器传回的梯度会远大于 bit-budget 正则，precision logits 基本不会动，最后 bit 分配停在初始化附近。

作者用了两个关键设计。第一是 gradient isolation：在计算 bit-selection 路径时，对重构权重做 detach，阻断交叉熵损失直接更新 precision logits，只让 logits 主要接收与 bit 选择相关的干净信号。第二是 alternating optimization：交替进行权重更新步和精度分配更新步，类似把“学表示”和“学资源分配”拆开。实验显示这样 precision logits 才会真正收敛到离散决策，而不是停留在软分布。

另一个重要发现是，训练出来的分配模式很快稳定，约在训练前 20% 就基本锁定。于是作者进一步把搜索结果蒸馏成固定 recipe：例如大部分 block 用统一 2-bit，首个 FFN block 保留 4-bit，LM head 按词频分层分配更高精度。也就是说，Gumbel 学习主要用于发现结构，最终部署不一定需要保留复杂的自适应机制。
summary.experiments:
核心结果有三类。第一，学到的 bit 分配高度异构，而且异构性发生在层内、甚至同类投影内部，而不只是“某些层高精度、某些层低精度”。整体上 69% 的 group 收敛到 1-bit，平均 bit-width 约 1.78。LM head 平均约 1.09 bit，但高频词相关部分会保留更高精度。

第二，作者强调 bigger-but-smaller。一个 131M 的 VBQ 模型，平均 1.82 bit、总大小 29MB，能在 perplexity 上超过 55M 的 FP16 模型，而后者大小是 109MB。更大的例子里，1.46B 参数模型用同样 recipe，在 FineWeb-Edu 上可以匹配 593M FP16 control，同时参数量约 2.5× 更大，但总存储预算约 3.7 bit/weight 级别。这里传达的信息是：在固定内存预算下，扩大参数量并原生训练到低比特，可能比训练一个更小的高精度模型更划算。

第三，recipe transfer 是成立的。自适应搜索得到的分配在早期就稳定，冻结成固定量化方案后，效果接近在线学习版。这说明论文的主要贡献不只是一个训练时技巧，也包括发现了可复用的精度分配规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和方法部分前半，抓住两个问题：为什么统一 bit-width 不够；为什么 precision logits 会被主任务梯度淹没。然后看训练算法图或伪代码，理解 gradient isolation 和 alternating optimization 如何配合。实验部分优先看三张结果：bit 分配直方图/分层统计、bigger-but-smaller 主表、以及 recipe freeze/transfer 结果。若只想判断是否值得跟进，20 到 30 分钟足够；若关心低比特预训练，可再细看不同模块的敏感性分析，尤其是 LM head、首层 FFN、attention output projection 的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a limitation of standard low-bit quantization: bit-width is usually fixed globally or by coarse heuristics, even though different weight groups have very different sensitivity to precision. That wastes memory budget and limits the design space for models that are larger in parameter count but smaller in storage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is not a single quantization trick, but the shift from hand-designed precision formats to learned bit allocation. More interestingly, the paper argues that if a model is trained natively under heterogeneous low-bit constraints, an average budget around 1.8 bits per weight can support a better quality-size tradeoff than uniform low-bit compression applied after the fact. That has implications for quantization-aware pretraining, memory-constrained scaling, and recipes that trade precision for parameter count.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VBQ assigns each contiguous group of 64 weights a learnable bit-width chosen from {1, 2, 4, 8}. The choice is relaxed with Gumbel-Softmax so it can be optimized jointly with the network. The core optimization problem is that task gradients flowing through the quantizer dominate the bit-budget signal by orders of magnitude, causing the precision logits to stay near initialization.

The paper addresses this with two mechanisms. First, gradient isolation: reconstructed weights are detached along the bit-selection path, preventing the main cross-entropy loss from directly overwhelming the precision logits. Second, alternating optimization: weight updates and precision updates are interleaved, so representation learning and precision allocation are optimized on cleaner timescales. Together, these changes let the bit-selection variables actually commit to discrete allocations.

A notable empirical finding is that the learned allocation stabilizes early, around the first 20% of training. The authors then distill the learned pattern into a fixed recipe, such as mostly 2-bit blocks, a higher-precision first feed-forward block, and a frequency-tiered LM head. This means the adaptive search is useful not only as a deployment method, but also as a way to discover reusable quantization structure.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical takeaways. First, the learned precision allocation is strongly heterogeneous, and the heterogeneity appears within projection types, not just across layers. About 69% of groups collapse to 1 bit, with an average precision of roughly 1.78 bits. The LM head averages around 1.09 bits, while a minority of more sensitive groups retain 4- or 8-bit precision.

Second, the paper makes a bigger-but-smaller argument. A 131M model at 1.82 bits on average, occupying 29MB, outperforms a 55M FP16 model that occupies 109MB. At a larger scale, a 1.46B model using the same recipe matches a 593M FP16 control on FineWeb-Edu while using a storage budget in the roughly 3.7 bits-per-weight regime. The practical message is that, under a fixed memory budget, training a larger model natively at low precision can be better than training a smaller high-precision model.

Third, recipe transfer works. Since the learned bit assignments stabilize early, freezing them into a fixed quantization recipe reproduces most of the adaptive method’s gains. That suggests the paper contributes both an optimization method and a structural observation about where precision matters in decoder-only LMs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, read the introduction and the first half of the method section. Focus on two questions: why uniform bit-width is too restrictive, and why precision logits fail under naive end-to-end optimization. Then inspect the training algorithm or pseudocode to understand how gradient isolation and alternating optimization interact.

In the experiments, prioritize the allocation histograms or per-module precision statistics, the main bigger-but-smaller comparison table, and the recipe-freezing results. Those are enough to judge whether the method is only a search procedure or whether it reveals a reusable low-bit training recipe. A 20 to 30 minute read is enough for triage. If low-bit pretraining is your main interest, spend extra time on the sensitivity analysis for the LM head, the first FFN block, and attention output projections.

recommendation.zh: 位宽分配的稳定规律有参考价值，只看§4的权重分组位宽分布统计即可，方法本身对超大模型的可扩展性待验证
recommendation.en: Stable bit-width allocation patterns are informative; only read §4 per-group precision statistics, method scalability to very large models remains unproven

paper.title: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
paper.abstract: Many everyday programming tasks resist clean rule-based implementation, such as alerting on important log lines, repairing malformed JSON, or ranking search results by intent, and are increasingly outsourced to large language model APIs at the cost of locality, reproducibility, and price. We propose fuzzy-function programming: compiling such a function from a natural-language specification into a compact, locally-executable neural artifact. We instantiate this paradigm with Program-as-Weights (P

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的提示工程，而是一个更底层的问题：很多真实软件函数并不适合用显式规则写出来，但又不值得为每次调用都去请求一个大模型 API。像日志告警、脏文本解析、模糊匹配、意图排序、JSON 修复这类任务，规则系统太脆，直接调大模型又贵、不可复现、难本地部署。论文提出把“函数规格”编译成一个可本地执行的神经程序，让模糊函数像普通软件模块一样被保存、分发和调用。核心难点有三个：一是如何把自然语言规格稳定地转成可执行行为，而不是只靠一次性 prompt；二是如何让很小的解释器承接复杂任务；三是如何构造足够大、足够多样的训练数据，让“编译器”学会从规格到参数高效映射。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在范式层面，而不只是一个应用系统。它把“模型参数”从通用能力载体，进一步变成“程序表示”，把一次性推理开销前移到编译阶段。这和传统 AR 语言模型每次都在线推理不同，更接近“预训练基座 + 任务编译 + 本地解释执行”的分层结构。对小模型研究尤其重要：论文显示 0.6B 解释器配合编译出的程序，可以达到甚至超过直接提示 32B 模型的效果，说明一部分原本依赖大模型上下文推理的能力，可以被离线蒸馏进任务特定参数中。对预训练方向的启发有三点。第一，PEFT 不只是适配工具，也可以作为程序中间表示。第二，数据集不再只是训练通用模型，也可以训练“从规格到权重”的编译器。第三，离线编译与在线执行分离后，模型能力、部署成本、可复现性之间出现了新的权衡空间。这类思路和 hypernetwork、weight generation、in-context learning 外化为参数更新，都有直接关系。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，PAW 由三个部件组成：伪程序生成器、LoRA 编译器、冻结解释器。整体流程不是让一个模型直接根据规格输出答案，而是先把规格整理成更稳定的中间表示，再生成任务专属参数，最后由小模型执行。

第一步是 pseudo compiler。它使用一个未训练的 4B Qwen3，通过固定模板把用户规格改写成 pseudo-program。这个 pseudo-program 由两部分组成：一段更清晰、去歧义的任务重述，以及少量输入输出示例。这样做的原因很直接：原始用户描述常常含糊、冗余、带 typo，直接拿来生成权重不稳定；先做一次离散化重写，相当于把自然语言规格投影到更规整的任务空间。

第二步是 LoRA compiler。这是论文真正训练的核心模型，也是一个 4B Qwen3 级别编译器。它读取原始规格和 pseudo-program，然后输出一组可注入解释器的 LoRA 参数。论文把这一步看成“从任务描述到神经二进制”的编译。相比前作用 prefix-tuning KV cache 作为程序表示，这一版改用 text-to-LoRA。作者明确比较后认为 LoRA 更强，因为它不是只在输入侧加条件，而是直接改变解释器内部线性层的行为，控制粒度更细，容量也更高。

第三步是 interpreter。解释器是冻结的小模型，主实验用 Qwen3-0.6B。运行时输入包括用户样本 x、pseudo-program 的离散部分，以及编译得到的 LoRA。也就是说，程序是“离散 token + 连续参数”的混合体。作者强调这个混合设计不是实现细节，而是关键抽象：离散部分负责鲁棒地表达任务语义，连续部分负责补足文本无法精确指定的行为边界。

训练数据方面，论文发布了 FuzzyBench，规模 1000 万样本，分 29 个主题版本，覆盖 800 多类模糊文本任务，包括分类、格式转换、解析、模糊匹配、自然语言命令、agent 工具使用等。数据是逐步扩展构建的，目标不是单一 benchmark，而是覆盖“可由自然语言规格定义、但难以用规则精确实现”的函数空间。这个数据设计很关键，因为编译器学的不是某个任务，而是从规格泛化到新任务的映射。

从建模角度看，PAW 和直接 instruction tuning 的区别在于：它不把所有任务都压进一个统一前向过程，而是显式生成任务特定权重；和元学习或 ICL 的区别在于：任务适配结果被固化成可保存、可版本化的程序文件；和普通 LoRA 微调的区别在于：LoRA 不是通过梯度优化得到，而是由编译器一次前向生成。这使它更像 hypernetwork 驱动的条件参数化系统。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果是主性能与成本对比。论文报告，Qwen3-0.6B 解释器执行 PAW 程序，在 exact match 上达到 73.78%，高于直接 prompt Qwen3-32B 的 68.70%。同时推理内存大约只有后者的五十分之一。这个结果说明，针对这类模糊函数，离线编译出的任务参数可以显著放大小模型能力，而不是只能做轻量近似。

部署侧数字也比较具体：量化后，共享解释器基座约 430MB GGUF，每个程序 LoRA 约 23MB，MacBook M3 上可跑到约 30 tokens/s。论文还给了更轻路径：一个 GPT-2 级别解释器可以通过 WebAssembly 完全在浏览器端运行。这些数字说明作者不是只做概念验证，而是把“程序可分发”当成一等目标。

案例实验覆盖五类任务：输出分诊、定制分类、模糊搜索重排、agent 预处理、创意生成。其中 agent preprocessing 在 ToolCall-15 上达到 93%。这部分的意义不在于单点 benchmark，而在于证明 PAW 不只适合分类或抽取，也能处理带工具选择和前处理逻辑的任务。

论文还展示了模态泛化：只替换编译器为视觉语言模型，保持解释器不变，就能把图像条件任务也编译成 PAW 程序。这说明程序表示并不依赖纯文本输入，编译器可以承担跨模态规格理解，解释器继续做统一执行。

从消融角度，摘要里已明确提到 prefix-tuning 与 LoRA 两种程序形式，LoRA 更优。结合全文设定，可以推断作者重点验证了三件事：一是 pseudo-program 是否提升稳定性与泛化；二是连续程序表示选型对性能的影响；三是解释器规模与编译器规模的分工。最值得注意的实验信号不是绝对分数，而是“冻结 0.6B + 编译 LoRA”能跨过“直接提示 32B”的门槛，这说明任务专属参数化在某些函数族上比通用大模型在线推理更有效率。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Programs as Weights 的定义部分，先把作者要建立的抽象吃透：这里的 program 不是 prompt，也不是训练后的 checkpoint，而是“伪程序 + PEFT 参数”的混合可执行物。这个定义如果没抓住，后面容易把它误读成普通 adapter 生成。

然后重点看 compile pipeline。要看清 pseudo compiler 为什么不训练、LoRA compiler 为什么单独训练、解释器为什么冻结。这里体现了作者对系统边界的划分：把语义清洗、参数生成、任务执行拆成三个不同难度层级。

实验部分优先看主表里和 direct prompting、不同模型尺寸、不同程序表示的比较。尤其关注 0.6B interpreter 对 32B direct prompting 的结果，这决定了这篇工作的成立程度。再看 case studies，判断它到底是在少数 benchmark 上奏效，还是确实覆盖了一类软件函数。

如果要深挖，最值得追的问题有四个。第一，FuzzyBench 的任务分布是否足够代表真实“模糊函数”空间，是否存在模板化偏置。第二，LoRA compiler 生成的参数是否具有可解释结构，比如不同任务族是否落在可分簇的低秩子空间。第三，pseudo-program 与 continuous weights 的职责边界能否进一步量化。第四，这种 compile-time specialization 与 test-time reasoning 的替代关系在哪里失效，比如长链推理、开放式生成、强组合泛化任务是否仍需要大模型在线思考。带着这几个问题读，会比只看分数更有收获。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a software-level gap that current LLM usage only patches awkwardly: many real functions are easy to describe but hard to encode as crisp symbolic rules, while calling a large remote model for every invocation is expensive, non-local, and hard to reproduce. Examples include log triage, malformed JSON repair, fuzzy parsing, intent-aware ranking, and semantic reranking. The core problem is how to turn a natural-language task specification into a compact executable artifact that can run locally on a small frozen model, without retraining that model per task. This requires solving three coupled issues: stabilizing noisy user specifications, generating task-specific behavior with enough capacity, and training a compiler that generalizes from specs to executable parameters across a broad family of fuzzy functions.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mostly architectural and paradigm-level. PAW reframes weights as a program representation, not just a repository of general capability. Instead of paying inference-time reasoning cost on every input, it shifts substantial work to compile time: a larger compiler maps a task spec into a small task-specific adapter, and a lightweight interpreter executes it repeatedly. That is a meaningful alternative to the standard autoregressive pattern of “one general model, one prompt, one forward pass per request.” The reported result that a 0.6B interpreter plus compiled adapters can match or exceed direct prompting of a 32B model suggests that some capability currently expressed as online contextual reasoning can be externalized into offline task specialization. For pretraining, this opens several directions: PEFT modules as executable intermediate representations, datasets for spec-to-weight compilation rather than only next-token prediction, and a cleaner separation between universal pretrained competence and compiled task-local behavior. It also connects naturally to hypernetworks, conditional weight generation, and the question of when in-context learning can be converted into persistent parameter updates.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PAW consists of three components: a pseudo-compiler, a LoRA compiler, and a frozen interpreter. The system is not just prompting a model with a better template; it explicitly compiles a task into a hybrid neural program.

Stage 1 is the pseudo-compiler. An off-the-shelf 4B Qwen3 model, kept untrained, rewrites the user specification into a pseudo-program. This pseudo-program contains a cleaned task restatement plus a handful of input-output examples. The motivation is practical: raw user specs are ambiguous, verbose, typo-prone, and often unstable as direct conditioning signals. The rewrite step creates a more canonical discrete representation of the task before any weight generation happens.

Stage 2 is the LoRA compiler, the main trained component. It is also built on a 4B Qwen3-scale model. Given the original spec and the pseudo-program, it emits a LoRA adapter to be injected into the interpreter. This is the actual “program binary.” The paper positions this as a shift from text-only task conditioning to generated parameterization. Compared with the authors’ earlier prefix-tuning-based precursor, the current version uses text-to-LoRA and reports better performance. That choice matters: prefix tuning mainly conditions through the input side, while LoRA changes internal linear transformations of the interpreter and therefore offers finer control and more representational capacity.

Stage 3 is the interpreter, a frozen small LM, with Qwen3-0.6B as the main instantiation. At execution time, the interpreter receives the input x, the discrete pseudo-program tokens, and the compiled LoRA. So the program is explicitly hybrid: a discrete component for semantic anchoring and a continuous component for behavioral precision. The paper argues that this split is not incidental. The discrete part protects against ambiguity in the original spec, while the continuous part captures nuances that text alone cannot pin down reliably.

Training relies on FuzzyBench, a 10M-example dataset released with the paper. It is built incrementally across 29 thematic versions and covers more than 800 categories of fuzzy text tasks, including classification, format conversion, parsing, fuzzy matching, natural-language commands, and agentic tool use. This dataset is central because the compiler is not learning one task family; it is learning a mapping from task descriptions to executable task-specific parameterizations.

Conceptually, PAW differs from standard instruction tuning because it does not force all tasks through a single shared forward policy. It differs from ordinary LoRA finetuning because the adapter is not obtained by gradient descent per task, but generated in one shot by a compiler. And it differs from pure in-context learning because the adaptation result is persistent, versionable, and distributable as a file.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is the main accuracy-cost tradeoff. The paper reports that a Qwen3-0.6B interpreter running PAW programs reaches 73.78% exact match, outperforming direct prompting of Qwen3-32B at 68.70%, while using roughly one fiftieth of the inference memory. That is the key empirical claim: for this family of fuzzy functions, offline task compilation can be more effective than repeatedly invoking a much larger general model.

Deployment numbers are also concrete. In quantized form, the shared interpreter base is about 430MB in GGUF format, and each compiled program is about 23MB as a LoRA adapter. The system runs at around 30 tokens per second on a MacBook M3. The paper also describes a smaller GPT-2-based path that runs fully client-side in the browser via WebAssembly. These details matter because the work is making a systems claim about software packaging and local execution, not only a modeling claim.

The case studies cover output triage, custom classification, fuzzy search reranking, agent preprocessing, and creative generation. The agent preprocessing setup reaches 93% on ToolCall-15. The point is not a single benchmark win, but evidence that PAW is not limited to narrow label classification; it can also support tasks with tool-selection and preprocessing structure.

The paper further shows modality generality: by replacing only the compiler with a vision-language model and keeping the same interpreter, PAW can handle image-conditioned fuzzy tasks. That suggests the executable representation is not tied to text-only specifications; cross-modal understanding can be absorbed by the compiler while execution remains unified.

On ablations, the abstract already states that LoRA outperforms prefix-tuning as the program form. The most important experimental signal is not the absolute score itself, but the fact that a frozen 0.6B interpreter plus generated task weights can cross the performance level of direct prompting on a 32B model. That strongly supports the paper’s central thesis about compile-time specialization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the formal definition of Programs as Weights. The key thing to internalize is that the “program” here is neither a prompt nor a finetuned checkpoint in the usual sense. It is a hybrid executable object: pseudo-program tokens plus PEFT parameters. If that abstraction is missed, the rest can look like ordinary adapter generation.

Then read the compile pipeline carefully. Focus on why the pseudo-compiler is left untrained, why the LoRA compiler is trained separately, and why the interpreter is frozen. Those design boundaries reveal the authors’ decomposition of the problem into semantic normalization, parameter synthesis, and execution.

In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison tables against direct prompting, model scale, and alternative program representations. The 0.6B interpreter versus 32B direct prompting result is the central validation point. After that, read the case studies to judge whether the method covers a genuine class of software functions rather than a narrow benchmark slice.

For deeper study, four questions are worth tracking. First, whether FuzzyBench adequately represents the real distribution of fuzzy functions or contains templated biases. Second, whether generated LoRAs have interpretable structure, for example clustering by task family in a low-rank subspace. Third, how much responsibility is carried by the pseudo-program versus the continuous adapter. Fourth, where compile-time specialization stops being enough and online reasoning is still necessary, such as long-horizon reasoning, open-ended generation, or strong compositional generalization. Reading with those questions in mind will make the paper much more useful.

recommendation.zh: 打破了大模型能力下沉必须依赖逐token推理或梯度蒸馏的固有认知，应在内部复现自然语言到adapter的编译流程，探索其对预训练目标设计的启发。
recommendation.en: Breaks the implicit assumption that LLM capability transfer to small models requires per-token inference or gradient distillation; reproduce the NL-to-adapter pipeline internally and explore its implications for pretraining objective design.

paper.title: Spec-AUF: Accept-Until-Fail Training under Train-Inference Misalignment for Masked Block Drafters
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting a block of tokens that the target model verifies left-to-right, committing only the longest accepted prefix. Block (DLM-style) drafters predict the whole block in parallel, which is fast but trained with a full-block cross-entropy that supervises every position against the gold continuation -- even though inference discards every token after the first rejection. Recent acceptance-aware objectives patch this by reweighting the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 speculative decoding 里一个很具体但很关键的训练—推理错配问题：对于 masked/block-style drafter，训练时通常对整个 block 的每个位置都做交叉熵监督，但推理时 target verifier 只会接受从左到右连续正确的最长前缀，一旦前面某个 token 错了，后面即使预测对也全部作废。也就是说，现有 full-block loss 奖励了很多对吞吐没有贡献的“后缀正确”。作者提出 AUF（Accept-Until-Fail），目标是让训练信号更贴近 verifier 的 prefix contract。
summary.importance: 这项工作的意义主要在推理加速和训练目标设计，而不是基座预训练本身。它对 pretrain 研究者的启发在于：当模型训练目标和部署时真正关心的 utility 不一致时，简单的 token-level CE 往往会把梯度花在错误位置。AUF 给了一个很干净的例子：不是再去手工调 position decay，而是直接把监督支持集截断到“首个错误”为止。这个思路对 block drafter、并行解码、甚至某些 any-order 生成器的训练目标设计都有参考价值。贡献量级属于工程上有用、概念上也清楚，但范围较窄，主要服务于 speculative decoding 这一子问题。
summary.technical_approach:
作者的出发点是 teacher forcing 的类比。AR drafter 在训练时，第 i 个位置天然条件于 gold prefix，因此位置 i 的监督只在前缀正确这个条件下才有意义。mask-only 的 block drafter 没有这个输入侧条件通道，因为整个 block 是并行预测的；于是作者把“前缀条件”搬到 loss 侧近似。

具体做法是：先让 block drafter 对一个长度 B 的 block 给出并行预测，然后从左到右找到第一个预测错误的位置。AUF 只保留从开头到这个首错位置的 gold cross-entropy，后面所有位置的 loss 全部 mask 掉。也就是说，accepted prefix 和 first failing token 仍然受监督，失败点之后的 token 不再训练。保留 first failing token 这一点很重要，因为 verifier 的吞吐不仅取决于已接受前缀长度，也取决于模型能否尽快把失败点修正到 target policy 上。

作者把 AUF 放在两类已有方法之间比较。第一类是 DFlash 这类 full-block masked CE，再加一个手工设计的位置衰减 prior，假设越靠前越重要。第二类是 GRIFFIN / D-PACE 这类 acceptance-aware 目标：前者会在 earlier token 不在 Top-K 时截断或降权，后者则继续保留 full-block support，但用软权重近似 prefix 条件。AUF 的区别有两点。其一，它用 exact first-error truncation，而不是 Top-K membership 这种较粗的代理条件；其二，它直接改变 loss support，而不是在全 support 上再叠一层位置权重。

从方法判断上看，AUF 的优点是简单、无额外模型结构、几乎不引入新超参，还能把原来手工设定的 decay-rate γd 去掉。代价是训练信号更稀疏，尤其在早期模型还不准时，后半 block 可能长期拿不到监督。因此阅读时要留意作者是否讨论了 warmup、curriculum 或训练早期稳定性问题。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比较直接。作者在 Qwen3-8B 目标模型设置下，报告 AUF 相比 DFlash 的 decayed-CE baseline，在六个评测基准上都提升了接受长度 τ。文中还强调，这个改进不仅出现在 DFlash 单头 block drafter 上，也能迁移到 Domino 的 two-branch head，说明收益不完全依赖某个具体 drafter 结构。

另一个重要结果是：在 DFlash 上，一旦采用 AUF，把原本的指数位置衰减继续保留在截断后的 support 内，并不会进一步提升 τ；六个 benchmark 上都基本不变。这个结果支持作者的核心论点：真正重要的是“监督到哪里为止”，而不是在全 block 上人为规定一个前重后轻的权重曲线。换句话说，AUF 让 hand-designed position prior 变得多余。

作者还拿 GRIFFIN 风格的 Top-3 prefix mask 作对照。D-PACE 曾报告这种基线在 block drafter 上不如 decayed CE，而本文指出问题不在 prefix-aware 思路本身，而在 Top-3 这个 AR 场景里常用的判据不适合 mask-only block drafter。exact-match 的首错截断反而在这里有效。这一点很有信息量，因为它说明 acceptance-aware supervision 不能从 AR drafter 直接平移到并行 block drafter。

摘要和正文片段里没有给出完整数值表，因此无法在这里复述具体提升幅度、block size、训练 token 数和 wall-clock 成本。正式阅读时应重点补齐：τ 的绝对值和相对提升、不同 benchmark 的一致性、是否影响 target-equivalent correctness、以及训练收敛速度是否变化。
summary.reading_guide:
先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，把 verifier 的接受规则、τ=A+1 的实现定义、以及 DFlash 的训练—推理错配想清楚。只要这部分理解了，AUF 的动机就很自然。

然后重点看方法节里 AUF 的精确定义。要确认三个细节：首错位置是按 argmax 还是采样 token 判定；first failing token 为什么保留监督；训练时是否对不同 block position 做归一化，避免有效 token 数变化带来 loss scale 漂移。

实验部分建议先看主结果表，再看 ablation。最值得关注的是“AUF + decay 与纯 AUF 几乎无差别”这一组，因为它直接决定这篇工作的判断是否成立。其次看 Domino 迁移结果，判断它到底是 loss 设计的普适收益，还是只对 DFlash 生效。

如果只想判断是否值得采用，读主文方法节和两张核心表，大约 20 分钟。若要真正落地到 serving 系统，还需要细看实现细节、训练稳定性和不同 block size 的附录。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific train–inference mismatch in speculative decoding for masked or block-style drafters. During training, these drafters are usually optimized with full-block cross-entropy, supervising every position in the drafted block against the gold continuation. But at inference, the target verifier only accepts the longest left-to-right correct prefix; once an early token is wrong, all later drafted tokens are discarded even if they are individually correct. So the standard loss spends gradient on suffix tokens that do not contribute to throughput. AUF is proposed to align training supervision with this prefix-based verification contract.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-acceleration paper rather than a core pretraining paper, but the lesson is broader: when deployment utility depends on structured events such as accepted prefixes, plain token-level CE can place supervision in the wrong places. AUF is a clean example of replacing a hand-designed positional prior with a support set determined by the model’s own first failure. That idea is relevant beyond speculative decoding wherever parallel prediction is evaluated through a sequential acceptance rule. The contribution is useful and conceptually tidy, though narrow in scope.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central intuition comes from teacher forcing. In an autoregressive drafter, the loss at position i is naturally conditioned on a gold prefix on the input side, so supervising later positions makes sense only under the event that earlier positions are already correct. A mask-only block drafter has no such input-side conditioning channel because all block positions are predicted in parallel. AUF approximates that missing prefix conditioning on the loss side.

Concretely, the drafter predicts a block of length B in parallel. The method then scans from left to right, finds the first prediction error, and keeps gold cross-entropy only up to that point. The accepted prefix and the first failing token remain supervised; all later positions are masked out of the loss. Keeping the first failing token is important because throughput depends not only on accepted-prefix length but also on correcting the earliest mismatch that breaks verification.

The paper positions AUF against two existing families. One is DFlash-style full-block masked CE with a hand-designed positional decay prior, which encodes the heuristic that earlier positions matter more. The other is acceptance-aware training such as GRIFFIN and D-PACE: GRIFFIN truncates or downweights based on Top-K prefix criteria, while D-PACE keeps full-block support and uses soft weights to approximate prefix conditioning. AUF differs in two ways: it uses exact first-error truncation rather than a coarse Top-K proxy, and it changes the support of the loss rather than merely reweighting all positions.

Methodologically, AUF is attractive because it is simple, architecture-light, and removes a tuned decay hyperparameter. The obvious trade-off is sparser supervision, especially early in training when first errors occur near the beginning of the block. While reading, it is worth checking whether the paper discusses warmup behavior, curriculum effects, or optimization stability under this sparser signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claim is straightforward: under a Qwen3-8B target setup, AUF improves the acceptance-length metric τ over the decayed-CE DFlash baseline on all six evaluated benchmarks. The paper also reports that the gain transfers from DFlash to Domino’s two-branch head, which suggests the effect is not tied to one specific drafter architecture.

A particularly important result is that once AUF is used on DFlash, retaining the original exponential positional decay within the truncated support does not further improve τ on any of the six benchmarks. This directly supports the paper’s thesis: what matters is where supervision stops, not a manually chosen front-heavy weighting curve over the whole block. In other words, AUF makes the hand-designed positional prior redundant in the tested setting.

The paper also contrasts AUF with a GRIFFIN-style Top-3 prefix mask. Prior work had reported that such a baseline underperforms decayed CE on block drafters. The authors argue that this does not invalidate prefix-aware supervision itself; rather, Top-K membership is an AR-oriented criterion that transfers poorly to mask-only block drafting. Exact first-error truncation works better in this setting. That is a useful negative-to-positive comparison because it shows that acceptance-aware objectives do not transfer mechanically from AR drafters to parallel block drafters.

The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so the exact margins, block sizes, training budgets, and wall-clock trade-offs should be checked in the main results section. The most important details to extract are absolute and relative τ gains, consistency across benchmarks, any effect on target-equivalent correctness, and whether convergence speed changes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and preliminaries. Make sure the verifier’s acceptance rule, the implementation-specific definition τ = A + 1, and the DFlash train–inference mismatch are fully clear. Once that is in place, the motivation for AUF becomes almost self-evident.

Then read the method section carefully. Three details matter: whether the first error is defined by argmax or sampled predictions, why the first failing token is still supervised, and whether the loss is normalized to account for the varying number of active positions after truncation.

In the experiments, first inspect the main comparison table, then the ablations. The most informative ablation is the one showing that AUF plus positional decay is essentially the same as AUF alone, because that is the strongest evidence that support truncation, not hand-tuned weighting, is doing the work. The transfer result to Domino is the next thing to check, since it speaks to generality.

For a quick decision on whether the idea is worth trying, the method section plus the main tables should take about 20 minutes. For actual deployment, the appendices on implementation details, training stability, and block-size sensitivity are likely necessary.

recommendation.zh: 解决block drafter训练-推理错位的思路干净直观，做推测解码的话重点看§3方法设计即可。
recommendation.en: Clean, intuitive approach to block drafter train-inference misalignment; for speculative decoding work, focus on §3 method design.

institutions: Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University

paper.title: Generic Expert Coverage for Pruning SparseMixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models contain substantial structured redundancy among routed experts, but pruning them without downstream calibration data remains challenging. Existing expert-pruning methods typically rely on a single aggregated importance score, which can bias the retained set toward experts favored by dominant calibration patterns. We propose \textbf{Generic TB-Coverage}, a coverage-aware expert pruning method that uses only generic text corpora (WikiText

summary.core_problem: 稀疏MoE大模型在无下游校准数据的场景下做专家剪枝时，现有单聚合重要度分数的排序方法会偏向主导校准模式对应的专家，丢弃那些在特定通用语料上关键但平均得分不高的专家，导致剪枝后模型泛化能力受损。
summary.importance: 提出了一种仅依赖通用文本语料的覆盖感知剪枝方法，无需下游数据和微调，为MoE预训练模型的轻量化压缩提供了更鲁棒的方案，对MoE模型的部署效率优化有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是Generic TB-Coverage方法，流程分为四步：1）在WikiText2和C4两个通用语料上，分别统计每个专家的REAP风格效用分数（结合路由权重与专家输出范数）；2）为每个语料生成独立的专家重要性排名；3）通过轮询规则从各语料排名中交替选择受保护专家，保障跨语料的能力覆盖；4）合并受保护专家集合后，移除排名最低的未受保护专家以达到目标保留比例。整个过程不需要模型微调。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B和DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base两个开源MoE模型上测试，覆盖25%、50%、75%三种专家保留比例。主指标为6个零样本基准（ARC-Challenge、ARC-Easy、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande、BoolQ）的平均准确率，辅助测试MMLU、GSM8K、Math500。该方法在所有保留比例下均优于单分数排序的剪枝基线，同时发现单种子随机剪枝基线在稀疏MoE场景下方差大、结果具有误导性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计15分钟。重点关注方法部分的轮询覆盖规则设计，以及实验部分跨模型、跨保留比例的一致性结果。附录中关于随机剪枝方差的分析和不同语料下专家效用分布的对比也值得浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Expert pruning of sparse MoE language models without downstream calibration data suffers from systematic bias when using single aggregated importance scores: experts critical for specific generic corpora but with moderate average scores tend to be discarded, degrading the pruned model's generalization.
summary_en.importance: A coverage-aware pruning method that relies solely on generic text corpora and requires no fine-tuning provides a more robust approach for post-pretraining MoE compression, with practical value for optimizing MoE deployment efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is Generic TB-Coverage, a four-step procedure: 1) Compute per-expert REAP-style utility scores (combining router weight and expert output norm) independently on two generic corpora, WikiText2 and C4; 2) Generate separate expert importance rankings for each corpus; 3) Select protected experts via a round-robin rule across corpus-specific rankings to ensure cross-corpus capability coverage; 4) Merge protected experts and remove the lowest-ranked unprotected ones to meet the target retention budget. No model fine-tuning is required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two open-source MoE models — Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B and DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base — at 25%, 50%, and 75% expert retention budgets. The primary metric is average accuracy across six zero-shot benchmarks (ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande, BoolQ), with MMLU, GSM8K, and Math500 as auxiliary tests. The method outperforms single-score ranking baselines across all retention ratios. The paper also finds that single-seed random pruning baselines have high variance and can be misleading in sparse MoE settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~15 minutes. Focus on the round-robin coverage rule design in the method section, and the consistent cross-model, cross-retention-budget results in experiments. The appendix analysis of random pruning variance and per-corpus expert utility distributions is also worth browsing.

recommendation.zh: MoE剪枝无需下游数据的实用方案，规避了单重要性打分的模式偏差问题，直接看Table 2不同保留率下的零样本对比即可
recommendation.en: Practical downstream-free MoE pruning method that avoids the pattern bias of single importance scores; just check Table 2 for zero-shot comparisons across retention rates

paper.title: SAB-LVLM: Significance-Aware Binarization for Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, yet their enormous parameter scale and cross-modal computation incur substantial memory and latency overhead, severely limiting real-world deployment on resource-constrained devices. Binarization offers an attractive solution by drastically reducing storage and computational costs. However, existing binarization methods neglect the varying importance of weights across different layers and modaliti

summary.core_problem: 降低大型视觉语言模型在存储、显存和推理延迟上的开销，同时尽量减少二值化带来的性能损失。
summary.importance: 这是 LVLM 压缩与高效部署论文，贡献在于把权重重要性按层和模态区分处理；对预训练本身不是直接推进，但对多模态模型的部署约束和模态敏感参数分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAB-LVLM，即 significance-aware binarization。方法基于文本和视觉输入构造 Hessian 矩阵，估计不同层、不同模态权重对任务输出的影响，再据此决定哪些权重需要更谨慎地优化或保留，以缓解统一二值化导致的关键模态权重损伤。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LVLM backbone、参数规模、数据集、baseline 或提升数值；实验目标是相对已有二值化方法降低存储和计算成本，同时保持多模态理解性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces memory, storage, and latency costs of large vision-language models while limiting the accuracy loss caused by binarization.
summary_en.importance: This is an LVLM compression and deployment paper. Its contribution is treating weight importance as layer- and modality-dependent; it does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal model deployment and modality-sensitive parameter analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAB-LVLM introduces significance-aware binarization. It constructs Hessian matrices from textual and visual inputs to estimate the importance of weights across layers and modalities, then uses this signal to avoid damaging modality-critical parameters during binarization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the LVLM backbones, model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against existing binarization methods in the storage-compute versus multimodal-understanding trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 作为 LVLM 二值化备查即可；真正可看的点是 Hessian 重要性是否揭示了模态层间脆弱性。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an LVLM binarization reference; the only interesting signal is whether Hessian importance exposes modality-layer fragility.

paper.title: Beyond Activation Alignment:The Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff in Task-Aware LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) has become a key technique for deploying large language models under stringent memory and compute constraints. We first identify a phenomenon that we term the Perplexity Illusion: layers ranked as important by perplexity-based sensitivity show little rank correlation with those that are most influential for complex reasoning performance, with Kendall $τ\approx 0$ in our analysis. We further reveal an Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff: using only target-task calibrat

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后训练混合精度量化流程默认采用两个未在现代LLM上验证的假设：一是困惑度（PPL）可以作为所有下游能力层敏感度的可靠代理，二是仅用通用域或仅用目标任务域校准数据就足以完成准确的敏感度度量。两个假设在面向推理任务的部署场景下均不成立，且朴素的任务对齐校准反而会降低量化后性能。
summary.importance: 两个核心观察修正了任务感知量化中常见的流程设计偏差：一是基于PPL的层敏感度排序和推理能力的敏感度排序几乎不相关，说明PPL作为能力代理指标在层粒度上存在系统性偏差；二是纯任务校准数据虽然激活对齐度高，但会导致表征坍缩，混合通用域数据才能稳定敏感度估计。这两点既指导实际量化部署——平均3.5bit精度即可达到传统4bit均匀量化性能，压缩率提升12.5%，也为理解LLM内部分层功能提供了量化证据：输入/输出层主要支撑流畅token预测，中间层承载多步组合推理，对模型结构设计、剪枝策略、预训练评估指标选择都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 通过逐层量化扰动实验验证了两个核心现象：1）困惑度错觉（Perplexity Illusion）：PPL测量得到的敏感层集中在输入嵌入层和输出投影层，而数学、科学推理任务对应的敏感层位于网络中间块，二者排序的Kendall τ≈0，统计上无相关性；2）对齐-多样性权衡（Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff）：仅用目标任务数据做校准时，校准用的Hessian矩阵估计方差大，容易引发表征坍缩；混入一定比例通用域数据可以正则化敏感度估计，保护模型的泛化流形，但混合比例随模型和任务变化，不存在固定通用的最优值。在此基础上提出TASA双层混合精度框架：数据层面用免训练的梯度迹对齐搜索，确定通用域和任务域校准数据的最优混合比，仅需|A|+1次前向传播，额外成本极低；网络层面提出多目标聚合（MOA）指标，融合PPL和推理任务的敏感度信号，将层间比特分配建模为背包结构的整数线性规划问题，用动态规划求精确解，层内再通过二阶显著性做分组粒度的精度调整。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B两个模型上测试，覆盖推理、常识、语言建模共8个基准。LLaMA-3-8B上，平均3.5bit精度的TASA模型对齐多个4bit均匀量化基线的总性能，比特消耗减少12.5%，保留FP16模型总精度的97.2%；Qwen2.5-7B上，3.75bit的TASA模型保留FP16性能的99.1%。数学推理任务上提升明显，GSM8K上比均匀3bit基线高20个点以上。消融实验验证了单独使用PPL指标、或单独使用任务校准数据都会带来明显性能下降，最优混合比不存在通用固定值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节两个现象的实证证据，尤其是不同能力对应的层敏感度分布对比，以及校准数据混合的消融结果，这两部分对理解模型内部能力分布最有价值。TASA的框架设计可以快速浏览，不需要深究比特分配的动态规划求解细节。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) pipelines for LLMs operate on two unvalidated assumptions for modern models deployed on reasoning tasks: that perplexity (PPL) is a reliable proxy for per-layer sensitivity across all downstream capabilities, and that calibration data drawn solely from either the general domain or the target task domain is sufficient for accurate sensitivity estimation. Both assumptions fail in practice, and naive task-aligned calibration often reduces post-quantization performance.
summary_en.importance: Two core observations correct common biases in task-aware quantization design. First, PPL-based layer sensitivity rankings have near-zero correlation with sensitivity for complex reasoning, showing that PPL is a systematically biased proxy for capability at layer granularity. Second, pure task-specific calibration causes representation collapse despite better activation alignment, while mixing in general-domain data stabilizes sensitivity estimates. Beyond practical deployment gains — 3.5-bit average precision matching standard 4-bit quantization with 12.5% lower bit cost — these results provide quantitative evidence for LLM functional specialization: input/output layers primarily support fluent token prediction, while middle layers carry multi-step compositional reasoning. This is relevant to model architecture design, pruning strategies, and pre-training evaluation metric selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematic layer-wise quantization perturbation experiments first validate two core phenomena: (1) The Perplexity Illusion: PPL-sensitive layers concentrate at input embeddings and output projections, while reasoning-critical layers lie in the middle network blocks, with a Kendall τ ≈ 0 rank correlation between the two orderings. (2) The Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff: exclusive task-domain calibration produces high-variance Hessian estimates and representation collapse, while mixing in general-domain data regularizes sensitivity estimation to protect the generalization manifold, though the optimal mixing ratio varies across models and tasks with no universal heuristic. The proposed TASA framework operates on two levels: at the data level, a training-free gradient trace alignment search finds the optimal general/task calibration data ratio in |A|+1 forward passes with negligible overhead. At the network level, a Multi-Objective Aggregation metric fuses PPL and reasoning sensitivity signals; inter-layer bit allocation is formulated as a knapsack integer linear program solved exactly via dynamic programming, with intra-layer bit refinement via second-order saliency-based group assignment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are run on LLaMA-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B across 8 benchmarks spanning reasoning, commonsense, and language modeling. On LLaMA-3-8B, 3.5-bit average precision matches multiple 4-bit uniform quantization baselines with 12.5% fewer bits, retaining 97.2% of FP16 aggregate accuracy. On Qwen2.5-7B, 3.75-bit TASA retains 99.1% of FP16 performance. Gains are particularly large on mathematical reasoning, with over 20 points improvement over uniform 3-bit baselines on GSM8K. Ablations confirm that using PPL alone or pure task calibration both cause significant performance drops, with no fixed universally optimal mixing ratio.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for empirical evidence of the two core phenomena, especially the layer sensitivity distribution across capabilities and calibration data mixing ablations — these are the most transferable insights for understanding LLM internal organization. Skim the TASA framework design; the dynamic programming solver details for bit allocation are not necessary unless implementing MPQ systems. Expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Perplexity Illusion的发现很有启发性——量化时只看perplexity会误导，对做训练后量化的研究员有直接参考，重点看§3的现象分析。
recommendation.en: The Perplexity Illusion finding is insightful—relying solely on perplexity for quantization can be misleading; directly useful for researchers working on post-training quantization; focus on §3 phenomenon analysis.

paper.title: Post-Training Pruning for Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated impressive performance in image generation but suffer from substantial computational overhead and resource consumption. Post-training pruning offers a promising solution; however, due to DiTs' unique architectural design and parameter distribution, traditional pruning methods are inapplicable, leading to significant performance degradation. Specifically, prior methods developed for LLMs, which derive metrics through a series of approximations, ampl

summary.core_problem: 扩散Transformer（DiT）计算开销大，传统后训练剪枝方法因DiT架构特性与参数分布差异导致性能显著下降。
summary.importance: 方法改进型工作，首次针对DiT设计定制化剪枝准则与粒度，属于扩散模型高效推理方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DiT-Pruning，从能量视角设计平衡权重与激活贡献的显著性度量，并采用适配DiT结构的剪枝粒度，缓解传统LLM剪枝方法在DiT上的性能退化。
summary.experiments: 未给出完整实验数据与基线对比，主要在图像生成DiT模型上验证剪枝效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have high computational overhead, and traditional post-training pruning methods suffer severe performance degradation due to DiT's unique architecture and parameter distribution.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement in efficient inference for diffusion models, introducing customized pruning criteria and granularity tailored to DiTs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DiT-Pruning, which designs a novel saliency metric balancing weight and activation contributions from an energy-based perspective, and adopts pruning granularity adapted to DiT structures to mitigate performance drop.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details and baseline comparisons not provided; validated on image generation DiT models.

recommendation.zh: 针对DiT的后训练剪枝，属于扩散模型效率优化，对LLM预训练研究员参考有限，可作为背景了解。
recommendation.en: Post-training pruning for DiTs falls under diffusion model efficiency optimization, with limited reference value for LLM pretraining researchers; useful as background knowledge only.

paper.title: GSRQ: Gain-Shape Residual Quantization for Sub-1-bit KV Cache
paper.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with extended context windows is increasingly constrained by the linear growth of Key-Value (KV) cache memory. Vector Quantization (VQ), particularly Residual Quantization (RQ), is a promising approach for pushing KV cache storage toward the sub-1-bit regime by progressively encoding residuals with small codebooks. However, most VQ methods still rely on standard $\ell_2$ $K$-means as the core codebook-learning primitive. We identify a subtle high-di

summary.core_problem: 解决残差量化用于KV缓存压缩时，标准ℓ2 K-means在高维下存在质心收缩、削弱角度对齐、方向保真差的问题，目标是实现亚1位KV缓存。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出改进的K-means变体用于残差量化，提升高维向量量化的方向保真度，为亚1位KV缓存提供新的量化方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Gain-Shape K-means（GSKM）作为标准K-means的直接替代，将质心更新分解为增益（幅度）和形状（方向）两部分，缓解质心收缩问题；在此基础上构建Gain-Shape残差量化（GSRQ），用于KV缓存的亚1位压缩。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出实验细节，提到在部分场景下ℓ2失真与标准方法相当甚至更优，方向保真度提升；具体模型参数量、基线、下游任务效果未在摘要中体现。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses centroid shrinkage and poor directional fidelity of standard ℓ2 K-means in high-dimensional residual quantization for KV cache compression, targeting sub-1-bit KV cache storage.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing an improved K-means variant for residual quantization that enhances directional fidelity of high-dimensional vector quantization, enabling a new sub-1-bit KV cache quantization scheme.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gain-Shape K-means (GSKM) as a drop-in replacement for standard K-means, decomposing centroid updates into gain (magnitude) and shape (direction) components to mitigate centroid shrinkage; builds Gain-Shape Residual Quantization (GSRQ) on top for sub-1-bit KV cache compression.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide full experimental details; notes ℓ2 distortion matches or improves on standard methods in some regimes, with better directional fidelity. Model size, baselines, and downstream performance are not specified.

recommendation.zh: 亚1位KV量化的增量改进，gain-shape分解思路可作为量化感知预训练的参考，看摘要和方法核心部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for sub-1-bit KV quantization; the gain-shape decomposition idea is a minor reference for quantization-aware pretraining, read abstract and core method section only.

paper.title: Attend, Transform, or Silence: Operator-Level Visual Skipping for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly process long visual-token sequences, increasing the overall inference computation. Existing acceleration methods usually remove visual tokens or skip visual-token updates in entire layers, but these coarse strategies may discard fine-grained evidence or suppress useful operators together with redundant ones. In this paper, we study visual-token computation from an answer-observable perspective and find that late visual-token updates can remai

summary.core_problem: 现有MLLM推理加速方法依赖粗粒度冗余判断：token级剪枝会不可逆丢失细粒度视觉证据，层级跳过将注意力和FFN绑定处理、无法区分单算子冗余；同时仅用隐状态更新幅度判断冗余，会误判大量对答案无实际贡献的“answer-silent”视觉更新为有效计算。
summary.importance: 提出算子级的视觉冗余分析视角，补充了MLLM计算效率研究的分析维度；无需重训练的跳过框架对高分辨率、长视觉序列MLLM的部署有实用价值，其answer-observable诊断方法也可迁移到其他多模态架构的效率分析中。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计answer-observable诊断指标，衡量视觉token更新是否传播到答案token的隐状态，识别出深层中大量更新幅度大但不影响最终输出的answer-silent冗余；2. 将Transformer层拆分为注意力和FFN两个独立算子，分别评估二者的答案可观测贡献，发现不同层存在注意力主导、FFN主导或双算子冗余的异质性；3. 实现算子级视觉跳过框架，保留完整视觉token序列，仅跳过每层中被判定为冗余的单个算子（注意力或FFN）的视觉计算，避免不可逆token丢失和固定算子偏好的限制。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3VL等多个MLLM架构、10个VQA基准上测试，最高可减少33.7%的视觉计算量，平均性能变化仅0.5%；消融实验验证了answer-observable指标相比原始更新幅度指标的有效性，以及算子级粒度相比token级、层级策略的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第2节的answer-silent现象分析、算子级异质性实验及对应图表，以及第3节跳过框架的核心逻辑；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，无需深究实现细节，核心吸收冗余判断的新维度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM inference acceleration methods rely on coarse redundancy granularities: token-level pruning irreversibly discards fine-grained visual evidence, while layer-level skipping couples attention and FFN computation and cannot isolate operator-specific redundancy. Judging redundancy solely by hidden-state update magnitude also misclassifies large but answer-irrelevant visual updates as useful computation.
summary_en.importance: It introduces an operator-level perspective for visual redundancy analysis, expanding the analytical toolkit for MLLM computational efficiency. The training-free skipping framework delivers practical value for deploying high-resolution or long-visual-sequence MLLMs, and the answer-observable diagnostic can be generalized to efficiency analysis of other multimodal architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Propose answer-observable diagnostics that measure whether visual token updates propagate to answer token hidden states, identifying widespread "answer-silent" redundancy in late layers where large visual updates do not affect final outputs. 2. Decompose each Transformer layer into separate attention and FFN operators, and evaluate their individual answer-observable contributions, revealing layer-wise heterogeneity: some layers are attention-dominant, some FFN-dominant, and others redundant in both operators. 3. Design an operator-level visual skipping framework that retains the full visual token sequence and only bypasses the redundant operator (attention or FFN) for visual tokens in each layer, avoiding irreversible token loss and fixed operator preference assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple MLLM architectures (including Qwen3VL) and 10 VQA benchmarks. It achieves up to 33.7% visual computation reduction with only 0.5% average performance change. Ablation studies validate the superiority of answer-observable metrics over raw update magnitude, and the advantage of operator-level granularity over token-level or layer-level strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2's analysis of the answer-silent phenomenon and operator-level heterogeneity experiments (and corresponding figures), plus the core logic of the skipping framework in Section 3. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes; no need to dive deep into implementation details, prioritize absorbing the new redundancy judgment dimension.

recommendation.zh: 算子级视觉token跳过的思路比整层剪枝更精细，重点看§3关于answer-silent冗余的分析与Fig 2的算子影响分布，可迁移到长上下文推理优化。
recommendation.en: Operator-level visual token skipping is finer-grained than layer pruning; focus on §3 analysis of answer-silent redundancy and Fig 2 operator impact distribution, transferable to long-context inference optimization.

paper.title: CoLT: Teaching Multi-Modal Models to Think with Chain of Latent Thoughts
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has enabled multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) to tackle complex visual reasoning tasks by generating explicit intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, this text-based reasoning paradigm is inherently slow at inference time with even thousands of tokens and fundamentally constrained by the expressiveness of natural language. In this paper, we propose CoLT, (Chain of Latent Thoughts), a novel framework that teaches multi-modal models to re

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型依赖文本形式的思维链推理，存在推理延迟高（需自回归生成数百到数千推理token）、自然语言表达能力受限、早期推理错误易累积的问题；现有纯文本潜推理方法不匹配多模态场景，依赖额外图像标注的潜视觉推理方案又存在标注成本高、扩展性差的缺陷。
summary.importance: 为多模态推理提供了无需额外图像标注的潜推理范式，验证了用极短潜状态链替代长文本思维链的可行性，对多模态基座模型的推理效率优化、推理范式设计有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CoLT框架，用连续潜表示替代文本推理步骤，通过三重监督机制约束潜空间语义有效性：1）前向解码监督：轻量解码器基于前置潜思维预测下一步文本推理内容，保证潜表示携带递进的推理信息；2）反向解码监督：将解码器基于前置文本思维生成的隐状态与潜思维表示对齐，锚定潜空间的语义结构；3）内部监督：让模型基于当前潜步预测下一步的潜表示，约束相邻潜步的连贯过渡。
summary.experiments: 在8个多模态基准上测试，性能优于现有潜推理方法和依赖图像监督的潜视觉推理方案；相比文本思维链，推理总时长降低10.1倍，文本解码时长降低22.6倍，仅需3步潜思维即可完成推理；可视化结果验证潜表示中确实编码了有效的推理模式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章方法部分的三重监督机制设计（3.3-3.4节），以及第4章的效率对比实验和潜表示可视化结果；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current multimodal large language models rely on text-form chain-of-thought reasoning, which suffers from three inherent limitations: high inference latency caused by autoregressive generation of hundreds to thousands of reasoning tokens, constrained expressiveness of natural language, and error accumulation from early reasoning steps. Existing text-only latent reasoning methods do not adapt to multimodal scenarios, while latent visual reasoning schemes requiring extra image annotations incur high labeling costs and poor scalability.
summary_en.importance: Provides a latent reasoning paradigm for multimodal models without additional image annotations, validates the feasibility of replacing long text CoT with extremely short latent state chains, and offers practical reference for reasoning efficiency optimization and reasoning paradigm design of multimodal base models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the CoLT framework, which replaces text reasoning steps with continuous latent representations, and regularizes latent space semantics via three complementary supervision signals: 1) Forward decoding supervision: a lightweight decoder predicts next-step textual reasoning content from preceding latent thoughts to ensure semantic validity and progressiveness of latent representations; 2) Backward decoding supervision: hidden states generated by the decoder from preceding textual thoughts are aligned with latent thought representations to anchor the semantic structure of the latent space; 3) Internal supervision: the model predicts the next-step latent representation from the current latent step to enforce coherent transitions between consecutive latent steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 multimodal benchmarks, outperforms both existing latent reasoning methods and latent visual reasoning schemes relying on image supervision. Compared with text CoT, reduces total inference latency by 10.1× and text decoding latency by 22.6×, requiring only 3 latent thought steps to complete reasoning. Visualizations confirm that effective reasoning patterns are encoded within latent representations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the three-fold supervision mechanism design in Method Chapter 3 (Sections 3.3-3.4), as well as the efficiency comparison experiments and latent representation visualization results in Chapter 4. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 潜在思维推理的双向监督设计对推理效率优化有参考价值，重点看§3的监督机制和消融实验。
recommendation.en: The bidirectional supervision design for latent reasoning is valuable for inference efficiency optimization; focus on §3 supervision mechanism and ablation studies.

paper.title: MATCH: Modulating Attention via In-Context Retrieval for Long-Context Transformers
paper.abstract: The quadratic computational cost of traditional attention mechanisms poses a major bottleneck to the scalability and practical deployment of large language models (LLMs), particularly in long-context scenarios. To improve efficiency, existing approaches often enforce rigid structural constraints such as local attention windows. However, these strategies typically lead to substantial performance degradation on tasks requiring precise long-range recall. In this work, we propose MATCH, a scalable a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的一个老问题：稀疏注意力把复杂度和 KV cache 压下来了，但代价是远距离精确召回能力明显变差，尤其在需要从很早位置找准证据的任务上。论文要解决的不是再设计一种固定稀疏模式，而是让稀疏模型在保持线性或次线性开销的同时，按当前上下文动态补回那些真正重要的远端 token 位置。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在两点。第一，它把“长上下文效率”和“长程精确召回”拆成两个模块：主干仍用稀疏注意力保证吞吐，外部检索器负责跨长距离找信息。这种分工比单纯扩大窗口或做更复杂的稀疏模板更接近工程上可落地的路线。第二，它提示一个值得继续追的方向：长上下文能力未必只能靠更强的原生注意力结构，也可以靠检索式辅助模块在推理时补足。对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，因为方法更偏 inference-time architecture augmentation，而不是训练范式或数据配方的改变。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MATCH：在稀疏注意力模型之外接一个外部 retriever，用它从整段上下文中挑出对当前 token 生成最有帮助的远端位置，再把这些位置对应的信息并入注意力计算。论文的出发点很明确：固定局部窗口的问题不在于“看得少”，而在于“看不到该看的远处 token”；因此需要一个上下文相关、按输入动态变化的选择机制。

从全文描述看，MATCH 包含两部分。第一部分是 retrieval-enhancing encoder / retriever。它以较低成本编码整段上下文，形成可检索表示，用来为当前查询位置返回一小组候选 token 位置。第二部分是 retrieval-enhanced attention。原始稀疏注意力仍保留局部窗口或已有稀疏结构，额外再把检索到的远端 token 作为补充 key/value 参与注意力。这样做不是替换稀疏注意力，而是在其上增加一条“远程跳连”。

它和已有方法的差别主要有三点。其一，不像 sliding window 那样用固定模式假设重要信息大多在邻域内；MATCH 允许跨任意距离访问。其二，不同于很多 post-sparsification / KV eviction 方法只是在已有 full-attention 模型上删 token，它主动引入一个检索器来恢复被稀疏化损失掉的 recall。其三，它强调 context-dependent sparsity：真正重要的远端依赖随输入变化，因此检索目标也必须动态变化，而不是预先写死规则。
