从研究味道上看，这更像“给稀疏 Transformer 加一个轻量 RAG-in-context 通道”，但检索对象不是外部知识库，而是当前 prompt 内部的历史 token。这个设定很适合长上下文 ICL、needle-style recall 和文档问答场景。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验结论是：MATCH 在合成 ICL 任务和真实长上下文 benchmark 上，都能显著改善稀疏注意力模型的表现，同时保持更好的效率。摘要和引言没有给出完整数字表，但实验设计的重点比较清楚：

1. 对比对象包括 full attention、原始 sparse attention，以及加入 MATCH 后的 sparse model。
2. 任务覆盖 synthetic recall / ICL 和 real-world long-context understanding，目标是看远距离信息检索是否恢复，而不是只看短上下文 perplexity。
3. 论文还专门分析 throughput 和 memory footprint，说明作者把它当成效率-性能折中方案，而不是单纯追求精度。

从可推断的结果结构看，MATCH 的收益应主要集中在需要精确定位远端证据的位置敏感任务；对局部模式占主导的任务，提升不会同样明显。另一个值得注意的点是，它的额外开销来自 retriever 编码和检索步骤，因此最终收益取决于：检索到的 token 数量是否足够小、检索命中率是否足够高、以及是否能在 prefilling 阶段高效完成。若这些条件成立，MATCH 相比直接扩大窗口会更划算。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。

第一，看方法总览图和 retrieval-enhanced attention 的公式，弄清楚检索到的位置是怎样并入原 attention 的。重点不是实现细节，而是它到底补的是 key/value、attention mask，还是额外分支。

第二，看 retriever 的构造。要确认它是预训练外部编码器、共享主干表示、还是单独训练的模块；还要看检索粒度是 token-level、chunk-level 还是 block-level。这决定了方法能否扩展到更长上下文。

第三，看效率表和长程 recall benchmark。只要这两部分站不住，这类方法就容易退化成“多加一个模块换一点分数”。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想判断是否值得继续跟，可以重点看 introduction、method overview、主结果表，以及 throughput/memory 分析。若后续要做相关工作，再细读检索器训练方式和消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of sparse long-context Transformers: they reduce compute and KV-cache cost, but they lose precise long-range recall. The goal is not to design yet another fixed sparsity pattern, but to let a sparse model recover the few truly relevant distant tokens on demand, without going back to full quadratic attention.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mostly architectural and practical rather than foundational for pretraining. The paper separates long-context modeling into two roles: sparse attention handles efficient local token mixing, while an external retriever restores global recall. That decomposition is useful for anyone working on long-context serving or sparse pretraining recipes. It also suggests a broader lesson: some long-context deficits may be better treated as retrieval failures than as pure attention-design failures. The direct impact on pretraining methodology is limited, since the contribution is closer to inference-time augmentation than to a new training objective or data recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MATCH augments a sparse-attention backbone with an external in-context retriever. The retriever scans or encodes the full prompt efficiently, identifies token positions that are likely useful for the current prediction, and passes those positions back to the Transformer. The attention layer then combines its usual sparse local context with a small set of retrieved distant tokens.

The design choice is motivated by a simple observation: fixed sparse patterns fail not because they see too few tokens in total, but because they cannot adaptively jump to the right distant evidence. MATCH therefore keeps the efficiency of sparse attention while adding a dynamic access path to arbitrary positions in the sequence.

From the full text, the method has two main components. First, a retrieval-enhancing encoder / retriever builds searchable representations over the whole context. Second, a retrieval-enhanced attention mechanism injects the retrieved positions into the sparse attention computation, effectively adding remote key/value access on top of the local sparse pattern.

Compared with standard sliding-window attention, MATCH is input-dependent rather than pattern-fixed. Compared with post-hoc KV eviction methods, it does not only prune memory; it actively restores missing recall through retrieval. Compared with full attention, it aims to preserve most of the recall benefit using a much smaller set of selected remote tokens.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports consistent gains over sparse-attention baselines on both synthetic in-context learning tasks and real long-context benchmarks, while retaining favorable efficiency characteristics. The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, but the experimental structure is clear:

1. Baselines include full attention, sparse attention, and sparse attention plus MATCH.
2. Tasks are chosen to stress exact long-range retrieval rather than only local language modeling quality.
3. The evaluation includes throughput and memory footprint, which is important because the method adds a retriever and could otherwise hide its cost.

The likely pattern of gains is that MATCH helps most on tasks where success depends on locating a specific distant span or token. On tasks dominated by local context, the benefit should be smaller. The practical trade-off depends on whether the retriever can keep the number of fetched tokens small while maintaining high recall.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, inspect the architecture figure and the retrieval-enhanced attention equations. The key question is how retrieved positions are injected into attention.

Second, read the retriever section carefully. Check whether retrieval is token-level or chunk-level, whether the retriever is pretrained separately, and how it scales with context length.

Third, look at the efficiency tables together with the long-range recall benchmarks. Without a convincing efficiency-recall trade-off, this class of methods is much less interesting.

A 20–30 minute skim is enough to judge relevance. If it looks promising for your work, then go back to the retriever training details and ablations.

recommendation.zh: 思路朴素（稀疏注意力+检索补全），属于增量工程，建议只看方法一节和长程召回表格即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental engineering—sparse attention plus retrieval backstop; read the method section and the long-range recall table, skip the rest.

paper.title: FlipGuard: Defending Large Language Models Against Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor Attacks
paper.abstract: Model quantization is essential for the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), but introduces a critical vulnerability: Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor (QCB) attacks. In these attacks, malicious behaviors remain dormant in full-precision models and activate only after specific quantization distortions, bypassing standard security audits. To mitigate this, we introduce FlipGuard, a proactive defense framework that selectively perturbs model weights prior to quantization. By break

summary.core_problem: LLM部署中量化技术会引入量化条件后门（QCB）攻击漏洞，恶意行为在全精度模型下潜伏，仅在量化后激活，绕过常规安全审计。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需训练数据或触发样本的主动防御框架，同时提出统一评估指标DER衡量安全增益、效用保留与计算成本的平衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FlipGuard主动防御框架，在量化前对模型权重进行选择性扰动，破坏攻击者构建的权重模式与量化边界的精确对齐，从而抑制后门激活。
summary.experiments: 在7个LLM（含StarCoder、LLaMA系列）和3种量化方案（INT8、FP4、NF4）上进行大量实验，验证防御有效性。

summary_en.core_problem: Quantization for efficient LLM deployment introduces Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor (QCB) vulnerabilities, where malicious behaviors stay dormant in full-precision models and activate only after quantization, evading standard security audits.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a proactive defense framework requiring no training data or trigger samples, plus a unified DER metric to balance security gain, utility preservation, and computational cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlipGuard framework applies selective weight perturbations before quantization to break the adversary-designed alignment between weight patterns and quantization boundaries, suppressing backdoor activation.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments across 7 LLMs (including StarCoder and LLaMA family) and 3 quantization schemes (INT8, FP4, NF4) validate defense effectiveness.

recommendation.zh: 量化后门防御的细分方向工作，仅对做量化感知预训练或部署安全的团队有参考价值，不影响通用预训练流程设计。
recommendation.en: A niche work on quantization backdoor defense, only relevant for teams working on quantization-aware pretraining or deployment security, with no impact on general pretraining pipeline design.

paper.title: Do Safety Guardrails Need to Reason? LeanGuard: A Fast and Light Approach for Robust Moderation
paper.abstract: In order to screen a prompt or a response, the recent guardrail methods generate a chain-of-thought (CoT) before they issue a verdict. This design follows a common belief that step-by-step reasoning improves a decision. However, CoT also makes the guard heavy and slow, because the model must generate many tokens before it decides. This may not match how guardrails are actually deployed. A guardrail sometimes should not be heavy and slow, and it often runs on-device, for example on an embodied ro

summary.core_problem: 安全guardrail是否真的需要CoT式推理才能做准确的内容审核？
summary.importance: 挑战‘CoT一定提升分类决策质量’的默认假设，给出轻量非推理guardrail可以达到与推理式guard相当准确率的控制实验证据，对部署成本有意义。
summary.technical_approach: 在相同语料上分别训练双向encoder（仅输出标签）与带推理的guardrail模型，然后在推理式guard中去掉推理部分、保持其他不变，做同基座受控比较；得到395M的LeanGuard。
summary.experiments: 395M label-only encoder在公开moderation基准上平均F1=82.90±0.26，声称达到与带CoT guard相当的准确率；但基准范围未展开，缺少与主流商用guardrail对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者为Dongbin Na，未标注机构；单作者论文。

summary_en.core_problem: Do safety guardrails actually need chain-of-thought reasoning to achieve accurate moderation?
summary_en.importance: Challenges the default assumption that CoT improves classifier decisions by showing, under a controlled same-base comparison, that a reasoning-free encoder can match reasoning guards on moderation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Train a lightweight bidirectional label-only encoder and a reasoning guard on the same corpus, then ablate reasoning out of the reasoning guard while holding everything else fixed; yields the 395M-parameter LeanGuard.
summary_en.experiments: A 395M label-only encoder reports 82.90±0.26 average F1 on public moderation benchmarks, matching the reasoning guard; benchmark coverage and comparison to commercial guards are not detailed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Single-author paper by Dongbin Na; no institution stated.

recommendation.zh: 受控消融做得干净，结论对RLHF后‘所有分类都上CoT’的惯性是有用提醒；但和预训练关系弱，按需看setup即可。
recommendation.en: Clean controlled ablation that usefully pushes back on reflexive CoT-for-classifiers, but only tangentially relevant to pretraining; skim the setup if you work on guardrails.

paper.title: Don't Go Breaking My LLM: The Impact of Pruning Attention Layers on Explanation Faithfulness and Confidence Calibration
paper.abstract: Pruning Large Language Models (LLMs) reduces memory and inference costs by removing parts of the network, producing smaller models that retain most of their accuracy. As attention layers are the most resource-intensive parts of LLMs, pruning them is a promising compression strategy. Prior work shows that up to 33% of attention layers can be pruned with minimal accuracy loss. Nevertheless, the impact of attention pruning on model interpretability, specifically faithfulness and confidence calibrat

summary.core_problem: 现有注意力层剪枝研究仅关注精度保留，未评估其对模型解释忠实度与置信校准的影响。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次系统量化注意力剪枝对解释性与校准的副作用，填补模型压缩策略的评估维度盲区。
summary.technical_approach: 选取5个LLM与8个数据集，控制不同注意力层剪枝比例（最高33%），对比剪枝前后的精度、解释忠实度、置信校准三类指标的变化。
summary.experiments: 覆盖5个LLM、8个数据集，发现剪枝后精度稳定时，解释忠实度与置信校准仍可能显著波动甚至退化，存在精度与解释性/校准的错位。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing attention layer pruning work only focuses on accuracy retention, without evaluating its impact on explanation faithfulness and confidence calibration.
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis contribution, first systematic quantification of attention pruning's side effects on interpretability and calibration, filling the evaluation gap for model compression strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Select 5 LLMs and 8 datasets, control different attention layer pruning ratios (up to 33%), and compare changes in accuracy, explanation faithfulness, and confidence calibration before and after pruning.
summary_en.experiments: Across 5 LLMs and 8 datasets, it finds that even when accuracy remains stable after pruning, explanation faithfulness and confidence calibration may still fluctuate significantly or degrade, showing a misalignment between accuracy and interpretability/calibration.

recommendation.zh: 剪枝的精度保留不代表解释性/校准完好，做压缩策略评估时可参考其指标设计，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Attention pruning's accuracy retention does not guarantee faithfulness or calibration; reference its metric design for compression evaluation, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Keyless Attention: Value-Space Routing and Value-Only Caching for Efficient Transformers
paper.abstract: We propose Keyless Attention, an attention mechanism that eliminates the key projection entirely, operating over queries and values only. This yields a Value-Only Cache that reduces KV cache memory and access overhead by exactly 50% over standard attention, while matching or exceeding standard attention's decode throughput. Beyond efficiency, we introduce Depth-$m$ Attention Factorization: standard attention computes a depth-2 factorization of the attention bilinear form, while Keyless Attention

summary.core_problem: 这项工作试图从注意力结构本身减少自回归解码的 KV cache，而不是在标准 QKV attention 之后再做量化、剪枝或系统层管理。
summary.importance: 它属于架构与推理效率交界的工作，对长上下文 serving 和预训练架构选择有参考意义。KV cache 已经是长上下文批量解码中的主要内存瓶颈，很多方法是在 cache 生成之后再压缩。Keyless Attention 的思路是删除 key projection，只缓存 value，因此把 cache 规模和访问带宽在结构上减半。对基座模型研究来说，关键问题不是 50% cache savings 本身，而是这种 attention 形式是否能在预训练损失、下游推理、长上下文外推和训练稳定性上接近标准 attention。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Keyless Attention：不再构造 K，而是在 query 和 value 表示之间直接计算注意力路由。推理时历史 token 只需要保存 V，形成 Value-Only Cache，相比标准 KV cache 精确减少 50% 的 cache memory 和 memory access，不依赖近似、量化或 token pruning。论文还提出 Depth-m Attention Factorization 的视角：标准 QKV attention 可看成 attention bilinear form 的 depth-2 factorization；Keyless Attention 在 m=3 时通过 value-space routing matrix 替代 key projection，使路由和内容读取共享 value space。这个设计区别于 MQA/GQA 的跨头共享，也区别于 MLA 的 latent cache 压缩；它不是压缩已有 KV，而是改写 attention 的参数化方式。
summary.experiments: 给出的材料显示，论文在语言建模和下游 reasoning benchmark 上评估了五个模型，并报告 Value-Only Cache 相比标准 attention 减少 50% cache memory 与访问开销，decode throughput 可匹配或超过标准 attention。材料中没有完整实验表，因此不能确认模型规模、训练 token 数、困惑度差异、各 benchmark 数字和消融结果。判断这类方法是否能用于基座预训练，需要重点核查三个实验：同等训练预算下的 LM loss；长上下文下的质量和吞吐；value-space routing matrix、depth m、head 设计对性能和稳定性的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 到 20 分钟，重点看方法章节而不是只看效率结论。先看 Keyless Attention 的精确定义：attention score 如何由 Q 和 V 计算，value-space routing matrix 放在哪里，是否改变每层参数量和 FLOPs。然后看 Depth-m Attention Factorization，因为这是论文对 expressivity 的主要解释。实验部分要优先查 perplexity、下游 reasoning、decode throughput、cache bandwidth、长上下文长度，以及与 MQA/GQA/MLA/Slim Attention 的同预算比较。若只关心 serving，可直接看 cache layout 和吞吐表；若关心预训练架构，应看 ablation 和训练曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to reduce autoregressive KV-cache cost at the attention-design level, instead of compressing, pruning, or managing the cache after standard QKV attention has already produced it.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture-and-efficiency paper with implications for long-context serving and possible pretraining architecture choices. KV cache has become a main memory and bandwidth bottleneck during batched long-context decoding. Keyless Attention removes the key projection and stores only values, giving a structural 50% cache reduction. For foundation-model training, the main question is not the memory reduction alone, but whether this attention form preserves language-modeling loss, downstream reasoning, long-context behavior, and training stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed mechanism eliminates K and computes attention routing directly between queries and values. During autoregressive inference, past tokens only need to store V, yielding a Value-Only Cache with exactly half the memory footprint and memory traffic of a standard KV cache, without approximation, quantization, or token pruning. The paper also introduces a Depth-m Attention Factorization view. Standard attention is described as a depth-2 factorization of the attention bilinear form, while Keyless Attention at m = 3 uses a value-space routing matrix to replace the key projection and couple routing with retrieval in value space. This differs from MQA and GQA, which share KV across heads, and from MLA, which compresses KV into a latent cache. It changes the attention parameterization rather than post-processing the cache.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text states that the method is evaluated on language modeling and downstream reasoning benchmarks across five models, and that Value-Only Cache reduces cache memory and cache access by 50% while matching or exceeding standard-attention decode throughput. The available content does not include the full experimental tables, so exact model sizes, training-token counts, perplexity deltas, benchmark scores, and ablation numbers cannot be verified here. The decisive evidence to check is same-budget LM loss, quality and throughput under long context, and ablations over the value-space routing matrix, factorization depth m, and head configuration.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15- to 20-minute skim should focus on the method section. First inspect the exact Keyless Attention formula: how scores are computed from Q and V, where the value-space routing matrix is inserted, and how the design changes parameter count and FLOPs. Then read the Depth-m Attention Factorization section, since it carries the main expressivity argument. In the experiments, prioritize perplexity, reasoning benchmarks, decode throughput, cache bandwidth, context length, and comparisons against MQA, GQA, MLA, and Slim Attention under comparable budgets. For serving concerns, read the cache-layout and throughput results; for pretraining relevance, read the ablations and training curves.

recommendation.zh: 去掉Key投影的注意力架构思路很大胆，重点看§3的Value空间路由设计与§4的困惑度对比，做长上下文架构的团队可复现小模型验证
recommendation.en: A bold attention architecture idea that eliminates key projections; focus on §3 for value-space routing design and §4 for perplexity comparisons, suitable for small-model reproduction by long-context architecture teams.

paper.title: UniRank: Unified Rank Allocation for Low-Rank LLM Compression
paper.abstract: Low-rank decomposition serves as a promising compression paradigm for large language models, however, rank allocation remains challenging: manual rules lack generalizability, and learning-based approaches incur heavy computational overhead. To address these issues, we formulate global low-rank allocation as a sorting-and-truncation pipeline, and score each singular component via dual criteria: \textbf{Local} singular energy ratio that quantifies the intrinsic importance within the decomposed par

summary.core_problem: 低秩分解压缩 LLM 时，每个权重矩阵保留多少奇异分量（秩分配）缺乏通用且低成本的方案；同时低秩模型无法直接兼容 LoRA 微调，传统重建-合并-再分解流程会引入信息损失和额外计算。
summary.importance: 提出了一套无需训练、计算开销极低的全局秩分配方法，可直接复用到不同模型架构；同时给出低秩模型与 LoRA 兼容的微调范式，对推理侧模型压缩和部署后适配有实际工程价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心分为两部分。第一是 Sorting-and-Truncation 全局秩分配管线：把原本组合爆炸的全局秩选择问题，简化为对所有权重矩阵所有奇异分量统一打分、排序、按预算截断。每个奇异分量的打分由两个指标相乘得到：一是局部奇异能量比（归一化奇异值平方占比），衡量该分量对重建原权重矩阵的结构重要性；二是全局功能重要性，用所在层在小校准集上的输入-输出余弦相似度做代理——利用 pre-norm 残差结构和 RMSNorm 的尺度不变性，语义信息只由方向决定，高输入输出余弦相似度说明该层变换要么接近恒等（奇异值接近 0），要么与输入线性相关（有效秩接近 1），因此可以分配更低的秩。第二是 Rank-Preserving Fine-Tuning（RPFT）：把已经分配好的秩 k 拆成冻结的 k-k_LoRA 和可训练的 k_LoRA 两部分，直接在分解后的因子矩阵上做 LoRA 式更新，不需要先重建全秩再合并再分解，避免截断损失和额外计算。
summary.experiments: 秩分配阶段开销约 2 分钟；零样本压缩下，相比手工规则基线，困惑度最多降低 50%；配合 RPFT 后，下游任务性能可恢复到稠密模型的 90% 水平。实验覆盖了低秩压缩、后压缩微调两个阶段的完整管线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第 3 节关于输入-输出余弦相似度与有效秩的几何解释和对应关系，这是整个打分指标的理论支撑；其次看 RPFT 的秩拆分设计和与传统 LoRA 合并流程的对比。附录中的消融实验可快速浏览，关注两个打分指标各自的贡献。全文泛读约 40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Rank allocation for low-rank LLM compression lacks a generalizable, low-cost solution: uniform or heuristic rules fail across architectures, and learning-based methods add heavy training overhead. Separately, pre-decomposed low-rank models cannot directly absorb LoRA updates; the standard reconstruct-merge-redecompose pipeline incurs information loss and extra compute.
summary_en.importance: Provides a training-free, computationally cheap global rank allocation method that transfers across model architectures, plus a LoRA-compatible fine-tuning paradigm for pre-decomposed low-rank models. Both components have direct engineering value for inference-side compression and post-deployment adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two core modules. First, a Sorting-and-Truncation (S&T) pipeline: the intractable combinatorial global rank optimization is reduced to scoring all singular components across every weight matrix, sorting them, and truncating to a total rank budget. Each component receives a product score: (1) local singular energy ratio, i.e. normalized squared singular value, measuring structural contribution to reconstructing the original weight matrix per Eckart-Young-Mirsky; (2) global functional importance, proxied by layer-wise input-output cosine similarity computed on a small calibration set. Under pre-norm residual structure and scale-invariant RMSNorm, semantics are encoded purely in vector direction — high input-output cosine similarity implies the layer transform is either near-identity (singular values ≈ 0) or linearly correlated with input features (effective rank ≈ 1), justifying a lower assigned rank. Second, Rank-Preserving Fine-Tuning (RPFT): the pre-allocated rank k of each decomposed module is split into a frozen part (k - k_LoRA) and a tunable part (k_LoRA). LoRA-style updates are applied directly on the factor matrices, avoiding full-rank reconstruction, re-decomposition, and the associated truncation loss.
summary_en.experiments: Rank allocation overhead is roughly 2 minutes. Under zero-shot compression, S&T reduces perplexity by up to 50% relative to handcrafted baselines. With RPFT, downstream task performance recovers to ~90% of the dense model. Results cover the full pipeline of compression plus post-compression adaptation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3's geometric justification linking input-output cosine similarity to effective rank, which is the theoretical foundation of the scoring metric. Then examine the RPFT rank-split design and its comparison with the standard LoRA merge workflow. Skim ablation results in the appendix to understand the relative contribution of the two scoring terms. Estimated reading time: ~40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 双准则秩分配思路干净，保秩微调策略对压缩后再继续预训练有参考价值，重点看 §3 打分公式与 §4.2 微调部分。
recommendation.en: The dual-criterion rank allocation is cleanly formulated; the rank-preserving fine-tuning recipe is relevant for continued pretraining after compression, focus on §3 scoring and §4.2.

paper.title: EfficientRollout: System-Aware Self-Speculative Decoding for RL Rollouts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a representative post-training paradigm for LLMs, enabling strong reasoning and agentic capabilities. However, rollout generation remains a dominant latency bottleneck because autoregressive sampling decodes responses sequentially and a small number of long-tailed generations often determine completion time. Speculative decoding (SD) offers a natural way to address this bottleneck, as it is a well-established technique for serving fixed LLMs that reduces la

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 on-policy RL 训练中的 rollout 生成延迟问题。常规自回归采样必须逐 token 解码，长回答和尾部样本会拖慢整个 batch；但直接把 serving 场景的 speculative decoding 搬到 RL rollout 中并不稳定，因为目标 policy 在训练中持续变化，固定 drafter 会过期，同时大 batch 初期往往处在 compute-bound 区间， speculative verification 可能反而变慢。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发在 RL post-training 的系统效率，而不是预训练目标本身。它指出 RL rollout 的瓶颈不能只按静态推理服务理解：policy 分布会变尖、batch 会随样本结束而收缩、尾部 decode 的 dense weight projection 成本突出。对于大规模 RL 训练，这类系统感知的采样加速会影响可承担的 rollout 数量、响应长度和训练迭代速度，也会间接影响推理型模型的训练 recipe 设计。
summary.technical_approach: EfficientRollout 采用 self-speculative decoding，但 drafter 不是额外训练的小模型，也不是历史 rollout 缓存，而是从当前 target policy 诱导出来的权重量化 drafter。这样做的关键取舍是：drafter 始终跟随正在更新的 policy，避免固定 drafter 在 on-policy RL 中快速失配；同时通过量化降低 draft 成本，不引入单独的 drafter 预训练和在线适配流程。方法还加入两个控制策略。第一是 system-aware SD toggle，只在 speculative decoding 有系统收益的阶段启用，避免大 batch 初期因为 parallel verification 进入 compute-bound 而慢于 AR decode。第二是 adaptive draft-length policy，根据当前 acceptance 行为调整 draft token 数，避免 draft 过长导致无效验证，也避免 draft 过短导致并行验证收益不足。论文用 block efficiency τ 描述每次 draft-verify 平均产出的 target-distributed token 数，并把算法接受率和系统耗时条件一起考虑，这是它区别于只优化接受率的 speculative decoding 方法的地方。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 EfficientRollout 在主流 RL 训练与推理栈上，相比加速后的 AR rollout baseline，rollout latency 最多降低 19.6%，端到端训练 latency 最多降低 12.7%。实验重点不是单点模型质量提升，而是 rollout 系统时间分解：大 batch 早期 speculative decoding 可能没有收益，batch 收缩后的 tail decoding 更适合启用；target-induced quantized drafter 能在 policy 持续变化时保持较高 block efficiency；adaptive draft length 能随 RL 过程中的接受率变化减少无效 draft。对比历史轨迹 drafting 和 learned auxiliary drafter 时，论文强调前者覆盖未来轨迹能力弱，后者需要额外训练和在线更新，系统复杂度更高。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Sec. 3 的 rollout workload characterization，尤其是 shrinking-batch dynamics、tail latency 和 compute-bound/memory-bound 切换的分析；再看 Sec. 4 的 target-induced quantized drafter、SD toggle 和 adaptive draft length。实验部分优先看端到端 latency、rollout latency 分解、不同 batch 阶段是否启用 SD 的消融。若关注 RL scaling，核心问题不是 speculative decoding 公式本身，而是它如何和 on-policy 更新、长回答分布、系统利用率耦合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets rollout latency in on-policy RL for LLM post-training. Autoregressive sampling is sequential, and a small number of long generations often determines the wall-clock time of a rollout batch. Standard speculative decoding does not transfer cleanly to this setting: the target policy keeps changing, so a fixed drafter becomes stale, and early rollout phases with large active batches can be compute-bound, where parallel verification may be slower than plain AR decoding.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is on the RL post-training systems side. The paper makes a useful distinction between fixed-model serving and RL rollout generation: policies evolve, response distributions sharpen, active batch sizes shrink over time, and tail decoding dominates latency. These details matter for how many rollouts can be collected per unit time, how long responses can be afforded, and how RL recipes scale in practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: EfficientRollout uses self-speculative decoding with a drafter induced from the current target policy rather than a separately trained auxiliary model or a history-based cache. The drafter is obtained through weight quantization of the target model, so it stays coupled to the evolving policy while being cheaper to run. The framework adds two control policies. A system-aware toggle enables speculative decoding only in favorable regimes, avoiding slowdowns in large-batch compute-bound phases. An adaptive draft-length policy changes the number of proposed tokens according to the observed acceptance behavior during RL. The paper analyzes block efficiency, the average number of target-distributed tokens produced per draft-verify iteration, together with system timing. This is the main difference from speculative decoding work that primarily optimizes acceptance rate in a static serving setting.
summary_en.experiments: The reported gains are up to 19.6% lower rollout latency and up to 12.7% lower end-to-end training latency over an accelerated AR rollout baseline built on common RL training and serving stacks. The experiments emphasize time decomposition rather than model-quality gains. They show that speculative decoding is not uniformly beneficial across a rollout: it is less useful during large-batch phases and more useful in tail decoding. The target-induced quantized drafter maintains useful block efficiency under policy updates, while adaptive draft length reduces wasted verification when acceptance behavior changes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on the workload characterization in Sec. 3, especially shrinking active batches, tail latency, and the transition between compute-bound and memory-bound regimes. Then read Sec. 4 for the quantized target-induced drafter, the SD toggle, and adaptive draft length. In the experiments, prioritize latency breakdowns and ablations over headline speedup numbers. The useful part is how speculative decoding is coupled to on-policy RL dynamics and system utilization.

recommendation.zh: RL后训练rollout延迟痛点的针对性优化，自推测+系统感知调度的思路可直接复现到内部RL训练pipeline，重点读§3的系统调度设计
recommendation.en: Targeted optimization for RL rollout latency pain points; self-speculative + system-aware scheduling can be directly reproduced in internal RL training pipelines, focus on §3 system scheduling design

paper.title: Complementary Attention Head Pruning for Efficient Transformers
paper.abstract: The remarkable success of Transformer-based models in natural language processing stems from architectural scaling, which leads to a large number of parameters and hinders deployment in resource-constrained environments. While structured pruning offers a pathway to compression, existing state-of-the-art methods often rely on gradient-based importance ranking or stochastic gating, which suffer from instability, structural degeneration, and the need for extensive manual hyperparameter tuning. In t

summary.core_problem: 现有Transformer注意力头结构化剪枝方法多基于梯度重要性排序或随机门，存在训练不稳定、结构退化、需大量超参调优的问题，且孤立评估头的重要性而忽略功能互补性。
summary.importance: 提出一种无需预定义稀疏度的后处理注意力头剪枝框架，属于高效推理方向的方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CAHP框架，将注意力头选择建模为全局图论问题：1）用信息论距离度量头之间的功能相似度构建无向图；2）图聚类识别拓扑多样的互补头子集；3）自动确定剪枝数量，无需预设稀疏比或额外重训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验所用的模型参数量、数据集、基准剪枝方法与性能-效率trade-off结果，核心贡献为剪枝框架设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing structured attention head pruning methods for Transformers mostly rely on gradient-based importance ranking or stochastic gating, suffering from instability, structural degeneration, hyperparameter tuning overhead, and ignoring functional complementarity between heads.
summary_en.importance: A post-hoc attention head pruning framework that eliminates predefined sparsity requirements, a methodological improvement in the efficient inference direction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CAHP framework, which formulates attention head selection as a global graph-theoretic problem: 1) Build an undirected graph using information-theoretic distances to measure functional similarity between heads; 2) Use graph clustering to identify topologically diverse subsets of complementary heads; 3) Automatically determine pruning count without preset sparsity ratios or retraining.
summary_en.experiments: Model scale, datasets, baseline pruning methods, and performance-efficiency trade-off results are not fully disclosed in the abstract; core contribution is pruning framework design.

recommendation.zh: 增量式的注意力头剪枝方法，仅需了解其基于互补性的全局选择思路，作为剪枝领域的literature备查即可，无需复现。
recommendation.en: An incremental attention head pruning method; only the complementarity-based global selection idea is worth noting, for pruning literature reference, no reproduction needed.

paper.title: Ternary Mamba: Grouped Quantization-Aware Training of W1.58A16 State Space Models
paper.abstract: State Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba-2 offer linear-time inference but their memory footprint limits edge deployment. Prior ternary SSM work (Slender-Mamba) trains from scratch on 150B tokens; we show a pretrained checkpoint suffices, reducing the marginal token budget by 1,000x. Using grouped quantization-aware training (QAT) with knowledge distillation from a frozen FP16 teacher, we compress Mamba-2 1.3B to 3.61x (2,687 to 744 MB) and achieve 48.1% zero-shot accuracy (7-task average) in jus

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究如何把已经预训练好的 Mamba-2 1.3B 压到三值权重 W1.58A16，同时避免从零训练三值 SSM 所需的大量 token 和算力。核心问题是：SSM 在低比特量化下误差会沿状态递推累积，普通 PTQ 几乎不可用，是否可以用很小代价的 QAT 从现有 checkpoint 得到可用模型。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发在两个方面。第一，它把架构效率和权重量化放到同一个 SSM 语言模型上考察，说明低比特 SSM 不能简单套用 Transformer 的 PTQ 经验。第二，它给出一个实用的 QAT-from-pretrained recipe：继承 FP16 预训练成本，只用 102M token 做量化适配，就接近从零训练二值/三值模型的零样本表现。这个结论对小算力环境下研究 SSM LM、边缘部署和 pretrain 后压缩都有参考意义。论文的范围较窄，只验证 Mamba-2 1.3B、英文 C4 和部分模块量化，不能直接外推到更大模型或混合架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 Mamba-2 1.3B 中所有 48 个 block 的 in_proj 和 out_proj 替换为 TernaryLinear，共覆盖 96 个模块、约 85.7% 参数。权重按 group 做三值量化，group size 主要取 128。每组 scale 用当前权重绝对值均值重新计算：s_g = mean(|w_i|)，再进行 clip、round 到 {-1,0,+1}，反量化为 s_g × ternary weight。训练时用 STE 传梯度。SSM 动态参数 A_log、D、dt_bias，conv1d、embedding、lm_head 和 norm 保持 FP16，因为已有 SSM 量化工作显示这些部分在低比特下更敏感。训练从公开 FP16 Mamba-2 checkpoint 出发，使用冻结 FP16 teacher 做知识蒸馏，loss 是 LM loss 与 KL/KD loss 的混合，α=0.5，T=1.0。一个关键发现是 zero-ratio collapse：如果把 scale 设为可学习参数，优化器会增大 scale 以短期降低 KD loss，导致 zero band 变宽，越来越多权重变成 0，容量继续下降，形成正反馈。使用非学习的 absmean scale 每次 forward 重算，可以形成负反馈，使零比例稳定在约 26%。
summary.experiments: 主实验在单张 H100 上训练 50k steps，序列长度 1024，总 token 约 102M，用时约 4 小时。模型从 Mamba-2 1.3B FP16 checkpoint 出发，压缩后体积从 2687 MB 降到 744 MB，压缩率 3.61×。7 个 zero-shot 任务平均准确率为 48.1%，接近 Bi-Mamba 的 48.4%，两者 0.3 个百分点差距落在约 ±0.9pp 的置信区间内。C4 perplexity 相比 FP16 增加 4.20，约 +24%；WikiText-2 gap 更大，作者认为主要受 C4 训练与 WikiText-2 评估域不匹配影响。朴素 ternary PTQ 的 PPL 约 13M，几乎随机，说明 QAT 对三值 SSM 是必要条件。多 seed 实验显示方差较小：C4 PPL 标准差约 0.01，7-task 平均标准差约 ±0.13pp。继续训练到 307M token 时 C4 PPL 仍单调下降，未见平台；log-token 拟合给出继续改善趋势，但作者也提醒只有四个数据点，外推到 1–10B token 需谨慎。group size 扫描显示 PPL 变化只有约 0.06，主要瓶颈来自三值约束本身，而不是 scale 粒度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、Method、Zero-Ratio Collapse 和 Experiments。重点看三处：一是量化哪些模块、保留哪些模块为 FP16；二是 learnable scale 为什么导致 zero-ratio collapse；三是 PTQ、QAT、Bi-Mamba 和 FP16 的表格对比。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是 SSM 低比特量化的训练动态，而不是 7-task 数字本身。预计阅读 25 到 35 分钟。若要复现实验，应细读 optimizer、KD loss、group size 和 layer-selective ablation 的设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a pretrained Mamba-2 1.3B checkpoint can be converted into a usable ternary-weight SSM with a small QAT budget. The central difficulty is that low-bit quantization error in SSMs accumulates through the recurrent state update, making naive ternary PTQ fail badly.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is that compression recipes for Transformer LMs do not transfer cleanly to SSM LMs. The work combines two efficiency axes: linear-time Mamba inference and W1.58A16 ternary weights. It also makes the cost profile practical by starting from an existing FP16 checkpoint and spending only a small amount of additional training. For pretraining researchers, the paper is most relevant as evidence that post-pretraining quantization-aware adaptation can be an effective alternative to training low-bit SSMs from scratch, while also exposing SSM-specific instabilities. The claims are intentionally narrow: Mamba-2 1.3B, English C4, and selective module quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method replaces the in_proj and out_proj layers in all 48 Mamba-2 blocks with grouped ternary linear layers. These 96 modules account for about 85.7% of the parameters. Weights are partitioned into groups, mainly with group size 128. For each group, the scale is recomputed as the mean absolute weight value, then weights are clipped, rounded to {-1, 0, +1}, and dequantized by multiplying by the group scale. Gradients pass through a straight-through estimator. The SSM dynamics parameters A_log, D, and dt_bias, as well as conv1d, embeddings, lm_head, and norms, remain FP16 because prior SSM quantization work finds these components sensitive at low precision. Training uses the public FP16 Mamba-2 1.3B checkpoint as initialization and a frozen FP16 teacher for distillation, mixing language-model loss and distillation loss with α=0.5 and temperature 1.0. A key observation is zero-ratio collapse: when group scales are learned parameters, optimization can increase the scale, widen the zero region, push more weights to zero, and reduce capacity in a positive feedback loop. Recomputing absmean scales at every forward pass provides a stabilizing feedback and keeps sparsity around 26%.
summary_en.experiments: The main run trains for 50k steps on C4 with sequence length 1024, totaling about 102M tokens, on a single H100 for roughly 4 hours. The compressed model reduces storage from 2687 MB to 744 MB, a 3.61x reduction. It reaches 48.1% average zero-shot accuracy over seven tasks, close to Bi-Mamba's 48.4%; the 0.3 percentage-point difference is within the reported approximate ±0.9pp confidence interval. On C4, perplexity increases by 4.20 relative to the FP16 model, about a 24% gap. The WikiText-2 gap is larger and attributed partly to domain mismatch. Naive ternary PTQ gives perplexity around 13 million, effectively unusable, which supports the need for QAT. Multi-seed runs show low variance: about 0.01 standard deviation in C4 perplexity and ±0.13pp in the seven-task average. Extending training to 307M tokens keeps improving C4 perplexity without a visible plateau. The log-token trend suggests further gains, but the extrapolation is based on only four points. Group-size ablations show only about 0.06 PPL range, indicating that the ternary constraint, not scale granularity, is the main bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should cover the Method section, the zero-ratio collapse analysis, and the main comparison tables. The most important implementation details are which Mamba modules are quantized, why SSM dynamics stay FP16, and why non-learned absmean scales are used. The experimental section is worth reading for the PTQ failure case, the QAT cost accounting, and the scaling curve up to 307M tokens. Plan for 25–35 minutes. Readers aiming to reproduce or extend the result should inspect the optimizer schedule, distillation loss, group-size sweep, and layer-selective ablations.

recommendation.zh: QAT-from-pretrained比从头训便宜1000x的结论有实际工程价值，zero-ratio collapse和SSM不适合后处理校正这两点值得注意。只看§3和§4.2
recommendation.en: 1000x token reduction via QAT-from-pretrained is practically useful; zero-ratio collapse and SSM incompatibility with post-hoc correction are notable. Read §3 and §4.2 only

paper.title: S4oP: Operator-level Pruning of Structured State Space Models for Resource-Constrained Devices
paper.abstract: Structured State Space Models (SSMs), including the S4 and S4D architectures, have recently emerged as powerful alternatives to attention-based models for capturing long-range dependencies in sequential data. Despite their strong empirical performance, deploying these models in time- and resource-constrained settings remains challenging due to their computational and memory demands. In this paper, we propose a novel incremental, operator-level pruning approach for S4- and S4D-based models that s

summary.core_problem: 结构化状态空间模型（S4/S4D）的推理计算与内存开销大，现有剪枝方法未针对其结构化算子做系统优化，难以部署在资源受限设备。
summary.importance: 方法创新类贡献，首次提出针对SSM的增量式算子级剪枝框架，实现效率-精度的可控权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 采用渐进式剪枝流程，交替执行结构化掩码与微调，联合监控模型精度与推理延迟，针对S4/S4D的结构化算子（状态矩阵、卷积核等）定制剪枝策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、数据集、基线与量化提升幅度，仅说明所提方法可显著降低SSM推理成本并保持预测性能。
summary.authors_note: Nicola Bombieri为维罗纳大学嵌入式系统与高效计算方向研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Structured State Space Models (S4/S4D) have high inference compute and memory overhead; existing pruning methods are not optimized for their structured operators, hindering deployment on resource-constrained devices.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation contribution; first proposes an incremental operator-level pruning framework tailored to SSMs, achieving controllable efficiency-accuracy tradeoffs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts a progressive pruning pipeline that alternates structured masking and fine-tuning, jointly monitors model accuracy and inference latency, and customizes pruning strategies for S4/S4D's structured operators (state matrices, convolution kernels, etc.).
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, dataset, baselines, or quantitative improvement margins are disclosed in the abstract; only states that the proposed method significantly reduces SSM inference cost while preserving predictive performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Nicola Bombieri is a researcher at the University of Verona, focusing on embedded systems and efficient computing.

recommendation.zh: SSM算子级剪枝的工程实现有参考价值，做SSM边缘部署的可看§3的剪枝策略设计，其余内容无需细读。
recommendation.en: The operator-level SSM pruning implementation is referenceable for edge deployment; only §3 pruning strategy design merits attention.

paper.title: TWLA: Achieving Ternary Weights and Low-Bit Activations for LLMs via Post-Training Quantization
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional general language processing capabilities, but their memory and compute costs hinder deployment. Ternarization has emerged as a promising compression technique, offering significant reductions in model size and inference complexity. However, existing methods struggle with heavy-tailed activation distributions and therefore keep activations in high precision, fundamentally limiting end-to-end inference acceleration. To overcome this limitation, we p

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM三值化方法因重尾激活分布无法同时低比特量化激活，限制端到端推理加速。
summary.importance: 提出首个实现1.58位权重和4位激活的训练后量化框架，属于高效推理领域的方法贡献。
summary.technical_approach: TWLA包含三部分：(1) E2M-ATQ两阶段优化（欧几里得初始化到流形重定位）最小化权重三值化的层输出误差；(2) KOTMS使用Kronecker结构正交旋转处理激活分布。
summary.experiments: 在多个LLM模型上进行PTQ实验，与现有量化方法对比精度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM ternarization methods cannot simultaneously quantize activations to low bits due to heavy-tailed activation distributions, limiting end-to-end inference acceleration.
summary_en.importance: First PTQ framework achieving 1.58-bit weights and 4-bit activations with maintained accuracy, a methodological contribution in efficient inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: TWLA comprises (1) E2M-ATQ: two-stage optimization from Euclidean initialization to manifold relocation minimizing layer-output error under weight ternarization; (2) KOTMS: Kronecker-structured orthogonal rotation for activation shaping.
summary_en.experiments: PTQ experiments on multiple LLM models, accuracy compared against existing quantization methods.

recommendation.zh: 推理量化的增量工作，声称1.58bit权重+4bit激活精度保持不错，但PTQ方法对预训练研究无直接启示，快速浏览方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental inference quantization work claiming 1.58-bit weights + 4-bit activations with decent accuracy preservation. PTQ methods have no direct implication for pretraining; skim the method section only if interested.

paper.title: Doc-to-Atom: Learning to Compile and Compose Memory Atoms
paper.abstract: Long input sequences are central to document understanding and multi-step reasoning in Large Language Models, yet the quadratic cost of attention makes inference both memory-intensive and slow. Context distillation mitigates this by compressing contextual information into model parameters, and recent work such as Doc-to-LoRA amortizes context distillation into a single forward pass that generates one LoRA adapter per document. However, producing a single monolithic adapter for all queries leads

summary.core_problem: 现有长文档参数化记忆方法（如Doc-to-LoRA）为每个文档生成单个整体适配器，存在无关查询干扰、组合召回能力差、长文档扩展性弱的问题。
summary.importance: 提出组合式参数记忆框架，通过语义原子拆分和动态路由解决单适配器的干扰问题，提升长文档推理的效率和效果。
summary.technical_approach: 将文档拆分为带语义类型的知识原子，每个原子编译为独立的micro-LoRA适配器和溯源检索键；推理时轻量路由器选择相关原子组装为查询专属适配器。
summary.experiments: 在长文档问答和多步推理任务上，相比Doc-to-LoRA等基线提升准确率，同时降低推理内存开销。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自三星北美山景城AI中心、达特茅斯学院。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing parametric long-document memory methods like Doc-to-LoRA produce one monolithic adapter per document, leading to irrelevant-query interference, poor compositional recall and weak scalability for long-document reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a compositional parametric memory framework that resolves monolithic adapter interference via semantic atom decomposition and dynamic routing, improving long-document reasoning efficiency and accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes documents into semantically typed knowledge atoms, each compiled into an independent micro-LoRA adapter and provenance retrieval key; at inference, a lightweight router selects relevant atoms to assemble a query-specific adapter.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms Doc-to-LoRA and other baselines on long-document QA and multi-step reasoning tasks while reducing inference memory overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Samsung AI Center Mountain View and Dartmouth College.

recommendation.zh: 长文档参数记忆的增量改进，只看Fig2的框架图了解设计思路即可，无需通读全文。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on parametric long-document memory; Fig 2 of the framework design suffices, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) project images into hundreds to thousands of visual tokens, making decoder inference expensive in both attention computation and KV-cache memory. Existing visual-token reduction methods largely follow a rank-and-remove paradigm: they score visual tokens, keep a compact subset, and permanently discard the rest. We show that this irreversible action is fragile because visual-token importance changes across decoder depth; tokens ranked low at one stage may become relev

summary.core_problem: VLM 中常见的 visual token 剪枝是一次性永久丢弃，而不同解码器层对 token 的重要性判断会变化，导致 grounding 类查询受损。
summary.importance: 提出可恢复的视觉 token 路由范式替代 rank-and-remove，属于轻量、training-free 的推理效率方法。
summary.technical_approach: Reroute 为 training-free 插件：在每个路由阶段，被选中的视觉 token 进入当前 decoder 块，延迟的 token 跳过该阶段并在下一轮路由重新进入候选池，复用已有注意力打分规则和阶段调度，保持与被增强的剪枝方法相同的渐近 FLOPs 与 KV-cache 预算。
summary.experiments: 在多种 VLM + 多种现有 token 剪枝方法上做插件式替换（摘要截断，具体数据集/数值未完整给出），在相同 FLOPs/KV-cache 预算下比永久剪枝更稳，尤其改善 grounding 敏感查询。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual-token reduction for VLMs permanently drops tokens, yet token importance shifts across decoder layers, hurting grounding-sensitive queries.
summary_en.importance: Proposes recoverable routing as an alternative to the rank-and-remove pruning paradigm; a training-free inference-efficiency plugin.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reroute is a training-free plug-in: at each routing stage selected visual tokens go through the decoder block while deferred tokens bypass and re-enter the candidate pool at the next stage, reusing existing attention-score ranking and stage-wise schedules, preserving the TFLOPs/KV-cache budget class of the underlying pruner.
summary_en.experiments: Plugged into multiple VLMs on top of existing pruning methods (details truncated); under matched FLOPs/KV-cache budgets it outperforms permanent removal, particularly for grounding-sensitive queries.

recommendation.zh: 对做 VLM 推理/多模态预训练的人有用："延迟而非丢弃"这个视角比剪枝更稳；纯文本 LLM 研究员看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on VLM inference or multimodal pretraining; the "defer instead of drop" framing is cleaner than hard pruning, but text-only pretrain folks can stop at the abstract.

paper.title: From Content to Knowledge: Lightning Fast Long-Video Understanding with Neural Knowledge Representations
paper.abstract: We propose a new paradigm for long video understanding by treating a long video as a Neural Knowledge Representation (NKR). NKR represents video contents neither as a stream of tokens nor pre-organized databases, but as an individual small portion of network weights attached to the VLM backbone. The NKR weights are optimized to encapsulate the video's semantic content via a novel Agentic Knowledge Distillation (AKD) process, where an agent automatically synthesizes dense descriptions and questio

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中推理成本与视频长度线性耦合，多轮查询需反复重编码原始视频。
summary.importance: 提出神经知识表示（NKR）新范式，将长视频知识蒸馏为可复用的小型网络权重，使推理成本与视频长度解耦。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agentic Knowledge Distillation (AKD)：用 agent 自动合成密集描述和 QA 对，将视频语义蒸馏为附加在冻结 VLM 骨干上的轻量 NKR 权重。推理时挂载 NKR 即可直接回答查询，无需重加载原视频。
summary.experiments: 未见详细参数/baseline，摘要仅展示了框架设计和 amortized efficiency 思路。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括清华大学、微软亚洲研究院（Xiulian Peng, Yan Lu）。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-video understanding, inference cost scales linearly with video length, and multi-turn queries require re-encoding the raw video repeatedly.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a Neural Knowledge Representation (NKR) paradigm that distills long-video knowledge into reusable small network weights, decoupling inference cost from video length.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agentic Knowledge Distillation (AKD) uses an agent to synthesize dense descriptions and QA pairs, distilling video semantics into lightweight NKR weights attached to a frozen VLM backbone. At inference, mounting the NKR enables direct query-based answering without reloading the original video.
summary_en.experiments: Detailed model parameters and baselines not fully shown in the abstract; primarily presents the framework and amortized efficiency argument.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Tsinghua University and Microsoft Research Asia (Xiulian Peng, Yan Lu).

recommendation.zh: 把视频知识编码进权重而非token序列的思路有意思，但实验和评估都很初步，作为方向参考即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of encoding video knowledge into weights rather than token sequences is interesting, but experiments and evaluation are preliminary — treat as directional reference only.

paper.title: SHAPE: Coalition-Aware Expert Pruning for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models achieve strong quality with low per-token compute, yet their deployment is often limited by the memory wall: the full expert pool must remain resident to support token-dependent routing. Expert pruning is a direct remedy, but prior criteria typically score experts independently and overlook that MoE inference is inherently \emph{coalitional}, where outputs arise from routed top-$k$ expert combinations. We propose \textbf{SHAPE}, a task-driven

summary.core_problem: 现有MoE LLM的专家剪枝方法独立评估专家重要性，忽略了MoE推理中top-k专家组合的联盟特性，导致剪枝后性能下降明显
summary.importance: 方法创新贡献，首次将合作博弈引入MoE专家剪枝，建模专家间的协作关系，剪枝后可在相同内存预算下保留更高性能
summary.technical_approach: 提出SHAPE框架，将小校准集上的路由轨迹建模为经验合作博弈，通过基于观测到的top-k联盟的Shapley式归因，分配考虑交互的专家价值，识别对高效用协作至关重要的专家；进一步提出质量感知的全局剪枝策略，在预算约束下保留MoE拓扑结构
summary.experiments: 在多个MoE模型上测试，相比独立剪枝基线，在相同剪枝比例下性能下降更少，在相同内存约束下可获得更高的推理性能（原文摘要截断，具体数值未披露）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing expert pruning methods for MoE LLMs evaluate expert importance independently, ignoring the coalitional property of top-k expert combinations in MoE inference, leading to significant performance degradation after pruning
summary_en.importance: Method innovation contribution, first introduces cooperative game theory to MoE expert pruning, models the collaboration between experts, and retains higher performance under the same memory budget after pruning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SHAPE framework, models routing traces on a small calibration set as an empirical cooperative game, assigns interaction-aware expert values via Shapley-style attribution over observed top-k coalitions, identifies experts essential for high-utility collaborations; further proposes a quality-aware global pruning strategy to preserve MoE topology under budget constraints
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple MoE models, has less performance degradation than independent pruning baselines under the same pruning ratio, and achieves higher inference performance under the same memory constraint (abstract truncated, specific values not disclosed)

recommendation.zh: MoE专家剪枝的联盟视角非常关键，Shapley归因的思路可直接复现用于内部MoE的专家冗余分析
recommendation.en: The coalition perspective for MoE expert pruning is critical; the Shapley attribution idea can be directly reproduced for internal MoE expert redundancy analysis.

paper.title: FAIR-Calib: Frontier-Aware Instability-Reweighted Calibration for Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) refine tokens iteratively but commit them irreversibly, leading to a "stability lag" where early decisions remain fragile even after being written. We reveal that Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) error easily flips these borderline decisions at the write frontier, which are then permanently locked in and amplified. To address this, we propose Frontier-Aware Instability-Reweighted Calibration (FAIR-Calib), a two-stage PTQ framework for dLLMs. Stage I probes

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion LLM 在后训练量化时一个很具体、也很容易被 AR-LLM 经验掩盖的问题：dLLM 的解码不是逐 token 左到右生成，而是在多步去噪中对整段序列反复预测，并在每一步把一部分位置从 mask 写成具体 token。这个“写入”是不可逆的，但“模型对该位置的判断是否已经稳定”往往滞后于写入时刻。作者把这种现象刻画为 stability lag：某个位置第一次被 commit 之后，模型的 top-1 预测还会在后续若干步继续摆动，直到最终才稳定到最终输出。PTQ 带来的微小扰动，恰好最容易在这种 write frontier 上把边界决策翻转；一旦翻转，错误 token 会被锁进上下文，随后在后续 refinement 中被不断放大。论文要解决的核心问题，不是一般意义上的“量化误差变大”，而是 dLLM 特有的“commit 不等于 stabilize”导致的前沿脆弱性，以及标准 PTQ 校准目标没有针对这种脆弱状态分配足够保护。
summary.importance: 对预训练与建模研究的意义主要有两层。第一层是方法层面：它说明 dLLM 的部署问题不能直接照搬 AR-LLM 的 PTQ recipe，哪怕底层 backbone 都是 Transformer，解码机制不同就会改变误差最敏感的位置与传播路径。第二层是研究信号层面：作者把 dLLM 推理中的 commit frontier、post-commit mismatch、error amplification 这些现象量化出来，相当于给 diffusion LM 补上了一套更贴近机制的稳定性分析框架。对于做新型语言建模范式的人，这比单纯报一个量化后 benchmark 分数更有价值，因为它指出了训练目标、解码策略、以及部署近似之间的耦合点。贡献量级上，它更像是面向 dLLM 部署与分析的关键工程方法，而不是改变预训练范式本身；但如果后续 dLLM 真要走向实用，这类工作是绕不过去的。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两阶段。第一阶段是 teacher probing，用全精度教师模型去估计一个位置相关的校准先验。这个先验不是简单按 token 频率或激活幅度加权，而是把两个因素合在一起：一是 frontier hit，也就是某个位置是否处在 commit 边界、是否正面临不可逆写入；二是 masked-stage reliability，也就是教师在该位置、该步上的置信度或稳定性。直觉上，处在 frontier 且教师自己也不够稳定的位置，最需要在量化时被保护。作者强调这个 prior 主要由机制决定，因此在不同校准语料之间有一定迁移性。第二阶段是 off-policy、layer-wise calibration。它没有真的让量化模型做完整 diffusion rollout，再和教师逐步对齐；那样代价太高，也会把 rollout 噪声混进校准目标。作者改用 teacher-forcing surrogate：在教师轨迹条件下，对每一层做隐藏状态对齐，并用第一阶段得到的权重做 reweighted hidden-state MSE。也就是说，校准目标不再平均对待所有时间步和位置，而是显式提高那些脆弱 frontier state 的损失权重。文中还给出 additive time × position weighting 的动机，并说明在温和假设下，加权 hidden-state MSE 可以作为保护 commit 决策稳定性的代理目标。底层量化实现上，沿用了 FlatQuant 风格的 layer-wise 可学习仿射重参数化，用来先 flatten 权重和激活分布，再做对称均匀量化；真正的新意不在量化器形式，而在 dLLM 特有的校准权重设计和 off-policy 校准方式。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验重点不是只看最终任务分数，而是把机制指标和下游表现一起报。模型与设置上，作者主要在 Dream / LLaDA 这类 dLLM 上做 W4A4 PTQ。结果层面，FAIR-Calib 在多类 benchmark 上都比直接迁移 AR-LLM PTQ 方法更稳，尤其是在更难的推理任务上退化更少。论文反复强调三类中间指标的改善：一是 teacher-forced commit-step flips 变少，说明量化模型在写入边界更不容易被扰动翻转；二是 post-commit mismatch 减少，既包括平均意义上的 mean-disagree，也包括更严重的 never-agree 情况；三是 probability-MSE trace 更平缓，说明错误一旦发生后的逐步放大被抑制。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从正文描述看，作者做了至少三类关键消融：去掉 frontier-aware weighting、去掉 reliability gating、以及不用 off-policy weighted calibration，性能都会回落；这支持方法不是单一 trick，而是两阶段设计共同起作用。另一个值得注意的实验点是 prior 的跨语料迁移性，说明第一阶段学到的不是某个校准集的偶然统计，而更接近 dLLM 解码机制本身的脆弱区域分布。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看引言和 Figure 1，理解作者为什么说 dLLM 的量化难点不是一般噪声，而是 irreversible commit 下的 stability lag。这里如果看懂了，后面的加权校准就顺了。第二，看方法部分关于 Stage I prior 的定义，重点弄清 frontier hit、masked-stage reliability、以及它们如何组合成 position-aware prior；这决定了方法是否真的抓住了 dLLM 特性。第三，看实验里关于 commit-step flips、post-commit mismatch、probability-MSE trace 的图表，这些比最终 benchmark 分数更能说明方法是否对症。预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟足够建立判断；如果你在做 dLLM 或 any-order / masked 生成模型的部署，建议再细看 weighted hidden-state MSE 的推导与消融，因为这里涉及“用什么 surrogate 才能保护解码前沿”这个更一般的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a quantization failure mode that is specific to diffusion LLMs rather than generic low-bit degradation. In a dLLM, decoding proceeds through iterative denoising over the whole sequence, and some masked positions are irreversibly written into concrete tokens at each step. The key mismatch is that commitment happens earlier than stabilization: a position may be committed, yet the model’s top-1 preference for that position can still oscillate for several later denoising steps. The authors formalize this as stability lag. Post-training quantization introduces small perturbations that are especially likely to flip these borderline decisions at the write frontier. Once flipped, the wrong token is locked into the context and the error propagates through later refinement. So the core problem is not merely larger quantization noise, but the interaction between irreversible commit and fragile pre-stable states, which standard PTQ calibration objectives do not protect well.
summary_en.importance: Its value is twofold. First, it shows that PTQ recipes transferred from autoregressive LLMs are not sufficient for diffusion LLMs, even when the backbone architecture is similar, because the decoding mechanism changes where errors matter and how they propagate. Second, the paper contributes a useful analysis lens for dLLMs: commit frontier sensitivity, post-commit mismatch, and sequential error amplification. For researchers working on non-AR language modeling, this is more informative than a plain benchmark table because it identifies the coupling between decoding policy, model uncertainty, and deployment-time approximation. In terms of impact, this is more of a strong deployment-and-analysis contribution than a change to pretraining itself, but it addresses a practical bottleneck that any usable dLLM stack will face.
summary_en.technical_approach: FAIR-Calib has two stages. Stage I is teacher probing. A full-precision teacher is used to estimate a position-aware prior that combines two signals: whether a position is at the write frontier, and how reliable the teacher is at that masked-stage position and timestep. Intuitively, positions that are both frontier-exposed and intrinsically unstable should receive more protection during calibration. The authors argue that this prior is mechanism-driven and therefore transfers reasonably across calibration corpora. Stage II is off-policy, layer-wise calibration. Instead of running expensive end-to-end diffusion rollouts with the quantized model, the method uses a teacher-forcing surrogate and aligns hidden states layer by layer under teacher trajectories. The loss is a reweighted hidden-state MSE, where the weights come from Stage I. This means calibration no longer treats all positions and timesteps equally; it explicitly prioritizes fragile frontier states. The paper also motivates an additive time-by-position weighting scheme and explains why weighted hidden-state MSE is a reasonable surrogate for preserving commit stability under mild assumptions. At the quantizer level, the implementation follows a FlatQuant-style learnable affine reparameterization to flatten weight and activation distributions before symmetric uniform quantization. The novelty is therefore not a new quantizer, but a dLLM-specific calibration target and an efficient off-policy procedure.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental story is built around both end-task quality and mechanism-level diagnostics. The main setting is W4A4 PTQ on diffusion LLMs such as Dream and LLaDA. FAIR-Calib consistently outperforms naive transfers of AR-LLM PTQ baselines across multiple benchmarks, with the largest benefit on harder reasoning tasks where dLLMs are more brittle under perturbation. More importantly, the paper reports improvements on three internal metrics: fewer teacher-forced commit-step flips, reduced post-commit mismatch including both mean-disagree and more severe never-agree cases, and flatter probability-MSE traces showing weaker stepwise error amplification after a false commit. The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, but the full text indicates several meaningful ablations: removing frontier-aware weighting, removing reliability gating, or dropping the off-policy weighted calibration each hurts performance. This suggests the gains come from the full two-stage design rather than a single heuristic. Another notable result is the cross-corpus transferability of the Stage I prior, which supports the claim that the estimated weights capture a decoding-mechanism property rather than dataset-specific statistics.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and Figure 1 carefully; they contain the real motivation of the paper, namely why quantization in dLLMs is dominated by irreversible commit under stability lag rather than by generic approximation error. Second, inspect the Stage I prior in the method section and understand how frontier hits and masked-stage reliability are combined. That is the conceptual center of the method. Third, look at the diagnostic plots for commit-step flips, post-commit mismatch, and probability-MSE traces. These are more revealing than the final benchmark numbers because they show whether the method actually fixes the proposed failure mode. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for a useful pass. If your work touches dLLM deployment or non-AR generation more broadly, it is worth spending extra time on the weighted hidden-state MSE surrogate and its ablations.

recommendation.zh: 针对扩散LM特有的写前沿稳定性问题设计量化校准，做diffusion LM落地的研究员可以复用其重加权校准思路，重点看§3核心方法
recommendation.en: The weighted calibration design for dLLM's write frontier instability is directly reusable for diffusion LM deployment research; focus on §3 for core methodology

paper.title: Video-Rate Streaming Stylization on a Vision-Aware MLLM-Conditioned Edit Diffusion: Asymmetric Batched Inference on a Distilled UNet + MLLM Text Encoder
paper.abstract: Aggressive distillation of the diffusion U-Net inverts the per-frame bottleneck of real-time text-to-image pipelines: once the denoiser is a 4-step or 1-step distilled student, the text encoder becomes the critical path. This inversion is most acute in vision-aware edit diffusion, where the encoder is a multimodal large language model (MLLM). We study the case of a 0.39B distilled edit U-Net paired with a 2.13B MLLM text encoder (Qwen3-VL) and present a streaming pipeline targeted at this regime

summary.core_problem: 蒸馏后diffusion U-Net推理时，MLLM文本编码器成为新瓶颈，尤其是vision-aware edit diffusion场景下尤其严重
summary.importance: 工程突破：单消费级GPU上实现视频速率(27.4fps@512x512视频风格化
summary.technical_approach: 非对称CUDA流水线批处理文本编码器摊销+静态提示缓存，ControlNet-LLLite重写为单融合图，周期性条件刷新
summary.experiments: 0.39B蒸馏U-Net + 2.13B Qwen3-VL文本编码器，RTX 3090 Ti上27.4fps/480帧

summary_en.core_problem: After aggressive U-Net distillation, the MLLM text encoder becomes the inference bottleneck in vision-aware edit diffusion
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough: video-rate streaming stylization on consumer GPU
summary_en.technical_approach: Asymmetric CUDA pipelining with batched text-encoder amortization + static prompt caching, compile-friendly ControlNet-LLLite fusion, periodic conditioning refresh
summary_en.experiments: 0.39B distilled U-Net + 2.13B Qwen3-VL encoder; 27.4 fps on RTX 3090 Ti at 512x512

recommendation.zh: diffusion+MLLM流水线工程优化，非对称批处理和条件摊销思路对多模态推理服务有一定启发，但过于场景特定
recommendation.en: Diffusion+MLLM pipeline engineering; asymmetric batching and amortization ideas may启发 multimodal serving but highly scenario-specific

paper.title: Value-Aware Stochastic KV Cache Eviction for Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning models improve accuracy through extended chains of thought, but their long outputs create a memory and compute bottleneck. KV cache eviction methods reduce this cost by evicting unimportant key-value pairs from the cache, yet they often yield worse accuracy than selection-based sparse attention alternatives, which keep the full KV cache. We identify key factors crucial to KV cache eviction accuracy. First, a small fraction of value states have abnormally large magnitudes, and evicting

summary.core_problem: 推理模型在生成超长思维链时，KV cache 随序列长度线性增长，造成严重的显存与计算瓶颈。现有 eviction 方法（永久丢弃不重要 KV 对）在推理任务上精度下降显著，往往不如保留完整 cache 的 selection 类稀疏注意力方法。
summary.importance: 揭示了 KV cache 管理中两个被忽视的关键因素——value 向量幅值分布的极端偏态性，以及随机性在 eviction 中的正面作用。对推理服务的工程落地有直接参考价值，也提示了 attention value 统计特性可能是预训练动态分析的一个有用窗口。
summary.technical_approach: VaSE 是一个无需训练的 eviction 策略，建立在两个观察之上：(1) value 向量幅值呈强偏态分布，极少数大幅值 value 对精度至关重要，驱逐它们会导致模型陷入重复推理循环；(2) 在 eviction 中引入随机性能提高保留 KV 的多样性，从而提升精度。具体做法：用 value 向量的 L2 范数作为重要性评分，优先保留大幅值 value；在评分中加入随机扰动（stochastic gumbel-max 采样）增加多样性。采用周期性 eviction 框架：分为永久缓存 K 个 token + 最近 B 个 token 的 buffer。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-14B 上评测，覆盖数学、代码、科学 QA 共 6 个任务。相比之前最优 eviction 方法 R-KV，VaSE 平均提升 4.4%（4B）和 4.9%（14B）。与 CurDKV 结合时结合时，随机采样额外分别再提升 7.7% 和 9.2%。在静态显存预算下，精度甚至略超过内存随序列线性增长的 selection 方法 SeerAttention-R。在 GSM8K 上单 value 评分贡献 16.2% 提升，随机性额外贡献 4.7%。同时实测了吞吐量和峰值显存，验证与理论压缩比基本吻合。此外还将 insight 推广到 KV 量化场景，证明大幅值 value 在 per-token 量化下也造成不成比例的重建误差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Figure 2（value 幅值分布直方图）和 Figure 9（evicting 大幅值 value 导致的失败案例）。阅读约 15-20 分钟。技术贡献主要看 method 方法与消融实验（Section 3-4）。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在文中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning models generate extremely long chains of thought, causing KV cache to grow linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory and compute bottleneck. Existing eviction methods (permanently discarding unimportant KV pairs) degrade accuracy notably on reasoning tasks, underperforming selection-based sparse attention that keeps the full cache.
summary_en.importance: Uncovers two underappreciated factors in KV cache management: the extremely skewed value magnitude distribution and the benefit of stochasticity in eviction. Offers a train-free recipe that directly improves reasoning service engineering, and also suggests that value statistics may be a useful lens for analyzing pretraining dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: VaSE is a training-free eviction strategy built on two observations: (1) value vector magnitudes are strongly skewed—a tiny fraction of large-magnitude values are critical to accuracy; evicting them triggers repetitive reasoning loops; (2) injecting stochasticity into eviction improves diversity of retained KV pairs. Specifically, VaSE uses L2 norm of value vectors as importance score, prioritizing large-magnitude values, and adds stochastic perturbation (Gumbel-max sampling) to increase diversity. Adopts a periodic-eviction framework with a persistent budget of K tokens plus a small buffer B of most recent tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B across 6 tasks spanning math, code, and science QA. VaSE outperforms prior SOTA eviction method R-KV by 4.4% (4B) and 4.9% (14B) on average. When combined with CurDKV, stochastic sampling further boosts accuracy by 7.7% and 9.2% respectively. Under static memory budget, VaSE even slightly exceeds selection method SeerAttention-R whose memory grows linearly with sequence length. On GSM8K, value scoring alone contributes 16.2% improvement and stochasticity adds another 4.7%. Throughput and peak memory benchmarks closely match theoretical compression ratios. The insight also generalizes to KV quantization: large-magnitude values cause disproportionate reconstruction error under per-token quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Figure 2 (value magnitude distribution histogram) and Figure 9 (failure cases from evicting large-magnitude values). Estimated reading time 15-20 min. Method and ablation are in Sections 3-4.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看§3对大幅值value状态的现象分析即可，方案是免训练的推理侧优化，对预训练侧的直接参考有限。
recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 for the analysis of large-magnitude value states. This is a training-free inference optimization with limited direct implications for pretraining.

paper.title: ProbeScale: Probing Analysis to Optimize Neural Scaling Laws for Efficient Small Language Model Inference

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图用 probing 分数来选择小语言模型中的任务相关层，从而在参数预算受限时保留更有用的子网络。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近推理压缩和表示诊断。可取之处在于把 probing 从“解释模型哪里编码了什么信息”推进到“用 probing 指导结构化裁剪”。这能帮助分析预训练模型的层功能分布，也能作为 layer dropping、early-exit、task-specific subnet 选择的一个信号。需要注意的是，论文标题里的 scaling law 更多是动机：它假设起点模型是按较好规模规律训练出来的 SLM，但方法本身没有拟合新的 scaling law，也没有解决预训练阶段的 compute/data/token 配比问题。
summary.technical_approach: ProbeScale 的流程是：给定一个预训练 SLM 和目标任务 T，先选出和任务相关的一组 probing 属性 P_T，例如 sentiment 任务可直接用情感属性，NER 可用 POS、chunking 等属性。然后对每一层表示 h_l 训练简单 probe，得到属性 p 在层 l 上的验证性能 V_{p,l}。论文定义任务相关层分数 R_{l,T}=sum_p w(p,T)V_{p,l}，其中 w 表示不同 probing 属性对目标任务的重要性。最后在参数或 FLOPs 预算 B 下选择层子集 S，使选中层的相关性分数之和最大。子集可以是任意层集合，也可以限制为连续 block；选中层连同 embedding 和任务 head 组成子网络。和启发式 layer pruning 的区别是，它不简单保留前几层、后几层或按 fine-tuning loss 删除层，而是用任务相关 probe 明确度量每层的功能贡献。
summary.experiments: 论文前部描述的实验对象包括 RoBERTa-Large 和 T5-Base，任务包括 sentiment classification 和 NER。结果表述为 ProbeScale 相比启发式基线有更好的性能-参数折中，并能在保留下游任务能力的同时减少参数量。给出的内容没有包含完整实验表格和具体数值，因此不宜推断精确提升幅度。可以确定的实验设计重点是比较 probe-guided layer selection 与 heuristic baselines，并考察不同任务下被选层是否随任务属性变化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 15–20 分钟即可。重点看 Framework 部分的层相关性定义 R_{l,T} 和预算约束下的选择目标，这是整篇工作的核心。实验部分建议只看两类信息：一是和随机裁剪、保留首尾层、连续层保留等基线相比的性能-参数曲线；二是不同任务选出的层分布是否符合已有 layer specialization 经验。对预训练研究者来说，最值得带走的是 probing signal 能否作为结构化压缩和层功能分析的统一工具；不必把它当作 scaling law 工作来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes to use probing scores to select task-relevant layers from a small language model, aiming to keep useful subnetworks under parameter or compute constraints.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is modest and indirect. The useful idea is to turn probing from a purely analytical tool into a selection signal for structured pruning. This can help study how pretrained representations distribute task-relevant information across layers, and it may inform layer dropping, task-specific subnetworks, or early-exit design. The scaling-law connection is mostly motivational: the method assumes that the starting SLM has been well trained for its size, but it does not estimate new scaling laws or optimize pretraining data, compute, or model-size allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProbeScale starts from a pretrained SLM with L layers and a target task T. It selects a set of probing properties P_T relevant to the task. For each layer l and each property p, a simple probe is trained on the layer representation h_l, producing a validation score V_{p,l}. The layer relevance score is defined as R_{l,T}=sum_p w(p,T)V_{p,l}, where the weights encode how important each probing property is for the target task. The algorithm then chooses a subset of layers S that maximizes the aggregate relevance score under a parameter or FLOP budget. The selected layers, together with embeddings and a task head, form the compressed subnetwork. The main difference from heuristic layer pruning is that the pruning decision is driven by task-specific representation evidence rather than fixed rules such as keeping bottom layers, top layers, or a contiguous block by default.
summary_en.experiments: The described experiments use SLM-scale models including RoBERTa-Large and T5-Base, with downstream tasks such as sentiment classification and named entity recognition. The paper claims better performance-efficiency trade-offs than heuristic baselines and meaningful parameter reduction while preserving task performance. The provided text does not include full result tables or exact numerical gains, so the safe reading is qualitative: the empirical test is whether probe-guided layer selection beats random or rule-based layer selection and whether the selected layers vary sensibly across tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is sufficient. Read the framework section for the definition of R_{l,T} and the constrained layer-selection objective. In the experiments, focus on performance-versus-parameter curves and on the distribution of selected layers for different tasks. For pretraining researchers, the useful takeaway is the use of probing as a structured signal for layer functionality and compression. It should not be read as a scaling-law paper in the Kaplan or Chinchilla sense.

recommendation.zh: 将内部表征探针与 Scaling Law 结合来指导小模型设计，视角新颖，关注 compute-optimal 和小模型 scaling 的研究员可看其预测公式和实验设定。
recommendation.en: Combines internal representation probing with Scaling Laws to guide small model design; a novel perspective. Researchers focusing on compute-optimal scaling and SLMs should review its prediction formulas and experimental setup.

paper.title: Pair-In, Pair-Out: Latent Multi-Token Prediction for Efficient LLMs
paper.abstract: Long chain-of-thought reasoning has made autoregressive decoding the dominant inference cost of modern large language models. Existing methods target either the input side (latent compression) or the output side (speculative decoding and multi-token prediction, MTP), but the two lines of work have been pursued independently. Moreover, output-side methods must incur an expensive verifier pass to validate the unreliable draft tokens predicted by MTP. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Pai

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是长链式推理场景下自回归解码成本过高的问题。现有路线通常只处理一侧：输入侧用 latent compression 缩短有效上下文，输出侧用 speculative decoding 或 multi-token prediction 一步生成多个 token。但输出侧方法往往需要大模型 verifier 再跑一遍来确认 draft token，接受 token 仍要经过完整 backbone，速度上限被 verifier 成本限制。PIPO 试图把输入压缩、输出展开和 draft 置信判断放进同一个 pair-level 接口里。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值不在于提出一个新的预训练 scaling 结论，而在于给出了一种训练目标、模型接口和推理机制耦合的设计。它把“两个输入 token 压成一个 latent”和“一个 hidden state 展开出额外 token”看成镜像操作，从而把解码单位从单 token 改成 token pair。对基座研究有两个启发：第一，MTP head 不只是 speculative decoding 的附属模块，也可以和输入侧 latent compression 一起定义新的序列建模接口；第二，on-policy distillation 中 teacher/student 分布已经包含 verifier 所需信号，可以被复用来训练轻量 confidence head，减少推理时的大模型验证成本。需要注意的是，它用 confidence head 近似替代 verifier，效率收益来自放弃严格 rejection-sampling 验证路径，分布等价性不如标准 speculative decoding 清晰。
summary.technical_approach: PIPO 把每个 decoding step 改成 pair step。输入端，compressor 接收两个连续 token embedding 的拼接，用一个 MLP 映射成一个 latent 表示 z_i。论文强调初始化时让 f([a;b]) 接近 a+b，以减小训练初期对 backbone 输入分布的扰动。输出端，backbone 在 pair-level 序列上前向，预测第一个常规 token 分布 p_b，同时由 MTP/draft head 预测第二个 token 分布 p_d。这样，一个 pair step 同时消费压缩后的双 token 输入，并尝试产生两个输出 token。关键补充是 confidence head：训练时利用 OPD 中已经计算出的 teacher 分布 p_t 和 student/draft 分布 p_s，把 speculative decoding 的接受概率 min(p_t/p_s, 1) 作为监督标签。推理时，若 confidence c_i 高于阈值 τ_c，则接受 draft token；否则拒绝 draft，并用 padding token 填入下一组 pair，使模型接口始终保持 pair-in/pair-out 的形态。与 EAGLE-2 或传统 speculative decoding 相比，PIPO 的差异是 verifier 不再是一次完整的大模型 forward，而是由轻量 confidence head 近似承担“是否可信”的判断。与单纯 latent compression 相比，它不只缩短输入序列，也提高每步输出 token 数。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B backbone，在 AIME 2025、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench v6 和 LongBench v2 上评估。对比对象包括 regular decoding、无验证的 MTP decoding，以及 EAGLE-2 speculative decoding。主要结果是 pass@4 在两个 backbone 上都优于最强基线：Qwen3.5-4B 上提升 +3.83 分，Qwen3.5-9B 上提升 +7.15 分。效率方面，相对 regular decoding，TTFT 最高达到 2.64× 加速，TPOT 最高达到 2.07× 加速。论文还指出，当 context budget 增大时，PIPO 的优势会扩大，原因是 pair-out 让模型在相同步数内生成更多推理 token，更容易把完整 reasoning trace 放进预算内。实验部分最需要核查的是 confidence threshold 对准确率和速度的折中、拒绝 draft 后 padding 机制对后续状态的影响，以及 compressor 初始化和 OPD 监督对稳定性的贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对 latent compressor、MTP head 和 verifier/teacher 角色等价性的论证；Method 中的 pair-level decoding 定义、compressor 初始化、confidence head 训练目标和拒绝时的 padding 处理是核心。Figure 1 和 Figure 3 应该先看，用来建立 pair-in/pair-out 的执行图。Figure 2 适合看 context budget 与 pass@4 的关系，因为它说明 PIPO 的收益不只是单步吞吐，还影响长推理预算下的有效搜索。实验表格需要重点比较 PIPO、MTP without verification 和 EAGLE-2：这三者的差异能看出 confidence head 是否真的替代了 verifier 的主要功能。消融部分如果包含 τ_c、compressor 初始化、OPD label、padding/reject 策略，应优先看，这些决定方法能否从工程技巧变成可复用的训练接口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the dominant inference cost in long-chain reasoning LLMs: autoregressive decoding emits one token per full forward step. Prior work usually optimizes only one side of the interface. Latent compression shortens the input sequence, while speculative decoding and multi-token prediction increase output throughput. Output-side methods still pay a verifier cost, because draft tokens must be checked by a strong model. PIPO addresses these issues by turning decoding into a pair-level operation with compression on input, expansion on output, and a learned confidence mechanism for draft acceptance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an architecture-and-training interface for efficient reasoning models, not a new pretraining scaling result. Its useful insight for foundation-model research is that input compression and MTP can be treated as symmetric operations: fold two tokens into one latent representation on the way in, and unfold one hidden state into an additional token on the way out. It also connects on-policy distillation with speculative verification. The teacher/student distributions computed during OPD already provide the same signal needed to estimate acceptance probability, so they can supervise a lightweight confidence head. The main caveat is that replacing a full verifier with a confidence head changes the guarantee profile. The method buys latency by approximating verification rather than preserving the exact rejection-sampling path of standard speculative decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: PIPO changes the basic decoding unit from a single token to a token pair. On the input side, a compressor MLP takes the concatenation of two consecutive token embeddings and maps them to one latent vector. The compressor is initialized so that f([a;b]) is close to a+b, which keeps the initial input distribution closer to what the backbone has seen. On the output side, the backbone predicts the first next-token distribution, while an MTP or draft head predicts the second token distribution. A confidence head predicts whether the draft token should be accepted. During training, the label for this confidence head is derived from the speculative acceptance probability min(p_t/p_s, 1), where p_t comes from the teacher and p_s from the student or draft model in OPD. At inference time, if the confidence exceeds a threshold, the draft token is accepted; otherwise it is replaced by a padding token before the next compression step, preserving the pair-level interface. Compared with EAGLE-style speculative decoding, the expensive verifier pass is replaced by a small head. Compared with pure latent reasoning, the method both halves effective input length and increases tokens emitted per step.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B on AIME 2025, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench v6, and LongBench v2. Baselines include regular decoding, unverified MTP decoding, and EAGLE-2 speculative decoding. PIPO gives the best pass@4 among the compared methods on both backbones, improving over the strongest baseline by +3.83 points on the 4B model and +7.15 points on the 9B model. On efficiency, it reports up to 2.64× improvement in time to first token and up to 2.07× improvement in time per output token over regular decoding. The paper also reports that the accuracy advantage grows with larger context budgets, because emitting two tokens per step allows more complete reasoning traces to fit under the same step or latency budget. The most important experimental details to inspect are the confidence-threshold trade-off, behavior under draft rejection, compressor initialization, and the dependence on OPD-derived supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction for the symmetry argument between latent compression and MTP, and for the connection between OPD teachers and speculative verifiers. The method section is the key part: focus on pair-level state transitions, compressor initialization, confidence-head labeling, and the padding mechanism used after rejection. Figure 1 and Figure 3 should be read early to understand the data flow. Figure 2 is useful for seeing why the method helps more under larger reasoning budgets. In the experiments, compare PIPO against unverified MTP and EAGLE-2 rather than only against regular decoding; that comparison isolates the value of learned confidence. Any ablation on τ_c, compressor initialization, OPD labels, and reject handling is worth close reading.

recommendation.zh: 将 latent compression 和 MTP 统一为镜像操作的思路非常优雅，且通过置信度头干掉了推测解码的 verifier，强烈建议精读其架构设计和 OPD 训练细节。
recommendation.en: The idea of unifying latent compression and MTP as mirror operations is highly elegant. By eliminating the speculative decoding verifier via a confidence head, it's strongly recommended to closely read its architecture design and OPD training details.

paper.title: Meta-Attention: Bayesian Per-Token Routing for Efficient Transformer Inference
paper.abstract: Standard transformer architectures apply a single attention mechanism uniformly across all tokens and sequence positions, irrespective of local context or computational budget.
