We propose Meta-Attention, a framework that dynamically routes each token to the most appropriate attention strategy -- full softmax attention, linear (kernel) attention, or sliding-window local attention -- via a Bayesian Meta-Controller. Unlike prior routing approaches that use deterministic or prior-free learned routin

summary.core_problem: 标准Transformer对所有token统一使用同一种注意力机制，无法按需分配算力，现有高效注意力方法在架构设计阶段就固定单一算法，无法兼顾长程依赖精度和整体推理效率。
summary.importance: 提出了token级动态选择注意力机制的贝叶斯路由框架，为推理效率优化提供了可解释、算力可调控的新路径，也为稀疏激活架构的路由设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Meta-Attention架构，将每个token的注意力机制选择建模为贝叶斯后验推断问题：内置全注意力、线性核注意力、滑动窗口注意力三个专家，通过2层MLP参数化的变分后验输出每个token的路由概率，同时加入编码算力偏好的狄利克雷先验（算力越高的机制先验权重越低），用ELBO目标训练路由控制器，支持软路由和基于不确定性阈值的硬路由，还验证了该方法与MoD（Mixture of Depths）架构正交可组合。
summary.experiments: 在Tiny LM上的消融实验显示，硬路由下贝叶斯控制器的归一化FLOP成本为25.1%，仅为无先验基线的42.3%（降低2.4倍），同时路由熵更低（43.3% vs 55.8%），在不损失任务性能的前提下避免了路由坍缩到高成本的全注意力机制，原型已验证前向传播正确性、后验多样性和校准指标。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Introduction中对现有高效注意力缺陷的定位、架构部分的狄利克雷先验设计、Tiny LM的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard Transformers apply the same attention mechanism to all tokens uniformly without on-demand compute allocation, and existing efficient attention methods fix a single algorithm at architecture design time, failing to balance long-range dependency accuracy and overall inference efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a Bayesian routing framework for per-token dynamic attention mechanism selection, providing an interpretable, compute-adjustable path for inference efficiency optimization, and reference for routing design in sparse activation architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Meta-Attention, which formulates per-token attention mechanism selection as Bayesian posterior inference. It includes three attention experts: full softmax attention, linear kernel attention, and sliding-window local attention. A 2-layer MLP parameterizes the amortized variational posterior to output per-token routing probabilities, with a compute-aware Dirichlet prior that assigns lower prior weight to more compute-heavy mechanisms. The controller is trained with an ELBO objective, supporting both soft routing and hard routing gated by per-token uncertainty. The work also confirms the approach is orthogonal and composable with Mixture of Depths (MoD) architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Ablation on Tiny LM shows that under hard routing, the Bayesian controller achieves 25.1% normalized FLOP cost, only 42.3% of the prior-free baseline (2.4x reduction), with lower routing entropy (43.3% vs 55.8%). It avoids routing collapse to expensive full attention without task performance degradation. The PyTorch prototype has validated forward-pass correctness, posterior diversity, and calibration metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the positioning of limitations of existing efficient attention in Introduction, the Dirichlet prior design in the architecture section, and ablation results on Tiny LM. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 贝叶斯路由视角新鲜，ELBO联合优化性能与成本的思路值得在推理效率研究中参考，重点看§3方法。
recommendation.en: The Bayesian routing perspective is fresh; the ELBO joint optimization of performance and cost is worth noting for inference efficiency research. Focus on §3.

paper.title: Skill Weaving: Efficient LLM Improvement via Modular Skillpacks
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly require specialization across diverse domains, yet existing approaches struggle to balance multi-domain capacities with strict memory and inference constraints. In this work, we introduce SkillWeave, a modular improvement framework that enables LLMs to specialize under fixed memory budgets. SkillWeave partitions full capabilities of a general-purpose model into skillpacks -- lightweight, domain-specific delta modules -- that reorganize and refine the model's in

summary.core_problem: LLM需要在多领域专业化，同时保持内存和推理效率，现有方法难以平衡这一矛盾。
summary.importance: 提出模块化的SkillWeave框架，通过轻量级领域特定delta模块实现固定内存预算下的多领域专业化。
summary.technical_approach: 将通用模型的完整能力划分为skillpacks（轻量级领域delta模块），通过SkillZip压缩为推理就绪格式，实现低延迟部署。
summary.experiments: 9B参数SkillWeave模型在多任务和Agent基准上优于多个基线，甚至超越32B单块模型，同时实现最高4倍加速。
summary.authors_note: 哈尔滨工业大学、香港理工大学、上海交通大学的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs need specialization across domains while meeting memory and inference constraints; existing approaches fail to balance this trade-off.
summary_en.importance: Proposes SkillWeave, a modular framework enabling LLM specialization under fixed memory budgets via lightweight domain-specific delta modules.
summary_en.technical_approach: Partitions full model capabilities into skillpacks (lightweight domain-specific delta modules), then compresses them via SkillZip into inference-ready format for low-latency deployment.
summary_en.experiments: A 9B SkillWeave model outperforms several baselines and surpasses a 32B monolithic LLM on multi-task and agentic benchmarks, achieving up to 4x speedup.
summary_en.authors_note: Researchers from Harbin Institute of Technology, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Shanghai Jiaotong University.

recommendation.zh: 模块化delta参数+压缩的思路对高效推理有一定参考，但属于增量架构改进，非预训练核心关切，快速浏览即可。
recommendation.en: Modular delta-parameter compression approach has some relevance for efficient inference, but is incremental architecture work, not core pretraining concern; quick glance suffices.

paper.title: Structured-Sparse Attention for Entity Tracking with Subquadratic Sequence Complexity
paper.abstract: Entity tracking requires maintaining and updating latent states for entities and attributes over long sequences. Recent task-specific attention operators can compress deep Transformer stacks into a few layers by performing multi-hop state propagation within a single layer, but their dense evaluation remains expensive. We show that in this setting, learned attention is strongly structured: most mass concentrates in local block-diagonal neighborhoods with a light cross-block residue. Exploiting th

summary.core_problem: 降低长序列实体跟踪中任务特定 attention operator 的计算成本，同时尽量保持 dense operator 的多跳状态传播能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是注意力结构与效率改进。它不是通用 LLM serving 优化，但对“长序列任务中 attention 质量集中在局部块、跨块残差较轻”这个现象给出可利用的计算结构。
summary.technical_approach: 论文观察到学习到的 attention 呈强结构性：大部分权重集中在局部 block-diagonal neighborhood，少量质量分布在跨块 residue。基于此，作者推导 blockwise resolvent-style operator：块内交互精确计算，跨块交互通过低维 reduced system 路由，从而得到次二次复杂度。
summary.experiments: 在 controlled entity tracking benchmarks 上，该方法匹配 dense operator 的准确率，并在标准化测量协议下减少 12-29% wall-clock time；复杂度为 O(n^{4/3}d)，当 d≈n 时为 O(n^{7/3})，相对某个对比实现最高快 2.4 倍。未见摘要给出 LLM 规模或真实语言建模任务结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces the cost of task-specific attention operators for long-sequence entity tracking while preserving the dense operator’s ability to perform multi-hop state propagation.
summary_en.importance: This is an attention-efficiency contribution rather than a general LLM serving paper. Its useful signal is the exploitable structure: learned attention for entity tracking concentrates locally with a light cross-block residue.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors observe that most attention mass lies in local block-diagonal neighborhoods, with only a small cross-block component. They derive a blockwise evaluation of a resolvent-style operator that computes within-block interactions exactly and routes cross-block interactions through a reduced system, yielding subquadratic sequence complexity.
summary_en.experiments: On controlled entity-tracking benchmarks, the method matches the dense operator’s accuracy while reducing wall-clock time by 12-29% under a standardized protocol. The stated complexity is O(n^{4/3}d), or O(n^{7/3}) when d≈n, with up to 2.4x speedup over a comparison implementation. No LLM-scale or real language-modeling results are reported in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 看结构观察就够了；没有 LLM 规模验证前，不要把它当长上下文 attention 通用解。
recommendation.en: Read the structural observation, not the headline speedup; without LLM-scale tests, it is not a general long-context attention answer.

paper.title: IO-SVD: Input-Output Whitened SVD for Adaptive-Rank LLM Compression
paper.abstract: Large language models deliver strong performance across language and reasoning tasks, but their storage and compute costs remain major barriers to deployment in resource-constrained and latency-sensitive settings. SVD-based post-training compression offers a hardware-agnostic way to reduce model size and improve inference efficiency through low-rank factorization. However, existing methods often rely on input-only whitening spaces, homogeneous rank allocation, or loss-agnostic allocation heurist

summary.core_problem: 现有基于SVD的训练后大模型压缩方法存在白化空间单一、秩分配不合理、计算开销高的问题，高压缩率下难以保留模型性能。
summary.importance: 提供了无需重新训练的低开销后训练压缩方案，将预测分布KL散度引入SVD设计的思路可为大模型部署压缩提供参考，无需改动预训练流程即可实现高效压缩，同时支持LLM和VLM两类模型。
summary.technical_approach: IO-SVD是训练后SVD压缩方法，从原始与压缩模型预测分布的KL散度二阶展开推导双侧白化空间，采用贪心的损失感知异构秩分配策略，支持损失感知的混合SVD-8比特量化压缩，计算开销远低于梯度优化的秩分配方法。
summary.experiments: 在最大13B参数的LLM和VLM家族上验证有效，高压缩率下性能保留优于现有SVD压缩方法，混合压缩进一步降低精度损失，在不同部署硬件下均有稳定效率提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注方法部分的双侧白化空间推导、损失感知秩分配策略设计，以及附录的KL二阶展开数学推导，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing SVD-based post-training LLM compression methods suffer from input-only whitening, unreasonable rank allocation, and high computational overhead, leading to severe performance degradation under aggressive compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: It provides a low-overhead post-training compression scheme without retraining, and the idea of introducing predictive KL divergence into SVD design can serve as reference for LLM and VLM deployment compression, with no modifications to pretraining pipelines required.
summary_en.technical_approach: IO-SVD is a post-training SVD compression method. It derives a double-sided whitening space from the second-order expansion of the KL divergence between the original and compressed model’s predictive distributions, adopts a greedy loss-aware heterogeneous rank allocation strategy, and supports loss-aware hybrid SVD-8bit quantization compression, with much lower computational overhead than gradient-based rank allocation methods.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across LLM and VLM families with up to 13B parameters. It outperforms existing SVD compression methods in performance retention under high compression ratios, and hybrid compression further reduces accuracy loss, with stable efficiency improvements across different deployment hardware settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Method section for the derivation of double-sided whitening space and loss-aware rank allocation strategy, as well as the appendix for mathematical derivation of second-order KL expansion. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SVD压缩方向的增量改进，KL感知双边白化的思路有参考价值。做LLM压缩的团队可看§3的IO-SVD核心推导，其余人浏览摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in SVD-based compression; the KL-aware double-sided whitening idea is worth noting. Teams working on LLM compression should read §3 for the core derivation; others can skim the abstract.

paper.title: Self-Pruned Key-Value Attention: Learning When to Write by Predicting Future Utility
paper.abstract: Under modern test-time compute and agentic paradigms, language models process ever-longer sequences. Efficient text generation with transformer architectures is increasingly constrained by the Key-Value cache memory footprint and bandwidth. To address this limitation, we introduce Self-Pruned Key-Value Attention (SP-KV), a mechanism designed to predict future KV utility in order to reduce the size of the long-term KV cache. This strategy operates at a fine granularity: a lightweight utility pred

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文解码里的一个老问题：KV cache 的瓶颈已经越来越像内存带宽问题，而不是算力问题。现有方法大多只在“读”的时候做稀疏化，或者在预填充后做事后驱逐；前者省 FLOPs 但不省显存，后者容易出现训练-推理失配，因为模型表征并没有为被裁剪的缓存而适配。作者要解决的是：能不能在写入 KV cache 的时候就学会“哪些 token 值得进入长期记忆”，并且只用标准 next-token 训练信号完成联合学习，而不依赖额外监督或冻结模型后的校准。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两层。第一层是工程层面：它把 KV 压缩从事后启发式，推进到可训练的架构设计，目标不是单纯做推理 trick，而是让模型在持续预训练阶段就适配稀疏写入机制。这一点和只做 read sparsity、eviction policy 的工作不同。第二层是研究层面：作者把 learned utility 当成一种“头部长期依赖需求”的探针，用它反过来指导 global/local hybrid attention 的布局设计。这使得 SP-KV 不只是一个推理优化模块，也是在回答哪些 head 真正在承担长期记忆、哪些 head 只需要局部上下文。对做长上下文预训练、混合注意力架构、训练后期 continual pretrain 的人，这个角度是有启发的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心很直接：对每一层、每个 key head、每个 token 位置，用一个很轻量的两层 MLP 从该层 hidden state 预测一个 utility 分数 u∈(0,1)。推理时，最近的 w 个 token 永远可见，形成 local sliding window；窗口之外的旧 token 只有在 utility 超过阈值 τ 时，才会被写入 persistent/global KV cache，并在后续全局注意力中可见。也就是说，它不是 query-aware 的读时检索，而是 token-wise、head-wise 的写时筛选。

训练时不能直接做硬阈值，因为会断梯度。作者采用 soft gating：把 log u 加到 attention mask bias 上。这样 u=1 时等价于不加偏置，u→0 时等价于把该位置屏蔽掉。模型和 utility predictor 端到端联合训练，训练目标仍然只是 next-token prediction。文中强调通常从 full-attention checkpoint 做 continual pretraining，而不是从零开始，这样更稳定，也更符合实际部署路径。

和已有方法相比，差异有三点。其一，H2O、KVZap 这类方法是在已有 cache 上做驱逐，SP-KV 是在写入时决定是否进入长期记忆，因而同时减少 cache 容量和后续读取流量。其二，QUEST、DeepSeek Sparse Attention 这类方法只做读稀疏，完整 cache 仍在内存里；SP-KV 直接减少持久缓存本身。其三，SP-KV 的 utility predictor 与主模型共同训练，避免了 frozen backbone + 小数据校准带来的分布偏移。

论文还有一个延伸用法：先在参考模型上训练 SP-KV，统计各 head 的平均 utility，再把 utility 高的 head 保留为 global，其他 head 改成 local，从而构造更合理的 hybrid transformer。这个思路比手工做 interleaved global/local layout 更数据驱动。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，作者做了几类关键实验。第一类是不同模型规模、不同序列分布下的 KV 压缩与质量权衡，结论是可以在较高 cache reduction 下保持验证损失和下游评测几乎不变。摘要和引言没有给出完整数字表，但论文主张的重点是“高压缩、低退化”，而且这种效果不是只在单一长度分布上成立。第二类是与 post-hoc eviction 方法的比较，作者强调压缩越激进、输入分布偏移越大，事后方法退化越明显，而联合训练的 SP-KV 更稳。第三类是迁移到 hybrid local-global attention 的实验：用 learned utility 选择 global heads，在相同 KV 预算下优于标准 interleaved layout。这个结果很关键，因为它说明 utility predictor 学到的不只是一个压缩策略，还包含了关于 head 功能分工的结构信息。

从方法细节可推断，实验里应重点报告：local window 默认 128；utility predictor 是 2-layer MLP；训练方式通常是从 pretrained full-attention checkpoint 做 continual pretraining；评估同时看 validation loss、下游任务和解码速度/显存占用。若精读全文，建议重点核对不同阈值 τ 下的 cache 保留率、per-head utility 分布、以及在长尾长上下文样本上的退化曲线，这些比单点平均指标更能说明方法边界。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读，但有几个位置值得认真看。先看 Introduction，作者把 write sparsity 和 read sparsity、post-hoc eviction 的区别讲得比较清楚。然后看方法部分里 soft gating 的公式：为什么用 log utility 加到 attention bias，而不是直接乘 attention score，这关系到训练稳定性和与 mask 语义的一致性。再看实验里三类图表：一是 cache reduction 对 loss/accuracy 的曲线，二是和 H2O、KVZap 之类方法的对比，三是 per-head utility 排名与 hybrid layout 设计结果。如果时间有限，抓住“联合训练的 sparse write 是否真的优于事后裁剪”以及“utility 是否真能作为 head 全局性的可靠指标”这两个问题即可，预计 25-35 分钟能完成一轮有效阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a growing inference bottleneck in long-context autoregressive decoding: KV cache cost is increasingly dominated by memory footprint and bandwidth rather than raw compute. Existing approaches usually sparsify reads or evict entries after prefill. Read sparsity reduces FLOPs but keeps the full cache in memory; post-hoc eviction often suffers from train-test mismatch because the model was never trained to operate under aggressive cache pruning. The paper asks a sharper question: can the model learn, during training, which tokens are worth writing into persistent long-term memory in the first place, using only the standard next-token objective?
summary_en.importance: Its value is not just as an inference optimization trick. The main contribution is to turn KV compression into a trainable architectural choice that can be integrated into continual pretraining from a dense checkpoint. That matters for long-context foundation models, where memory behavior should ideally be co-adapted with representations rather than patched afterward. A second contribution is more structural: the learned utility scores expose which heads actually need global memory and which mostly operate locally. That makes SP-KV useful as a probe for designing better local-global hybrid attention layouts under a fixed KV budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
For each layer, each key head, and each token position, a lightweight two-layer MLP predicts a utility score u in (0,1) from the hidden state. During inference, the most recent w tokens are always accessible through a causal local window. Older tokens are available to global attention only if their predicted utility exceeds a threshold τ, meaning only those key-value pairs are written into the persistent cache. This is write-time sparsification, not query-aware retrieval at read time.

Hard thresholding would block gradients, so training uses a soft relaxation: instead of binary gating, the model adds log u to the attention mask bias. When u=1, the bias is zero; when u approaches 0, the position is effectively masked out. The language model and the utility predictor are trained jointly end-to-end with the ordinary next-token loss, typically via continual pretraining from a pretrained full-attention checkpoint rather than training from scratch.

Relative to prior work, the distinctions are clear. Methods such as H2O or KVZap prune or evict cache entries after they have already been written; SP-KV decides whether to write them into long-term memory at all. Query-aware sparse attention methods reduce reads but still retain the full cache in memory; SP-KV reduces the persistent cache itself. And unlike frozen-model pruning policies calibrated on auxiliary data, SP-KV co-trains the pruning mechanism with the backbone, reducing distribution mismatch under stronger compression.

The paper also uses the learned utility as an architectural signal. After training SP-KV on a reference model, heads with high average utility are kept global while the rest are converted to local heads, yielding hybrid transformers that outperform standard interleaved layouts at the same KV budget.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental story has three main parts. First, across model scales and sequence distributions, SP-KV achieves substantial KV-cache reduction with negligible degradation in validation loss and downstream evaluations. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, but the claimed operating regime is clearly 'high compression, low quality loss.' Second, the paper compares against post-hoc eviction methods and argues that the gap widens as compression becomes more aggressive and as the input distribution shifts, which is exactly where train-test mismatch hurts frozen pruning schemes. Third, the utility scores transfer beyond dense attention: selecting global heads based on learned average utility yields stronger local-global hybrids than standard interleaved designs under the same cache budget.

The details worth checking in the full paper are the retention curves versus threshold τ, the default local window size of 128, the behavior across different context-length distributions, and the per-head utility histograms. Those analyses matter more than a single average metric because they show whether the method is robust or only tuned to a narrow operating point.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but several sections deserve focused attention. Start with the introduction to understand the distinction between write sparsity, read sparsity, and post-hoc eviction. Then read the method section carefully around the soft-gating formulation: adding log-utility to the attention bias is a small design choice with important implications for differentiability and mask semantics. In the experiments, prioritize three things: the compression-quality tradeoff curves, the comparison against eviction baselines, and the head-utility analysis used to build hybrid attention layouts. If reading time is limited, the key questions are whether jointly trained sparse writes truly outperform post-hoc pruning, and whether utility is a stable enough signal to guide architectural head allocation. A useful first pass should take about 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Meta提出的动态KV剪枝方案训练成本低，适配现有模型，做推理优化的团队可参考§3的联合训练方法做内部验证。
recommendation.en: This dynamic KV pruning method from Meta has low training cost and is compatible with existing checkpoints, refer to §3 for joint training details if working on inference efficiency.

paper.title: CoRDS: Coreset-based Representative and Diverse Selection for Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding with large vision-language models (VLMs) requires a compact memory that can support future reasoning over an ever-growing visual history. A common solution is to compress the key-value (KV) cache, but existing streaming methods typically rely on local token-wise heuristics, such as recency, temporal redundancy, or saliency, which do not explicitly optimize whether the retained cache is representative of the accumulated history. We propose to view KV-cache compressio

summary.core_problem: 流式视频理解中VLM的KV缓存压缩依赖局部token级启发式方法（如新近性、时间冗余），未显式优化保留内容是否代表累积视觉历史。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将KV缓存压缩视为coreset选择问题，在联合KV表示空间中做几何覆盖优化。
summary.technical_approach: CoRDS方法：(1)双准则目标平衡key和value空间的覆盖度，同时保留检索结构和输出相关信息；(2)正交性驱动的多样性准则促进保留子集的多样性。
summary.experiments: 在流式视频理解任务上验证，据称优于局部启发式方法。
summary.authors_note: UBC、Vector Institute，Leonid Sigal是资深CV/VLM领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache compression for streaming video understanding with VLMs relies on local token-wise heuristics (recency, temporal redundancy, saliency) that do not explicitly optimize whether retained content represents accumulated visual history.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: reframes KV-cache compression as a coreset selection problem, optimizing geometric coverage in joint KV representation space.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRDS method: (1) bicriteria objective balancing coverage in key and value spaces, preserving both retrieval structure and output-relevant information; (2) orthogonality-driven diversity criterion for diverse retained subsets.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on streaming video understanding tasks, outperforming local heuristic methods.
summary_en.authors_note: UBC, Vector Institute; Leonid Sigal is a well-known researcher in CV/VLM.

recommendation.zh: 将coreset方法应用于KV缓存压缩是新颖视角，但属于视频VLM推理优化，对LLM基座预训练研究员参考价值有限，仅作方法灵感参考。
recommendation.en: Coreset-based KV compression is a novel perspective but limited to video VLM inference optimization; minimal relevance for LLM foundation pretraining; reference for method inspiration only.

paper.title: Orthrus: Memory-Efficient Parallel Token Generation via Dual-View Diffusion
paper.abstract: We introduce Orthrus, a simple and efficient dual-architecture framework that unifies the exact generation fidelity of autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) with the high-speed parallel token generation of diffusion models. The sequential nature of standard autoregressive decoding represents a fundamental bottleneck for high-throughput inference. While diffusion language models attempt to break this barrier via parallel generation, they suffer from significant performance degradation, high

summary.core_problem: 自回归LLM解码阶段的严格串行特性导致推理延迟高、硬件利用率低；扩散语言模型虽支持并行生成，但存在效果差、训练成本高、无法匹配原自回归模型预测分布的问题，现有将自回归模型适配为扩散模型的方案仍需大量继续预训练，且存在效果损失。
summary.importance: 提出了自回归与扩散建模范式融合的低侵入式实现路径，无需重构预训练流程即可为现有基座模型注入并行生成能力，对推理阶段建模范式创新、基座模型能力扩展有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双视图架构Orthrus，冻结预训练自回归LLM的全部权重，仅在其注意力头旁新增一个轻量可训练的扩散模块，两者共享同一份KV缓存，无冗余缓存开销；生成阶段扩散模块基于自回归分支构建的高质量KV缓存并行生成多个token，再通过内置的双分支共识机制，由冻结的自回归分支验证扩散生成的token轨迹，保证最终输出严格匹配原自回归模型的预测分布，实现无损推理。
summary.experiments: 仅微调16%的总参数，使用不到1B token的训练数据，在单节点8卡H200上训练不超过24小时即可完成适配；推理阶段最高获得7.8倍的速度提升，同时输出分布与原自回归模型完全一致。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章的架构设计和双分支共识机制部分，以及第4章的速度和效果验证实验，预计阅读时间25分钟；扩散模型的基础介绍部分可跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: The strictly sequential decoding of autoregressive LLMs leads to high inference latency and low hardware utilization. Diffusion language models support parallel generation but suffer from inferior performance, high training costs, and inability to match the predictive distribution of original autoregressive models. Existing adaptation methods converting autoregressive models to diffusion models still require extensive continued pre-training and incur performance degradation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a low-intrusive path for integrating autoregressive and diffusion modeling paradigms. It enables parallel generation capabilities for existing base models without reconstructing the pre-training pipeline, offering direct reference for inference-phase paradigm innovation and base model capability expansion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Orthrus, a dual-view architecture. It freezes all weights of the pretrained autoregressive LLM, and only adds a lightweight trainable diffusion module alongside its attention heads. The two branches share the same KV cache with no redundant cache overhead. During generation, the diffusion module generates multiple tokens in parallel conditioned on the high-quality KV cache built by the autoregressive branch. An intrinsic two-branch consensus mechanism lets the frozen autoregressive branch validate the token trajectories generated by the diffusion view, ensuring the final output strictly matches the original autoregressive model's predictive distribution for lossless inference.
summary_en.experiments: Adaptation is completed by fine-tuning only 16% of total parameters, using less than 1B tokens of training data, and taking under 24 hours on a single 8xH200 node. It achieves up to 7.8x inference speedup while maintaining exact parity with the original autoregressive model's output distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the architecture design and two-branch consensus mechanism in Section 3, as well as speed and performance validation experiments in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes. Introductory sections on diffusion model basics can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: AR+扩散混合解码的新范式，共享KV缓存的设计很巧妙，§3.2双视图交互部分对探索非AR推理路径有启发
recommendation.en: A new AR+diffusion hybrid decoding paradigm with a clever shared KV cache design; the dual-view interaction part in §3.2 is inspiring for exploring non-AR inference paths

paper.title: Training-Inference Consistent Segmented Execution for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models face severe scalability challenges in long-context generation due to the computational and memory costs of full-context attention. Under practical computation and memory constraints, many inference-efficient long-context methods improve efficiency by adopting bounded-context or segment-level execution only during inference, while continuing to train models under full-context attention, resulting in a mismatch between training and inference execution and st

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是长上下文建模里一个常被忽略但很关键的问题：很多方法在训练时仍用 full-context attention，而在推理时为了省算力改成分段、窗口化或受限上下文执行。这样做虽然推理便宜，但训练和推理的执行语义不一致，模型在训练时学会依赖的信息，在真实推理时并不存在，导致长上下文泛化和稳定性受损。作者要解决的核心问题不是单纯做更便宜的 long-context inference，而是把“受限分段执行”提升为训练和推理共享的建模假设，让模型从一开始就在与部署一致的状态转移规则下学习。
summary.importance: 对基座研究来说，这篇工作的意义在于它把长上下文问题从“注意力算子优化”转回到“训练目标与执行语义是否一致”。这和预训练里很多问题是同构的：比如 teacher forcing 与 test-time rollout 的偏差、full attention 训练配 sparse attention 推理的偏差、训练时可见全局信息而部署时只能看局部状态的偏差。作者给出的框架说明，若把跨段信息流限制到一个受控接口状态，并把更远程的信息访问改成前向只读，那么 TBPTT 不再只是近似梯度，而是在该受限语义下的精确梯度。这一点很重要，因为它把“截断反传会不会伤目标”这个问题重新定义了：如果目标本身就是 inference-consistent 的分段目标，那么截断就是正确训练，而不是权宜近似。对做长上下文预训练、状态压缩、外部记忆、streaming LM 的人，这个视角有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的核心是把序列切成若干不重叠 segment，并把跨 segment 的信息流拆成两条通道。第一条是可微的局部连续性通道 C_i，也就是固定大小的 carried KV tail。它是唯一允许在相邻 segment 间递推的状态接口，训练和推理都按同样方式传递。第二条是前向只读的远程条件通道 R_i，即 retrieved KV prefix，用来提供超出 carried-KV 视野的长程证据，但它不参与状态递推，也不允许梯度穿过历史链条。

在这个设计下，每个 segment 的前向算子在训练和推理时完全相同：当前 segment 的输出由当前 token、上一个 segment 传来的 C_{i-1}，以及远程检索得到的 R_{i-1} 共同决定。关键约束是，只有 C 构成递归状态链，R 只是额外条件。训练时作者使用 TBPTT，但不是对 full-attention 目标做近似，而是把跨段 credit assignment 明确限制到最近 K 次状态转移。由于目标本身就是在这个受限递归上定义的，所以 TBPTT 在这里计算的是 inference-consistent objective 的精确梯度。论文还强调，在实验中 K=1 已经足够且最优，意味着只需要对最近一次状态传递反传即可。

架构实现上，作者采用 head- 和 layer-sparse 的 long-range heads：少数头负责长程检索或远程条件，大多数头负责局部、可携带状态的计算。这样做的动机很清楚：如果所有头都承担长程依赖，状态接口会膨胀，训练和推理的一致性也更难维持；把长程能力限制在稀疏子结构里，更容易控制计算和语义边界。论文的设计取舍也很明确：它不追求保留 full attention 的精确语义，而是主动定义一种受限但一致的执行语义，用一致性换取可扩展性和部署可靠性。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法部分能确认的关键结果有三类。第一，作者在多个 long-context benchmark 和不同上下文长度下验证了该框架在受限执行条件下仍有较强表现，说明训练-推理一致的分段建模并没有因为限制状态传播而明显失效。第二，关于反传长度的消融显示 TBPTT 的 K=1 已经 sufficient and optimal，这个结果很关键，因为它意味着跨段学习所需的可微信号窗口可以非常短，训练成本和实现复杂度都能显著下降。第三，在 128K context prefill 场景下，相比 full attention，内存占用约降低 6×。这说明它不仅是理论上更一致，也确实带来可观的系统收益。

不过，真正需要在正文里核实的实验细节包括：segment 长度如何设定；retrieved KV prefix 的来源与检索策略；长程头占比多少；在 perplexity、needle-in-a-haystack、长文问答、长程复制或多跳检索等不同任务上，和 full-attention train / segmented inference 的 baseline 差距有多大；以及一致性训练是否改善了推理阶段的稳定性而不仅是平均分数。如果这些结果完整，论文的说服力会明显增强。
summary.reading_guide:
先读 Method 开头和 Figure 2，弄清楚 C 和 R 两条通道分别承担什么角色。这里最容易误读的一点是：R 不是 memory state，而是 forward-only conditioning；真正的递归状态只有 carried KV。接着看训练目标的形式化部分，重点确认作者为何说 TBPTT 在这里是 exact gradient，而不是常见意义上的近似。这个论证是全文最有信息量的地方。然后看架构实现，关注 long-range heads 的稀疏设计，因为这决定了方法到底是一个理论框架，还是可落地的 Transformer 变体。最后看 ablation，尤其是 K=1 最优、不同 segment size、是否需要 retrieval prefix、以及不同头/层稀疏度的影响。

如果只想快速判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟足够：看 Introduction、方法总图、目标定义、K 的消融、128K 内存对比表。若准备把这个思路用于预训练或 streaming LM，建议把附录里的实现细节也读完，尤其是状态接口大小、检索前缀构造方式，以及训练吞吐与稳定性数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific but important failure mode in long-context language modeling. Many practical systems train with full-context attention but switch to segmented, windowed, or otherwise bounded execution only at inference time to save memory and compute. That creates a mismatch in both execution semantics and state evolution: the model learns during training to rely on information that will not be available under the constrained inference regime. The paper is not mainly about making inference cheaper in isolation. It is about making segmented execution the shared modeling assumption for both training and inference, so the model is optimized under the same state-transition rules that it will face at deployment.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the key value is the shift in perspective. The paper reframes long-context modeling from an attention-optimization problem into a training-objective consistency problem. This is closely related to several broader issues in pretraining: teacher-forcing versus rollout mismatch, full-attention training with sparse-attention inference, and any setting where training exposes global information that deployment cannot use. The strongest conceptual point is their treatment of TBPTT. If the objective itself is defined under a bounded, inference-consistent segment recurrence, then truncated backpropagation is no longer merely an approximation to a larger full-context objective; it is the exact gradient of the objective the model is actually meant to solve. That is a useful lens for work on streaming LMs, compressed state interfaces, external memory, and long-context pretraining under realistic serving constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method partitions a sequence into non-overlapping segments and decomposes cross-segment information flow into two channels. The first is a differentiable local continuity channel, C_i, implemented as a fixed-size carried KV tail. This is the only recurrent interface state passed from one segment to the next, and it is used identically in training and inference. The second is a forward-only long-range conditioning channel, R_i, implemented as a retrieved KV prefix. It gives access to evidence beyond the carried-KV horizon, but it does not participate in state recursion and gradients do not flow backward through it.

Under this design, each segment uses the same forward operator at training and inference: outputs for the current segment depend on current tokens, the carried state C_{i-1}, and the retrieved prefix R_{i-1}. The crucial constraint is that only C defines the recursive state chain. R is auxiliary conditioning, not part of the recurrent state. Training uses TBPTT, but not as an approximation to full-attention learning. Instead, the objective itself restricts cross-segment credit assignment to the most recent K state transitions. Because the model is explicitly defined under this bounded recursion, TBPTT computes the exact gradient of the inference-consistent objective. The paper further claims that K=1 is sufficient and optimal in practice, which is a strong statement about how short the necessary differentiable horizon can be.

Architecturally, the design is realized with head- and layer-sparse long-range heads. A small subset of heads handles long-range retrieval or conditioning, while most heads support local state-carrying computation. The motivation is straightforward: if all heads are responsible for long-range dependency handling, the recurrent interface becomes too large and the execution semantics become harder to control. By confining long-range access to sparse substructures, the model keeps a clean boundary between local recurrent state and non-recurrent long-range evidence. The trade-off is explicit: the method does not try to preserve exact full-attention semantics. It defines a more restricted but deployment-aligned execution model and optimizes directly for that regime.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, three main empirical claims are clear. First, the framework is validated on multiple long-context benchmarks and context lengths, showing strong performance under constrained execution. That suggests the consistency constraint does not collapse long-range capability even though state propagation is heavily restricted. Second, ablations on the truncation horizon show that TBPTT with K=1 is already sufficient and optimal. This is an important result because it implies that the useful differentiable cross-segment learning signal can be extremely short, which reduces both training cost and implementation complexity. Third, at 128K-context prefill, the method uses about 6× less memory than full attention. So the proposal is not only conceptually cleaner; it also yields substantial systems-level savings.

The details that matter most when reading the full paper are the segment length, how the retrieved KV prefix is constructed, how many heads are allocated to long-range access, and how the method compares against the common baseline of full-attention training with segmented inference. It is also important to check whether the gains show up only in average benchmark scores or also in inference stability under constrained execution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the method overview and the main figure that defines the two channels, C and R. The easiest mistake is to treat R as part of the recurrent memory. It is not. R is forward-only conditioning, while C is the only true recurrent state. Then read the objective formalization carefully. The most informative part of the paper is the argument for why TBPTT is exact in this setting rather than an approximation. After that, inspect the architectural realization with sparse long-range heads, because that determines whether the proposal is mainly a conceptual framework or a practical Transformer variant. Finish with the ablations: K=1, segment size, the necessity of retrieval prefixes, and the effect of head/layer sparsity.

If you only want a quick triage, 30 minutes is enough for the introduction, the method figure, the objective definition, the K ablation, and the 128K memory comparison. If you are considering this for pretraining or streaming LM work, the appendix is likely important, especially the exact interface-state size, retrieval-prefix construction, and throughput or stability details.

recommendation.zh: 看训练语义和 ablation，不必先看长榜单；关键是它是否真的减少 full-attention 训练到分段推理的分布偏移。
recommendation.en: Read the execution semantics and ablations, not the leaderboard first; the key is whether it really reduces full-attention-to-segmented-inference shift.

paper.title: Not All Tokens Need 40 Steps: Heterogeneous Step Allocation in Diffusion Transformers for Efficient Video Generation
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art video generation quality, but they incur immense computational cost because standard inference applies the same number of denoising steps uniformly to every token in the sequence. It is well known that human vision ignores vast amounts of redundant motion. Why, then, do our densest models treat every spatiotemporal token with equal priority? In this paper, we introduce Heterogeneous Step Allocation (HSA), a training-free inference algo

summary.core_problem: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for video generation apply uniform denoising steps to all spatiotemporal tokens, wasting compute on redundant motion that human vision ignores.
summary.importance: Proposes the first training-free heterogeneous step allocation for video DiTs, enabling dynamic compute budgets per token while maintaining global context via KV-cache synchronization.
summary.technical_approach: Heterogeneous Step Allocation (HSA): assigns varying step budgets to spatiotemporal tokens based on velocity dynamics. Resolves sequence-length mismatch via KV-cache synchronization where active tokens attend to full sequence while inactive tokens are skipped. Uses cached Euler update for latent states of skipped tokens.
summary.experiments: Evaluated on video generation benchmarks. Training-free inference method that reduces compute while maintaining generation quality. KV-cache synchronization mechanism preserves global context.
summary.authors_note: Johns Hopkins University. Ernie Chu is a notable researcher in efficient computer vision.

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion Transformers for video generation waste compute by applying uniform denoising steps to all spatiotemporal tokens, even though much video content contains redundant motion.
summary_en.importance: First training-free heterogeneous step allocation approach for video diffusion transformers, enabling dynamic compute allocation per token while preserving global context via KV-cache synchronization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Heterogeneous Step Allocation (HSA) assigns varying denoising step budgets to spatiotemporal tokens based on velocity dynamics. KV-cache synchronization resolves sequence-length mismatches so active tokens attend to the full sequence while inactive tokens are bypassed. Cached Euler update advances latent states of skipped tokens without extra model evaluations.
summary_en.experiments: Training-free inference algorithm evaluated on video generation tasks. Reduces compute while maintaining generation quality through dynamic compute reallocation.
summary_en.authors_note: Johns Hopkins University. Ernie Chu is a recognized researcher in efficient computer vision and model acceleration.

recommendation.zh: 视频DiT的异构步数分配，KV-cache同步机制对LLM推理优化有微弱概念启发，但领域差异大，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Heterogeneous step allocation for video DiTs. The KV-cache synchronization mechanism has weak conceptual relevance for LLM inference optimization, but domain differences are substantial.

paper.title: Training Transformers for KV Cache Compressibility
paper.abstract: Long-context language modeling is increasingly constrained by the Key-Value (KV) cache, whose memory and decode-time access costs scale linearly with the prefix length. This bottleneck has motivated a range of context-compression methods, from token-level summarization to recent optimization-based KV compression methods. These post-hoc methods operate on the KV cache of a fixed pretrained model, so their effectiveness is fundamentally limited by how well the model's internal representations can

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题很直接：KV cache 压缩的上限不只取决于压缩算法，也取决于模型在训练中学出了什么样的内部表示。作者关心的是，能不能通过继续预训练，让 Transformer 自身变得更“可压缩”，从而让后续任何 post-hoc KV compression 方法都更有效。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发在于，它把长上下文推理中的 KV cache 问题从纯推理优化，往训练目标和表示学习上推了一步。很多现有方法默认模型固定，只在推理时做裁剪、摘要或优化式压缩；这篇工作指出，表示是否冗余、是否把关键信息组织成可压缩形式，本身是可训练的。这对 continued pretraining、长上下文适配和 serving-aware pretraining 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先形式化了 KV-compressibility，把它定义为：是否存在一个压缩策略，能把长前缀的 KV cache 映射到更短 cache，同时近似保持 next-token 分布。理论部分说明，同一个 sequence-to-vector function 可以有高度可压缩的 Transformer 实现，也可以有几乎不可压缩的实现，因此可压缩性是 learned representation 的属性，不是输入序列天然决定的。基于这个观点，作者提出 KV-CAT。做法是在 continued pretraining 中引入训练时 KV sparsification：随机或按策略屏蔽一部分 KV 槽位，让模型在信息瓶颈下前向。损失由两部分组成，一部分是 self-distillation，让稀疏 KV 前向去匹配原始 dense 前向的输出分布；另一部分保留标准 next-token prediction，在未屏蔽前向上维持原模型能力。这样训练的目标不是直接替代现有压缩算法，而是让模型学出更适合被这些算法压缩的表示。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen2.5 系列模型，评测三类指标：前缀压缩后的 suffix perplexity、从压缩前缀中做 retrieval 的准确率，以及 LongBench v2 上的压缩长上下文问答。结果显示，经过 KV-CAT 的模型在不同压缩预算、模型规模和后续压缩方法下，都有更好的 quality-budget tradeoff。文中给出的代表性数字包括：suffix perplexity retention 最多提升 3.21 倍，优化式压缩的求解时间最多加速 5 倍，retrieval accuracy 提升最高 68%，LongBench v2 长上下文 QA 提升最高 39%。这些结果说明训练出的表示更规整后，不只是压缩误差更小，连后续优化过程也更容易。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言和问题形式化，抓住作者的核心判断：KV 压缩不是纯后处理问题。然后看理论部分里的构造性例子，尤其是同一计算目标可以有可压缩和不可压缩两种实现，这一段能帮助理解为什么要改训练而不是只改压缩器。实验部分重点看三张结果：perplexity-retention 曲线、retrieval、LongBench v2。若时间有限，30 分钟内读完方法总览、主结果和一页消融就够。若要继续深挖，可以看训练时 sparsification 策略、蒸馏目标细节，以及不同 post-hoc compression 方法在 KV-CAT checkpoint 上的收益差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether KV-cache compressibility should be treated as a property to train for, rather than something to recover only at inference time. Existing KV compression methods operate on a fixed pretrained model, so their ceiling is limited by how compressible that model’s internal representations already are. The core problem is therefore: can we continue training a transformer so that its KV cache becomes easier to compress without sacrificing its standard dense-cache behavior?
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is conceptual. It reframes long-context efficiency from a purely inference-side problem into a representation-learning problem. That matters because many current approaches assume the model is fixed and only optimize the compressor. This paper argues that the model itself can be made more compression-friendly through continued pretraining. For foundation-model work, that is relevant to long-context adaptation, serving-aware pretraining, and the broader idea that deployment constraints should feed back into training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first formalizes KV-compressibility as the existence of a compression policy that maps a long KV cache to a shorter one while preserving the next-token distribution up to small error. The theoretical section shows that compressibility is not determined by the task or the input sequence alone: nearly any sequence-to-vector function can be implemented by transformers whose caches are either highly compressible or fundamentally hard to compress. This motivates making compressibility an explicit training target.

The proposed method, KV-CAT, is a continued pretraining procedure. During training, the model is exposed to a KV sparsification policy that masks out a constant fraction of KV slots, creating an information bottleneck. The objective combines two losses: a self-distillation loss that makes the masked model match the dense model’s output distribution, and a standard next-token prediction loss on the unmasked forward pass to preserve the original model’s dense-cache quality. The goal is not to replace post-hoc compression algorithms, but to reshape the learned representations so that those algorithms work better afterward.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Qwen2.5 models and evaluate three settings: suffix perplexity under compressed prefixes, retrieval accuracy from compressed prefixes, and compressed long-context QA on LongBench v2. The main result is consistent improvement in the quality–budget tradeoff across compression budgets, model sizes, and downstream compression methods. The paper reports up to 3.21× better suffix perplexity retention, up to 5× faster optimization time for compression, up to 68% higher retrieval accuracy, and up to 39% gains on long-context QA. The optimization-time result is especially interesting because it suggests that better-trained representations are not only more compressible in principle, but also easier for optimization-based compressors to fit in practice.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, read the introduction, the formal problem setup, and the main experimental figures. The key idea to retain is that KV compressibility is a learned property of the representation, not just a property of the context. If you have a bit more time, look at the theoretical constructions showing that the same computation can admit both compressible and non-compressible transformer implementations. Then read the KV-CAT training recipe and the main result tables on perplexity retention, retrieval, and LongBench v2. A 25–30 minute pass is enough to capture the main idea and empirical takeaway.

recommendation.zh: 只看第3节理论证明和第4节正则设计，可参考在长上下文预训练中加入类似约束降低推理成本
recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 for theoretical proof and Section 4 for regularization design, referenceable for adding similar constraints in long-context pretraining to reduce inference cost

paper.title: VideoRouter: Query-Adaptive Dual Routing for Efficient Long-Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video large multimodal models increasingly face a scalability bottleneck: long videos produce excessively long visual-token sequences, which sharply increase memory and latency during inference. While existing compression methods are effective in specific settings, most are either weakly query-aware or apply a fixed compression policy across frames, proving suboptimal when visual evidence is unevenly distributed over time. To address this, we present VideoRouter, a query-adaptive dual-router fra

summary.core_problem: 长视频VLM的视觉token序列过长，导致推理内存和延迟大幅上升，现有压缩方法query感知弱或策略固定，在视觉证据时间分布不均时效果差
summary.importance: 工程创新，提出查询自适应的双路由框架，在保证精度的前提下优化长视频推理效率
summary.technical_approach: 基于InternVL构建双路由架构：语义路由选择时间覆盖策略，在全局覆盖和高分辨率保留之间切换；图像路由利用LLM早期层打分帧相关性，压缩无关帧保留关键帧细节；构建两个专用数据集用于路由训练
summary.experiments: 基于InternVL实现，相比基线方法在精度下降可接受的范围内降低了推理资源消耗，具体数值未在摘要中完整披露

summary_en.core_problem: Long-video VLMs face scalability bottleneck from overlong visual token sequences, which sharply increase inference memory and latency; existing compression methods are weakly query-aware or use fixed policies
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation, proposes a query-adaptive dual routing framework to optimize long-video inference efficiency while preserving accuracy
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on InternVL: Semantic Router selects allocation policy between broad temporal coverage and high-resolution preservation; Image Router scores frame relevance with early LLM layers to compress irrelevant frames; two custom datasets are built for router training
summary_en.experiments: Implemented on InternVL, reduces inference resource cost with acceptable accuracy drop compared to baselines, full quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 长视频VLM推理优化的增量工作，仅关注推理效率的研究员可扫方法部分，预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental long-video VLM inference optimization, only for efficiency-focused researchers, no deep read for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Cascade Token Selection for Transformer Attention Acceleration
paper.abstract: A method is presented for reducing the cost of representative token selection in transformer attention layers by exploiting the coherence of the representative set across depth. Activation Decorrelation Attention (ADA) selects $r \ll T$ representative tokens at each layer via a Gram threshold and computes attention on the compressed $r \times r$ problem, but the selection requires a $T \times T$ Gram matrix at every layer. The cascade mechanism introduced here inherits the representative set fro

summary.core_problem: 解决Activation Decorrelation Attention中每层选代表性token需要计算O(T²d)的Gram矩阵，计算成本过高的问题。
summary.importance: 方法改进，有效降低注意力token选择的计算复杂度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出级联机制，继承上一层的代表性token集合，通过(T-r)×r的交叉Gram计算验证，仅做少量增删更新集合，将每层选择成本从O(T²d)降至O(T r d)。
summary.experiments: 在GPT-2 124M、GPT-J 6B、OPT 6.7B上测试，Gram操作开销降低22%到63%，连续层代表性token集Jaccard重叠度0.83到0.94。
summary.authors_note: 作者所属机构未明确披露，无公开知名作者记录。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the high computation cost of O(T²d) Gram matrix calculation per layer for representative token selection in Activation Decorrelation Attention.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement, effectively reduces computation complexity of attention token selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes cascade mechanism, inherits representative token set from previous layer, validates via (T-r)×r cross-Gram calculation, updates the set with minimal additions and deletions, reduces per-layer selection cost from O(T²d) to O(T r d).
summary_en.experiments: Validated on GPT-2 124M, GPT-J 6B, OPT 6.7B, achieves 22% to 63% reduction in Gram operation cost, Jaccard overlap of representative token sets between consecutive layers is 0.83 to 0.94.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliation is not explicitly disclosed, no publicly known prominent researchers.

recommendation.zh: 注意力加速的增量改进，作为推理优化相关文献备查即可，无需细读。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in attention acceleration, only for inference optimization literature reference, no in-depth reading needed.

paper.title: LEAP: Layer-wise Exit-Aware Pretraining for Efficient Transformer Inference
paper.abstract: Layer-aligned distillation and convergence-based early exit represent two predominant computational efficiency paradigms for transformer inference; yet we establish that they exhibit systematic incompatibility under standard deployment conditions for convergence-based early exit. Distillation objectives that align intermediate student layers to teacher representations suppress the representational convergence that early-exit mechanisms exploit, rendering such mechanisms ineffective on distilled

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个部署层面很常见、但训练目标里很少被正面讨论的冲突：层对齐蒸馏得到的小模型，往往无法再配合基于表示收敛的 early exit 使用。原因不在阈值没调好，也不在退出策略太粗糙，而在于标准 layer-wise distillation 会要求学生每一层都去拟合教师对应层，从而把表征能力均匀摊在整个深度上。这样一来，相邻层之间不会自然出现“后几层变化越来越小”的收敛结构，early exit 依赖的可提前终止条件就失效了。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在不改模型结构、不增加推理参数的前提下，让蒸馏模型既保留蒸馏收益，又重新具备可用的中间退出点。
summary.importance: 对预训练/压缩研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它指出了一个常被默认可组合、实际却互相牵制的训练—部署接口问题：蒸馏目标会塑造层间表征几何，而这种几何直接决定 early exit 是否成立。这一点对做小模型预训练、蒸馏、mid-training 目标设计的人都有参考价值。第二，它给出的修正方式很轻：不是引入额外退出头，也不是改 backbone，而是在训练目标里显式鼓励中间层靠近最终表征。这个思路说明，很多推理效率问题未必需要推理时加机制，也可以在预训练/蒸馏阶段把“可退出性”作为一种表征约束提前写进目标函数。贡献量级不算范式级，但问题定义清楚，机制解释到位，属于对训练目标设计有实际启发的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 LEAP 的辅助目标。作者先把冲突讲清楚：标准蒸馏里，学生第 l 层对齐教师第 π(l) 层，常见于 MiniLM、TinyBERT 一类 layer-aligned KD。这样的目标会让每层都承担独立功能，导致 contraction ratio 近似 1，也就是层间变换幅度没有随深度单调减小。early exit 需要的恰恰相反，是后层逐步收敛到稳定表示。

LEAP 的做法不是放弃蒸馏，而是在原有 final/output matching 与 intermediate matching 之外，再加一个 exit-aware loss，让每个中间层都被训练成“潜在可退出点”。具体有两个对齐目标：一是中间层表示接近教师最终层表示，二是中间层表示接近学生自身最终层表示，其中后者用 stop-gradient 保持训练稳定，避免所有层一起塌缩到一个不断漂移的目标。损失形式采用带 soft margin 的 sigmoid 约束，并设置训练阈值 τ=0.98，要求中间层与最终层的余弦相似度足够高。总的 exit loss 为教师终层对齐项加上 0.7 倍的学生终层自对齐项，平衡质量与推理时自一致性。

此外，作者还加入 batch 内相似度结构蒸馏，即 contrastive KL，让学生保留教师 embedding space 的相对几何。和传统 attention/hidden-state KD 相比，这里更偏向 sentence embedding 场景下的表示蒸馏。

推理阶段没有额外模块，只用 k-skip patience early exit。默认 k=1，从第 l_min=6 层开始，若当前层与前 k 层的 mean-pooled 表示余弦相似度超过 θ=0.95 就退出。训练阈值比推理阈值更严格，给部署留出余量。这种设计的关键点在于：不是靠训练一个 exit classifier 来预测“能不能退”，而是直接把中间层训练成接近最终层，因此退出判据可以保持参数无关、结构无关。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是追求绝对任务精度，而是验证“蒸馏 + early exit 为何失效，以及 LEAP 如何恢复可退出性”。作者在句向量、语义相似度和检索任务上做了评测，并给了 GPU latency 的 wall-clock benchmark，而不只报理论层数减少。

最关键结果是：标准 layer-aligned distillation 在部署 early exit 时，虽然中间层偶尔会满足某些表面条件，但实际几乎没有有效层数削减，甚至因为逐层监控开销导致吞吐下降；LEAP 则实现了 1.80× 的平均层数减少，并带来 1.61× 的实际 wall-clock 加速。这个差距说明，是否能退不是看有没有退出逻辑，而是看训练后表征是否真的形成收敛结构。

论文还给出若干机制性分析。其一，标准蒸馏模型的层间 contraction ratio 基本不下降，说明表示没有向终层收敛；LEAP 会显著改善这一趋势。其二，去掉 L_exit 后，模型重新失去 early-exit 能力，说明恢复可退出性的关键不是 final matching 或 contrastive distillation，而正是 exit-aware 约束。其三，作者讨论了不同阈值、patience 设置和 batch size 下的延迟表现，强调 early exit 的收益必须用真实延迟衡量，因为逐样本退出会受 kernel launch、分支不规则性和小 batch 开销影响。

从给出的内容看，实验规模更像 sentence embedding 蒸馏与部署验证，而不是大规模生成式 LLM 预训练。参数量和数据规模在正文片段里没有完整展开，但方法定位很明确：面向 BERT/encoder 类蒸馏模型的高效推理，而不是 decoder-only LLM。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言和 Figure 1，抓住论文真正的观察：蒸馏目标会破坏 early exit 依赖的层间收敛。然后看方法部分里 contraction ratio 的定义，以及 L_final、L_inter、L_exit 三者的分工。这里最值得注意的是为什么要同时对齐教师最终层和学生最终层，以及为什么学生终层项要 stop-gradient。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：一类是层间表示变化/收敛曲线，用来验证冲突是否真实存在；一类是 latency vs. layer reduction，确认理论省层数有没有转成真实加速；一类是 ablation，特别是去掉 L_exit、只保留普通蒸馏时的结果。若只打算快速判断是否值得跟进，读完问题定义、主损失公式和主表，大约 20–30 分钟就够。若关心把类似思想迁移到 decoder-only 模型，可进一步深挖作者对“表征收敛”与“功能分层”关系的讨论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical incompatibility between two efficiency techniques that are often assumed to compose: layer-wise distillation and convergence-based early exit. In standard layer-aligned distillation, each student layer is trained to match a corresponding teacher layer. This spreads useful computation across the full depth of the student and suppresses the progressive representational convergence that early-exit methods rely on. As a result, distilled models may satisfy superficial exit checks but still fail to reduce effective depth or latency in deployment. The core problem is how to train a distilled transformer so that it remains compact and accurate while also exposing genuinely usable intermediate exit points, without changing the architecture or adding inference-time parameters.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not a new backbone, but a clean training-objective diagnosis. It shows that deployment behavior can be determined by the geometry induced during distillation: if the objective enforces per-layer specialization, convergence-based early exit becomes structurally unlikely. That is a useful lesson for pretraining and compression work more broadly. Efficiency mechanisms are not always modular; some combinations fail because their optimization targets encode conflicting assumptions about layer dynamics. LEAP also suggests a lightweight remedy: instead of adding exit heads or runtime controllers, one can bake “exitability” into training by shaping intermediate representations toward the final one. The contribution is moderate in scope, but the mechanism is concrete and operationally relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method adds an auxiliary exit-aware objective on top of standard distillation. The paper first formalizes why the conflict arises. In layer-aligned KD, student layer l matches teacher layer pi(l), as in MiniLM or TinyBERT-style setups. This encourages each layer to carry distinct teacher-aligned information, which keeps the contraction ratio near 1 across depth. Early exit, however, needs later layers to make progressively smaller updates so that representations stabilize before the final layer.

LEAP keeps standard final-layer matching and intermediate-layer matching, but introduces an additional loss that turns every intermediate layer into a potential exit point. Each intermediate student representation is encouraged to be close to two targets: the teacher’s final-layer embedding and the student’s own final-layer embedding. The second target uses stop-gradient to avoid instability from chasing a moving target. The loss is implemented as a soft-margin sigmoid constraint with a training threshold tau = 0.98, pushing cosine similarity high enough that intermediate layers become valid approximations of the final representation.

The total exit loss combines the teacher-final alignment term and a 0.7-weighted student-final self-consistency term. This is an important design choice: the teacher term preserves quality, while the student term makes the model internally consistent with the representation actually available at inference time. The method also includes a contrastive KL term over batch-wise similarity matrices so that the student preserves the teacher’s embedding-space geometry.

At inference, LEAP uses a parameter-free k-skip patience early-exit rule. Starting from l_min = 6, the model exits when the cosine similarity between the current mean-pooled representation and that from k layers earlier exceeds theta = 0.95. The training threshold is stricter than the inference threshold, leaving some deployment margin. A notable aspect is that the method does not train an explicit exit classifier; it directly shapes intermediate representations so that a simple convergence test becomes meaningful.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed to validate the incompatibility claim and the recovery effect of LEAP, rather than to maximize absolute task scores. Evaluation is done on sentence embedding, semantic similarity, and retrieval settings, with GPU wall-clock latency benchmarks in addition to theoretical layer reduction.

The headline result is that standard layer-aligned distillation provides essentially no effective layer reduction under convergence-based early exit, and can even hurt throughput because per-layer monitoring adds overhead without enough actual exits. LEAP, in contrast, achieves 1.80x layer reduction and 1.61x wall-clock speedup. That gap is the central empirical point of the paper: early exit fails not because the runtime rule is weak, but because the distilled representation trajectory never becomes contractive.

The analysis also includes several useful ablations. Standard distilled models show contraction ratios that stay roughly flat across layers, indicating little representational stabilization. LEAP changes this trend and creates usable convergence regions. Removing the exit-aware loss eliminates the early-exit benefit, showing that final-output matching and similarity-structure distillation alone are insufficient. The paper also discusses threshold choices, patience settings, and latency behavior across batch sizes, which matters because sample-wise early exit can lose some of its theoretical savings due to branching and kernel overhead.

From the available content, this is clearly positioned as an encoder-side embedding/distillation study rather than a large-scale decoder-only LM pretraining paper. The exact parameter and data scales are not fully visible in the provided text, but the experimental story is coherent and deployment-oriented.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the main motivating figure. The key idea to verify is simple: layer-wise distillation destroys the convergence pattern that early exit needs. Then read the methodology around the contraction ratio and the roles of L_final, L_inter, and L_exit. The most important detail is why LEAP aligns intermediate layers to both the teacher final layer and the student final layer, and why the latter uses stop-gradient.

In the experiments, focus on three things: representation-convergence plots, latency-versus-layer-reduction results, and the ablation removing L_exit. Those are the pieces that establish the paper’s main claim. For a quick pass, the introduction, core loss definitions, and main tables should take around 20–30 minutes. If you are interested in adapting the idea to decoder-only models, the deeper question worth probing is how training objectives shape functional layering and representational redundancy across depth.

recommendation.zh: 只看 incompatibility 论证和 LEAP 约束；这是部署训练目标的干净负交互案例，不是基座预训练方向。
recommendation.en: Skim the incompatibility argument and the LEAP constraint; it is a clean efficiency-training interaction, not a foundation pretraining result.

paper.title: Carbon-Taxed Transformers: A Green Compression Pipeline for Overgrown Language Models
paper.abstract: The accelerating adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in software engineering (SE) has brought with it a silent crisis: unsustainable computational cost. While these models demonstrate remarkable capabilities in different SE tasks, they are unmanageably large, slow to deploy, memory-intensive, and carbon-heavy. This reality threatens not only the scalability and accessibility of AI-powered SE, but also its long-term environmental sustainability. The research challenge is clear: we must go be

summary.core_problem: 针对软件工程场景中 LLM 部署成本、内存占用、延迟和碳排放过高的问题，提出一个压缩流程选择与排序框架。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程压缩 pipeline，而不是新的预训练或模型架构；它把环境成本显式纳入模型压缩目标，对 serving 成本讨论有参考意义，但摘要中的“carbon tax”更像调度准则和评估口径，不一定带来新的压缩机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Carbon-Taxed Transformers，将经济学中的 carbon pricing 类比为计算碳税，对架构低效进行惩罚、对可部署压缩进行奖励；方法看起来是多架构压缩流程排序与选择，可能组合剪枝、量化、蒸馏或模型裁剪等常见手段，但摘要未展示完整算法细节。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个软件工程任务上评估 CTT，但给出的摘要被截断，未能确认具体任务、模型规模、压缩率、延迟/显存/能耗测量方式和精度损失。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Saskatchewan，研究背景偏软件工程和软件开发协作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the high deployment cost, memory footprint, latency, and carbon impact of LLMs used in software-engineering tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering compression pipeline rather than a new pretraining method or model architecture. Explicitly including environmental cost in compression objectives is useful for serving discussions, but the carbon-tax framing appears to be a selection and evaluation principle rather than a new compression primitive.
summary_en.technical_approach: Carbon-Taxed Transformers applies an analogy to carbon pricing: architectural inefficiencies are penalized and deployment-ready compression is rewarded. The method appears to organize and order multi-architecture compression steps, likely involving standard compression tools, though the provided abstract does not expose the full algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims evaluation across multiple software-engineering tasks, but the provided abstract is truncated and does not reveal the exact tasks, model sizes, compression ratios, latency or energy measurements, or accuracy trade-offs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Saskatchewan, with a software-engineering and collaborative software-development focus.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验表里精度-延迟-能耗的 Pareto 曲线；若没有真实功耗测量，carbon tax 只是包装。
recommendation.en: Only inspect the accuracy-latency-energy Pareto tables; without real power measurements, the carbon-tax framing is mostly packaging.

institutions: AJMAIN INQIAD ALAM, University of Saskatchewan
CHANCHAL K. ROY, University of Saskatchewan
KEVIN A. SCHNEIDER, University of Saskatchewan

paper.title: Coverage-Based Calibration for Post-Training Quantization via Weighted Set Cover over Outlier Channels
paper.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models to low bit-widths using a small calibration set, and its quality depends strongly on which samples are chosen. We identify a failure mode in which calibration samples fail to activate outlier channels, hidden dimensions with unusually large activations, causing the quantizer to underestimate their dynamic range and producing per-channel reconstruction errors that dominate layer-wise loss. Motivated by this observation, we argue th

summary.core_problem: 现有后训练量化（PTQ）的随机采样校准样本经常无法激活激活值异常大的异常值通道，导致量化器低估这些通道的动态范围，产生主导层损失的重构误差。
summary.importance: 为PTQ校准样本选择提供了新视角，不再依赖通用样本分布代表性，转而关注异常值通道覆盖，可大幅降低校准样本用量，降低量化部署成本，方法后端无关、 overhead 极低，对预训练模型落地有实际应用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将校准样本选择形式化为异常值通道上的加权集合覆盖问题，每个通道按其对量化误差的贡献加权，目标函数为单调次模，使用贪心算法COVERCAL选样本，基于预计算的激活掩码运行，选样过程不需要GPU资源，自带(1-1/e)的近似最优保证。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA-3-8B上使用AWQ做INT4量化的场景下，64个COVERCAL选择的校准样本就能达到随机采样256个样本的效果，测试覆盖3个模型家族、2种PTQ后端、4种校准预算、5个下游基准，性能提升直接对应异常值通道覆盖度的提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章的问题建模、第4章的COVERCAL算法实现、第6章的实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Randomly sampled calibration sets used in existing post-training quantization (PTQ) often fail to activate outlier channels (hidden dimensions with abnormally large activations), leading quantizers to underestimate the dynamic range of these channels and produce reconstruction errors that dominate layer-wise loss.
summary_en.importance: Provides a new perspective for PTQ calibration sample selection, shifting focus from general sample distribution representativeness to outlier channel coverage, reduces required calibration sample count and quantization deployment cost. The proposed method is backend-agnostic with negligible overhead, and has practical value for pre-trained model deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates calibration sample selection as a weighted set cover problem over outlier channels, where each channel is weighted by its contribution to quantization error. The objective is monotone submodular, so a greedy algorithm named COVERCAL is used for sample selection. It runs on precomputed activation masks, no GPU resource is needed during sample selection, with a (1-1/e) approximation guarantee.
summary_en.experiments: On LLaMA-3-8B with AWQ INT4 quantization, 64 calibration samples selected by COVERCAL achieve the same performance as 256 randomly sampled calibration samples. Tests are conducted across 3 model families, 2 PTQ backends, 4 calibration budgets, 5 downstream benchmarks, performance improvements directly correlate with increased outlier channel coverage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for problem formulation, Section 4 for COVERCAL algorithm implementation, Section 6 for experimental results. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看方法和 outlier-channel 消融；把 PTQ 校准从代表性采样改成覆盖问题，适合做内部量化复现实验。
recommendation.en: Read the method and outlier-channel ablations; reframing PTQ calibration as coverage rather than representativeness is worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: LayerBoost: Layer-Aware Attention Reduction for Efficient LLMs
paper.abstract: Transformers are mostly relying on softmax attention, which introduces quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length and remains a major bottleneck for efficient inference. Prior work on linear or hybrid attention typically replaces softmax attention uniformly across all layers, often leading to significant performance degradation or requiring extensive retraining to recover model quality.   This work proposes LayerBoost, a layer-aware attention reduction method that selectively modifies

summary.core_problem: 在尽量少重训的前提下，如何按层选择性削减 Transformer 的注意力计算，以降低长序列推理成本而不过度伤害性能。
summary.importance: 这是典型的推理效率工作，不直接推进预训练方法论。价值在于它强调不同层对注意力机制的依赖并不相同，因而“全层统一替换 softmax attention”往往不是好策略。对基座研究员而言，更多是部署侧和架构敏感性分析的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 LayerBoost，先对预训练模型做层敏感性分析，再按层采用三种不同策略：高敏感层保留标准 softmax attention，中敏感层替换为线性滑窗注意力，低敏感层直接移除注意力。核心思想是把 attention reduction 做成 layer-aware 的结构改写，而不是全局统一替换。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和 baseline 名称，只说明与统一替换线性/混合注意力的方案相比，LayerBoost 试图在较少重训下保留性能。由于缺少定量结果和 clean setup 细节，目前更适合作为方法备查，而不是高优先级阅读对象。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to selectively reduce Transformer attention computation layer by layer, with minimal retraining, to lower long-sequence inference cost without excessive quality loss.
summary_en.importance: This is a standard inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining-methods contribution. Its main value is the reminder that layers differ in how much they rely on attention, so uniformly replacing softmax attention across all layers is often a poor design choice. For foundation-model researchers, it is mostly a deployment-side and architecture-sensitivity reference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose LayerBoost: first run a sensitivity analysis on a pretrained model, then apply one of three strategies per layer—keep standard softmax attention for highly sensitive layers, replace it with linear sliding-window attention for moderately sensitive layers, and remove attention entirely for low-sensitivity layers. The key idea is a layer-aware structural rewrite instead of a uniform global replacement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or named baselines. It only states that LayerBoost aims to preserve quality better than uniform linear or hybrid attention replacements while requiring less retraining. Given the lack of quantitative detail and clean setup information in the abstract, this is better treated as a reference method than a high-priority read.

recommendation.zh: 典型增量效率文；若你关心 attention 替换，只看层敏感性分析即可，方法本身不太会改变你对预训练或架构的 prior。
recommendation.en: A fairly incremental efficiency paper; if you care about attention replacement, read only the layer-sensitivity analysis—the method itself is unlikely to change your pretraining or architecture priors.

paper.title: Does Visual Token Pruning Improve Calibration? An Empirical Study on Confidence in MLLMs

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态LLM中视觉token剪枝（推理加速）对模型校准/置信度可靠性的影响，而不仅是准确率。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率策略的可靠性评测与经验规律总结；对部署与评估体系有价值，但对预训练方法论影响间接。
summary.technical_approach: 在不同token预算下，对多种剪枝策略（SCOPE不同saliency权重、saliency-only、FastV、random）进行系统对比，使用ECE、Brier、AURC等校准指标分析“效率-可靠性-准确率”关系，并做内部alpha sweep研究saliency权重对校准的影响。
summary.experiments: 基于LLaVA-1.5-7B，在POPE与ScienceQA-IMG上评测；发现剪枝并非简单牺牲可靠性换效率：在POPE上SCOPE的pure-coverage设置可显著降低ECE且准确率接近不剪枝；alpha-sweep显示降低saliency权重在各token预算下持续改善校准，准确率变化较小（摘要未给出完整数值表）。

summary_en.core_problem: Study how visual token pruning (for efficient inference) affects calibration/reliability in multimodal LLMs beyond task accuracy.
summary_en.importance: An empirical reliability evaluation of inference-efficiency techniques; useful for deployment and evaluation methodology, with indirect relevance to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematically compare pruning strategies (SCOPE with varying saliency weights, saliency-only, FastV, random) across token budgets using calibration metrics (ECE, Brier score, AURC), including an alpha sweep to analyze the effect of saliency weighting.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate LLaVA-1.5-7B on POPE and ScienceQA-IMG; pruning is not a simple reliability-efficiency tradeoff: on POPE, SCOPE pure-coverage yields substantially lower ECE with similar accuracy; lowering saliency weight consistently improves calibration across budgets with minor accuracy changes (full numbers not in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 告诉你剪视觉token可能把校准搞坏/搞好但不提供可泛化机制，更多是评测提醒；扫一眼结论图和分任务分解即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly an evaluation warning that pruning can shift calibration in non-obvious ways without a unifying mechanism; glance at the headline plots and per-task breakdown.

paper.title: OFA-Diffusion Compression: Compressing Diffusion Model in One-Shot Manner

summary.core_problem: 如何在一次训练中得到可适配不同算力/延迟约束的扩散模型压缩子网，避免为不同设备重复做多轮压缩训练。
summary.importance: 属于扩散生成模型的部署效率方向：将Once-for-All思想引入扩散模型压缩，降低多目标部署的训练与工程成本；对LLM基座预训练本身启发有限，但对“单次训练、多档推理配置”的通用效率范式有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OFA-Diffusion Compression：通过一次性训练覆盖多个计算/参数规模的子网络；为避免候选子网空间过大导致优化变慢，限制子网参数规模集合（离散档位）以缩小搜索/训练空间，并在统一框架下导出不同计算预算的子模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、指标与对比方法的完整细节；仅能确认其目标是扩散图像生成模型的压缩与多档位子网导出，效果与开销对比需以论文正文为准。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain diffusion-model subnetworks for multiple device constraints via one-shot training, avoiding repeated compression runs per deployment target.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an efficiency/deployment contribution for diffusion generative models: adapts the once-for-all paradigm to diffusion compression to reduce training/engineering overhead across multiple inference budgets. Limited direct relevance to LLM pretraining, but the “train once, serve many” efficiency pattern may transfer conceptually.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes OFA-Diffusion Compression: one-shot training over a family of subnetworks with different compute/parameter budgets; to mitigate the huge candidate space typical in OFA, it restricts the subnetwork sizes to a discrete set of parameter budgets to speed up optimization and selection.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, metrics, or full baselines; details of quality-vs-cost tradeoffs and comparisons must be checked in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: OFA 思路搬到扩散压缩但更像工程拼装，结论对预训练 prior 影响弱；只当“一训多档”部署范式备查，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Mostly an engineering port of Once-for-All to diffusion compression; weak impact on pretraining priors—keep as a reference for “train once, serve many configs,” no deep read.

paper.title: How Should Video LLMs Output Time? An Analysis of Efficient Temporal Grounding Paradigms

summary.core_problem: 视频时序定位（VTG）中，Video LLM/MLLM 需要输出时间边界，但现有方法的“时间输出范式”与骨干网络、数据、训练协议强耦合，导致无法判断性能差异究竟来自输出设计还是其他因素；同时面向边缘/端侧部署时，不同输出范式在参数开销、训练稳定性、推理确定性与算力成本上的系统级权衡缺乏受控分析。
summary.importance: VTG 是 moment retrieval、dense captioning、highlight detection、grounded video QA 等任务的核心能力。随着模型走向小型化与端侧部署，“如何输出时间”会放大为工程与算法的共同瓶颈：同等骨干下，输出范式可能显著影响收敛、延迟、可复现性与最终精度。该论文的价值在于做受控对比，把输出范式从“系统整体差异”中剥离出来，给出可操作的选型依据。
summary.technical_approach:
论文在统一框架下对三类主流 VTG 输出范式做 controlled study，保证除输出设计外其余变量一致（同一紧凑 VLM 骨干、相同数据源三元组、相同优化器/epoch/LoRA 微调协议等），从而隔离“输出范式”这一自变量。
三类范式：
1) Text Numeral Generation（文本数字生成）：直接在语言输出中生成起止时间的数字字符串（chat 式输出）。优点是实现简单、无额外词表/头；风险是数字生成误差、格式不稳定、对解码敏感。
2) Temporal Token Generation（时间 token 生成）：引入专门的时间/事件结构 token，把时间边界作为结构化序列的一部分自回归生成（文中以 TRACE 风格的 causal event modeling 实例化，事件可包含 (t, saliency, caption) 等字段）。优点是结构显式、可扩展元数据；代价是序列更长、解码更复杂。
3) Continuous Temporal Decoding（连续时间解码）：从隐藏状态映射到连续时间目标；文中重点比较分布式/概率化解码（如 DisTime 风格：对时间 bin 输出分布以表达边界不确定性），并说明纯回归头可视为其退化情形。
评估维度不仅是定位精度，还包括：参数额外开销、训练稳定性/收敛、推理确定性（determinism）、计算成本等面向部署的指标。
summary.experiments:
受控实验设置：在多种紧凑骨干上实现三范式并统一微调配置（SmolVLM2 0.5B/2.2B、FastVLM 1.5B、Molmo2 4B/8B），使用一致的数据与训练协议，仅改变输出格式与对应目标函数。
对比报告覆盖：
- 精度：不同范式在相同骨干下的 VTG 定位效果差异；
- 规模效应：从 0.5B 到 8B 时范式差异是否缩小/放大；
- 工程属性：参数/词表/头的额外开销，训练是否更易发散，推理输出是否更确定（尤其生成式/数字式对解码策略敏感），以及计算成本。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含结果表数值；精读时应以 Table 1、Figure 1 及实验章节的主表/效率分析表为准。）
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + 重点章节/图表/创新点）
- 精读 Introduction：明确论文要解决的是“输出范式的因果影响隔离”与“端侧效率权衡”。
- 必看 Figure 1 + Table 1：Figure 1 总结三范式差异；Table 1 说明以往工作为何不可比（骨干/数据/协议不一致），也是本文受控设计的动机证据。
- 精读 Paradigm Formulation：把三范式统一到同一数学符号体系（h→t*），理解每种范式的训练目标与解码路径；尤其关注 TRACE 风格结构化事件生成与 DisTime 风格分布解码的具体实现细节（tokenization/binning/损失）。
- 精读实验的“效率维度”小节：关注参数开销、训练稳定性、推理确定性与计算成本的度量方式（例如是否固定解码策略、是否统计方差/失败率）。
- 精读跨骨干对比：看 0.5B/1.5B/2.2B/4B/8B 下结论是否一致，从而指导真实部署选型。
skim（泛读建议：方法概述 + 推荐看哪些部分）
- 只看 Introduction + Figure 1：快速建立三范式概念。
- 快速扫 Paradigm Formulation 每个范式的“输出长什么样”。
- 直接跳到实验主表与效率分析结论段：获取“哪种范式在小模型上更划算”的经验结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调“输出空间设计”本身就是 VTG-MLLM 的关键变量：它影响学习难度、解码稳定性与系统成本。论文通过严格控制骨干/数据/训练协议，把讨论从‘某某系统更强’转为‘在同等条件下哪种时间输出更优’，并把端侧部署关心的效率指标纳入同等重要的评价维度。

summary_en.core_problem: In Video Temporal Grounding (VTG), Video LLMs must output temporal boundaries, but existing approaches entangle the temporal output paradigm with different backbones, datasets, and training protocols—making it impossible to attribute performance differences to the output design itself. As VTG moves toward compact, edge-deployable models, the system-level trade-offs (parameter overhead, training stability, inference determinism, compute cost) across output paradigms need a controlled, apples-to-apples analysis.
summary_en.importance: VTG underpins moment retrieval, dense video captioning, highlight detection, and grounded video QA. For compact/edge deployment, the temporal output formulation can materially affect convergence, latency, reproducibility, and accuracy. This paper’s value is a controlled comparison that isolates output design as the sole variable and provides practical guidance on accuracy–efficiency trade-offs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper implements and compares three dominant VTG output paradigms under a unified fine-tuning framework, holding constant the compact VLM backbone, data triples, optimizer, epochs, and LoRA protocol—so the only changing factor is the output formulation and its objective.
Paradigms:
1) Text Numeral Generation: generate start/end timestamps as plain-text numerals in the language output. Simple but prone to formatting/numeral errors and decoding sensitivity.
2) Temporal Token Generation: introduce dedicated temporal/event tokens and autoregressively decode structured event sequences (TRACE-style causal event modeling), where an event may include (time, saliency, caption) fields. More structured/extendable but longer sequences and more complex decoding.
3) Continuous Temporal Decoding: map hidden states to continuous temporal targets; the study focuses on distribution-based decoding (DisTime-style) that outputs a probability distribution over time bins to model boundary ambiguity (with pure regression viewed as a degenerate case).
Evaluation goes beyond localization accuracy to include parameter overhead, training stability, inference determinism, and computational cost.
summary_en.experiments:
Controlled experiments are run across multiple compact backbones (SmolVLM2 0.5B/2.2B, FastVLM 1.5B, Molmo2 4B/8B) with identical fine-tuning settings and the same underlying data, varying only the output paradigm.
Reported analyses cover: accuracy differences under identical backbones, scaling effects from 0.5B to 8B, and deployment-relevant properties such as extra parameters/vocabulary/heads, convergence stability, inference determinism (especially for generative/numeral outputs), and compute cost.
(Note: the provided excerpt does not include numeric result tables; consult Figure 1, Table 1, and the main/efficiency tables in the experiments section for exact findings.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical + how to read)
- Introduction: focus on the causal isolation goal and the edge-efficiency motivation.
- Figure 1 + Table 1: Figure 1 summarizes the three paradigms; Table 1 motivates why prior comparisons are confounded.
- Paradigm Formulation: understand the unified notation (h→t*) and the concrete instantiations (TRACE-style structured generation; DisTime-style distributional decoding), including tokenization/binning and losses.
- Efficiency analysis section: pay attention to how overhead, stability, determinism, and compute are measured (fixed decoding settings, variance/failure rates, etc.).
- Cross-backbone results: verify whether conclusions hold consistently from 0.5B to 8B for real deployment decisions.
skim (high-level + what to look at)
- Read Introduction + Figure 1 to grasp the three output options.
- Skim each paradigm’s “what the output looks like”.
- Jump to the main results and efficiency takeaways to learn which paradigm offers the best accuracy–efficiency trade-off for compact models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that the temporal output space is a first-class design choice for VTG-MLLMs, affecting learnability, decoding stability, and system cost. By strictly controlling backbone/data/training, they shift the discussion from ‘which system is better’ to ‘which output paradigm is better under identical conditions’, and elevate deployment-centric efficiency metrics to equal footing with accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 受控对比把“时间输出头”从骨干/数据里剥离，能直接指导端侧VTG选型；只看成本-稳定性-确定性权衡表和关键消融即可。
recommendation.en: Cleanly isolates the “time-output head” from backbone/data effects, giving actionable edge-deployment tradeoffs; just read the cost/stability/determinism table and the core ablations.

paper.title: Tango: Taming Visual Signals for Efficient Video Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 视频LLM的计算瓶颈主要在LLM侧的长序列自注意力与FFN，视觉token数量直接决定推理成本。现有训练free token pruning两大范式存在关键缺陷：注意力Top-k选择无法覆盖多模态、长尾的注意力分布(且易受attention sink影响)；直接基于相似度的聚类会产生空间碎片化簇，池化后对象几何结构被破坏，导致表征失真。
summary.importance: 该工作系统性“复盘并推进”两类主流剪枝信号(显著性attention与多样性similarity)，给出可插拔的改造：既提升显著token选择对多模态/长尾的覆盖，又让聚类合并更符合视频对象的时空局部性，从而在极低保留率下保持性能并显著加速。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Tango 框架，包含三模块：时间分段、显著token选择、时空合并。
(1) must_read：显著token选择的改造
- 观察：attention热图常呈多模态(对应不同语义实体)，且分数长尾；硬Top-k会偏向单一峰值或被固定位置的attention sink占据，导致语义覆盖不足。
- 方法：引入“diversity-driven”选择：先扩展候选集合，再对候选token做聚类，并在簇内进行选择(而非全局Top-k)，以覆盖多个注意力模式与尾部信息，实现更全面的语义保留。
(2) must_read：相似度聚类的局部性注入
- 问题：仅用特征相似度聚类会把同一对象切成碎片簇，池化后形状结构丢失。
- 方法：在相似度计算中加入时空局部性先验，惩罚时空距离远的token被判为相似；具体通过 Spatio-temporal Rotary Position Embedding (ST-RoPE) 编码空间与时间相对距离，使相似度对“近邻一致、远邻区分”更敏感，并可无缝接入标准聚类/合并流程。
(3) skim：整体流程
先做时间分段以最大化可剪的静态token；再用多样性驱动的显著选择保留关键token；最后用带ST-RoPE的相似度进行时空合并/池化，得到更干净的对象级表示。
