summary.experiments: 在 Video LLM 上进行综合实验。报告在仅保留10%视频token时，LLaVA-OneVision-7B可保持约98.9%的全量性能，同时推理加速约1.88×。并通过可视化/统计展示注意力多模态与长尾分布、以及直接聚类导致的碎片化现象，用以支撑方法设计动机。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）
- 重点看：Introduction 对两类范式缺陷的诊断(注意力多模态+长尾、聚类碎片化)；Preliminaries 中对FLOPs与“等效保留率”对齐的说明(保证比较公平)。
- 重点模块：显著选择的“扩展候选→聚类→簇内选择”；ST-RoPE 如何把时空相对距离注入相似度并影响聚类合并。
- 建议精读图表：Fig.2(注意力热图多模态、聚类碎片化对比)、Fig.3(长尾分布)、Fig.4(整体框架)。同时关注文中对attention sink的讨论(通常在附录)。
- 创新点抓手：用“多样性驱动”修正Top-k显著选择；用ST-RoPE把局部性先验显式写进相似度，减少碎片簇。

skim（泛读建议）
- 先读：Introduction + Fig.1/2理解问题；再扫 Fig.4 把三模块串起来；最后只看主结果表(10% token下性能保持与加速)。
- 若时间有限：只抓两点——(i) 为什么Top-k不行；(ii) ST-RoPE解决聚类碎片化的直觉。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心观点是：高效视频LLM的关键不只是“剪多少”，而是“如何利用两类视觉信号”。他们把attention当作显著性但强调其分布形态(多模态/长尾)必须被尊重；把similarity当作去冗余但强调必须加入时空几何约束，否则聚类会破坏对象结构。整体方法保持训练free与工程可插拔。

summary_en.core_problem: Video LLM inference is dominated by the LLM’s Transformer cost, which scales with the number of visual tokens. Existing training-free pruning has two major issues: (1) rigid attention Top-k selection fails under multi-modal, long-tailed attention distributions and can be hijacked by attention sinks; (2) plain similarity-based clustering often yields spatially fragmented clusters, and pooling over them distorts object representations by breaking geometric structure.
summary_en.importance: The paper advances the two mainstream pruning paradigms (attention-based saliency and similarity-based diversity) with plug-and-play fixes: better coverage of attention modes/tails during selection and locality-aware similarity for cleaner object-level merging—enabling strong accuracy retention at very low token budgets with notable speedups.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Tango consists of (i) temporal video segmentation, (ii) salient token selection, and (iii) spatio-temporal merging.
(1) must_read: Improved salient selection
- Observation: attention maps are multi-modal (aligned with different semantic entities) and long-tailed; global Top-k is suboptimal and vulnerable to fixed-position attention sinks.
- Method: a diversity-driven selection pipeline—expand the candidate set, cluster candidate tokens, then select within each cluster—so multiple attention modes and tail information are covered rather than over-allocating to a single peak.
(2) must_read: Locality-aware clustering via ST-RoPE
- Problem: feature-only similarity clustering produces fragmented clusters and noisy pooled representations.
- Method: inject a spatio-temporal locality prior into similarity by penalizing tokens that are far apart in space/time. This is implemented with Spatio-temporal Rotary Position Embedding (ST-RoPE) encoding relative distances along spatial and temporal axes, and can be integrated into standard clustering/merging.
(3) skim: End-to-end
Segment the video temporally to maximize prunable static tokens, select salient tokens with diversity-aware clustering, then merge tokens using ST-RoPE-enhanced similarity to preserve object geometry.
summary_en.experiments: Comprehensive experiments on Video LLMs show that keeping only 10% of video tokens preserves ~98.9% of full performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B while achieving ~1.88× inference speedup. The paper also provides visual/statistical evidence of multi-modal/long-tailed attention and fragmented clustering to justify the design.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep reading)
- Focus on: Introduction’s diagnosis of the two paradigm failures; Preliminaries on FLOPs and the “equivalent retention ratio” for fair comparisons.
- Key modules: diversity-driven salient selection (expanded candidates → clustering → intra-cluster pick); how ST-RoPE injects spatio-temporal relative distance into similarity and improves merging.
- Figures to study: Fig. 2 (multi-modal attention + fragmented clustering), Fig. 3 (long-tail attention), Fig. 4 (overall framework). Also check the attention-sink discussion (often in the appendix).
- Main innovations: diversity-driven fix for Top-k saliency; explicit locality prior in similarity via ST-RoPE to reduce fragmented clusters.

skim (quick reading)
- Read: Introduction + Fig. 1/2 for motivation; Fig. 4 to connect the pipeline; then the main results table for 10% token retention (accuracy retention and speedup).
- If time is tight: only capture (i) why Top-k fails; (ii) the intuition of ST-RoPE for locality-aware clustering.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that efficiency is not only about pruning ratio but about properly exploiting two visual signals. They treat attention as saliency but emphasize respecting its multi-modal/long-tailed nature, and treat similarity as redundancy reduction but insist on spatio-temporal geometric constraints to avoid destroying object structure. The overall design remains training-free and engineering-friendly.

recommendation.zh: 对attention top-k与相似度聚类两派剪枝的失败模式讲得够具体，给出可插拔修补件；只读失败案例+极低保留率下的消融就能判断值不值。
recommendation.en: Useful because it pinpoints concrete failure modes of attention top-k vs similarity clustering and offers drop-in fixes; read the failure-case section and low-retention ablations to decide.
